import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { isAdminRole } from "@/lib/roles";

// Simple in-memory rate limiter (Note: specific to single-instance/long-running server)
// For distributed systems (Vercel/Serverless), use Redis (e.g., Upstash)
const rateLimit = new Map<string, { count: number; startTime: number }>();
const RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60 * 1000; // 1 minute
const MAX_REQUESTS = 1000000; // 1000000 requests per minute (increased to prevent false positives)

// Cleanup interval to prevent memory leaks (every 5 minutes)
setInterval(() => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [ip, record] of rateLimit.entries()) {
    if (now - record.startTime > RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW) {
      rateLimit.delete(ip);
    }
  }
}, 5 * 60 * 1000);

function checkRateLimit(ip: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const record = rateLimit.get(ip);

  if (!record) {
    rateLimit.set(ip, { count: 1, startTime: now });
    return false;
  }

  if (now - record.startTime > RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW) {
    rateLimit.set(ip, { count: 1, startTime: now });
    return false;
  }

  if (record.count >= MAX_REQUESTS) {
    return true;
  }

  record.count++;
  return false;
}

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const DEFAULT_LOCALE = "az";
/** DÉ™stÉ™klÉ™nmÉ™yÉ™n brauzer dillÉ™ri Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n aÃ§Ä±lÄ±ÅŸ dili (istifadÉ™Ã§i tÉ™lÉ™bi) */
const FALLBACK_LOCALE_UNSUPPORTED = "en";

/**
 * Accept-Language header-indÉ™n ilk dÉ™stÉ™klÉ™nÉ™n dili tapÄ±r.
 * MÉ™s: "en-US,en;q=0.9,az;q=0.8" -> "en", "az-AZ,tr;q=0.9" -> "az"
 */
function getLocaleFromAcceptLanguage(acceptLanguage: string | null): string {
  if (!acceptLanguage || !acceptLanguage.trim()) return FALLBACK_LOCALE_UNSUPPORTED;
  const parts = acceptLanguage.split(",").map((p) => p.trim().split(";")[0]?.toLowerCase() || "");
  for (const part of parts) {
    const lang = part.split("-")[0] || part;
    if (lang === "en") return "en";
    if (lang === "az") return "az";
    if (lang === "tr") return "tr";
    if (lang === "ru") return "ru";
  }
  return FALLBACK_LOCALE_UNSUPPORTED;
}

/**
 * @param forRoot true = domain/localhost aÃ§Ä±lÄ±ÅŸÄ±nda birbaÅŸa brauzer dilinÉ™ yÃ¶nlÉ™ndir (cookie gÃ¶zardÄ±)
 */
function getPreferredLocale(request: NextRequest, forRoot = false): string {
  const hl = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("hl");
  if (hl && LOCALES.includes(hl as (typeof LOCALES)[number])) return hl;

  if (forRoot) {
    const acceptLanguage = request.headers.get("accept-language");
    return getLocaleFromAcceptLanguage(acceptLanguage);
  }

  const cookieLocale = request.cookies.get("locale")?.value?.toLowerCase();
  if (cookieLocale && LOCALES.includes(cookieLocale as (typeof LOCALES)[number])) {
    return cookieLocale;
  }
  const acceptLanguage = request.headers.get("accept-language");
  return getLocaleFromAcceptLanguage(acceptLanguage);
}

function isGoogleAdsenseCrawler(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  const ua = (request.headers.get("user-agent") || "").toLowerCase();
  return ua.includes("adsbot-google") || ua.includes("mediapartners-google");
}

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname;

  // 0. Simple redirects
  if (path === "/blogs" || path.startsWith("/blogs/")) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = path.replace(/^\/blogs/, "/blog");
    return NextResponse.redirect(url, { status: 301 });
  }

  // 0b. Dil prefiksi: bÃ¼tÃ¼n ictimai URL-lÉ™r /az/, /en/, /tr/, /ru/ altÄ±nda olsun (Google Ads dil tÉ™yini Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
  const isApi = path.startsWith("/api");
  const isAdmin = path.startsWith("/admin");
  const isAuth = path.startsWith("/auth");
  const isAccount = path.startsWith("/account");
  const isNext = path.startsWith("/_next") || path.startsWith("/favicon");
  const isStatic = path.match(/\.(svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico|css|js)$/);
  const firstSegment = path.slice(1).split("/")[0] || "";
  const hasLocalePrefix = LOCALES.includes(firstSegment as (typeof LOCALES)[number]);

  if (!isApi && !isAdmin && !isAuth && !isAccount && !isNext && !isStatic) {
    if (path === "/" || path === "") {
      const locale = getPreferredLocale(request, true);
      if (isGoogleAdsenseCrawler(request)) {
        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
        url.pathname = `/${locale}`;
        const res = NextResponse.rewrite(url);
        res.cookies.set("locale", locale, { path: "/", maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365, sameSite: "lax" });
        res.headers.set("x-locale", locale);
        return res;
      }
      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
      url.pathname = `/${locale}`;
      const res = NextResponse.redirect(url, 307);
      res.cookies.set("locale", locale, { path: "/", maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365, sameSite: "lax" });
      res.headers.set("x-locale", locale);
      return res;
    }
    if (!hasLocalePrefix) {
      const locale = getPreferredLocale(request);
      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
      url.pathname = `/${locale}${path}`;
      const res = NextResponse.redirect(url, 307);
      res.cookies.set("locale", locale, { path: "/", maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365, sameSite: "lax" });
      res.headers.set("x-locale", locale);
      return res;
    }
  }

  // 1. DDoS / Rate Limiting Protection
  // Skip rate limiting for static assets and API routes (except admin)
  const isStaticAsset = path.startsWith("/_next") || 
                        path.startsWith("/api/chat") || 
                        path.startsWith("/api/marketing") ||
                        path.match(/\.(svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico|css|js)$/);
  
  if (!isStaticAsset) {
    const ip = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || "unknown";
    if (checkRateLimit(ip)) {
      return new NextResponse("Too Many Requests", { status: 429 });
    }
  }

  // URL-dÉ™ dil prefiksi varsa (/en/, /az/ ...) x-locale vÉ™ cookie tÉ™tbiq et
  const localeFromPath = hasLocalePrefix ? firstSegment : null;
  const hl = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("hl");
  const localeFromQuery =
    hl && LOCALES.includes(hl as (typeof LOCALES)[number]) ? hl : null;
  const effectiveLocale = localeFromPath || localeFromQuery;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers(request.headers);
  if (effectiveLocale) {
    requestHeaders.set("x-locale", effectiveLocale);
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: requestHeaders,
    },
  });

  if (effectiveLocale) {
    response.cookies.set("locale", effectiveLocale, {
      path: "/",
      maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365,
      sameSite: "lax",
    });
  }

  // Define protected paths (path already defined above)
  const isAdminRoute = path.startsWith("/admin") && path !== "/admin/login";
  const isAccountRoute = path.startsWith("/account");
  const isProtectedRoute = isAdminRoute || isAccountRoute;

  // âš¡ PERFORMANS: YalnÄ±z qorunan (protected) marÅŸrutlarda Supabase auth yoxla
  // Public sÉ™hifÉ™lÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n gÉ™rÉ™ksiz network sorÄŸusu gÃ¶ndÉ™rmirik
  if (isProtectedRoute) {
    const supabase = createServerClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
      {
        cookies: {
          getAll() {
            return request.cookies.getAll();
          },
          setAll(cookiesToSet) {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =>
              request.cookies.set(name, value)
            );
            response = NextResponse.next({
              request,
            });
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              response.cookies.set(name, value, options)
            );
          },
        },
      }
    );

    const {
      data: { user },
      error,
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    // If not authenticated (incl. invalid/expired refresh token)
    if (error || !user) {
      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
      url.pathname = "/auth/login";
      url.searchParams.set("next", path);
      const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);
      // Invalid refresh token â€“ sessiya cookie-lÉ™rini tÉ™mizlÉ™ ki, brauzer tÉ™krar cÉ™hd etmÉ™sin
      try {
        const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || "";
        const projectRef = supabaseUrl.match(/https:\/\/([^.]+)\.supabase\.co/)?.[1];
        if (projectRef) {
          const baseName = `sb-${projectRef}-auth-token`;
          redirectResponse.cookies.set(baseName, "", { maxAge: 0, path: "/" });
          for (let i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            redirectResponse.cookies.set(`${baseName}.${i}`, "", { maxAge: 0, path: "/" });
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      return redirectResponse;
    }

    // Check role for admin routes
    if (isAdminRoute) {
      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("role, is_admin")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (profileError) {
        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
        url.pathname = "/auth/login";
        url.searchParams.set("next", path);
        return NextResponse.redirect(url);
      }
      const hasAdminAccess = profile
        ? isAdminRole(profile.role) || Boolean(profile.is_admin)
        : false;
      if (!hasAdminAccess) {
        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
        url.pathname = "/404";
        return NextResponse.rewrite(url);
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Security Headers (XSS, Clickjacking protection)
  const cspHeader = `
    default-src 'self';
    script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'
      https://*.supabase.co
      https://*.stripe.com
      https://va.vercel-scripts.com
      https://www.googletagmanager.com
      https://www.google-analytics.com
      https://www.googleadservices.com
      https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net
      https://*.doubleclick.net
      https://hcaptcha.com
      https://*.hcaptcha.com;
    style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
      https://fonts.googleapis.com
      https://hcaptcha.com
      https://*.hcaptcha.com;
    img-src 'self' blob: data:
      https://*.supabase.co
      https://images.unsplash.com
      https://*.stripe.com
      https://www.googletagmanager.com
      https://www.google-analytics.com
      https://www.gstatic.com
      https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net
      https://*.doubleclick.net;
    font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com;
    connect-src 'self'
      https://*.supabase.co
      https://api.stripe.com
      https://vitals.vercel-insights.com
      https://www.google-analytics.com
      https://www.googletagmanager.com
      https://stats.g.doubleclick.net
      https://www.google.com
      https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net
      https://*.doubleclick.net
      https://hcaptcha.com
      https://*.hcaptcha.com;
    frame-src
      https://*.stripe.com
      https://hcaptcha.com
      https://*.hcaptcha.com
      https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net
      https://tpc.googlesyndication.com
      https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com
      https://*.doubleclick.net
      https://www.google.com;
    object-src 'none';
    base-uri 'self';
    form-action 'self';
    frame-ancestors 'none';
    block-all-mixed-content;
    upgrade-insecure-requests;
  `.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();

  response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', cspHeader);
  response.headers.set('X-DNS-Prefetch-Control', 'on');
  response.headers.set('Strict-Transport-Security', 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload');
  response.headers.set('X-Frame-Options', 'SAMEORIGIN');
  response.headers.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
  response.headers.set('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');
  response.headers.set('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
  response.headers.set('Permissions-Policy', 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()');

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    "/",
    /*
     * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with:
     * - _next/static (static files)
     * - _next/image (image optimization files)
     * - favicon.ico (favicon file)
     * - public files (svg, etc)
     */
    "/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)",
  ],
};

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { unstable_cache } from "next/cache";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { ensureAbsoluteImageUrl } from "@/lib/seo-utils";
import { parseKeywords } from "@/lib/keywords-utils";
import Script from "next/script";
import SpeedInsightsWrapper from "@/components/common/SpeedInsightsWrapper";
import "./globals.css";
import Providers from "./providers";

const OG_LOCALE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  az: "az_AZ",
  en: "en_US",
  tr: "tr_TR",
  ru: "ru_RU",
};

async function getRequestLocale(): Promise<"az" | "en" | "tr" | "ru"> {
  const h = await headers();
  const c = await cookies();
  const locale = h.get("x-locale") || c.get("locale")?.value;
  if (locale === "en" || locale === "tr" || locale === "ru") return locale;
  return "az";
}

/* â”€â”€â”€ Ãœmumi data fetcher (hÉ™m metadata, hÉ™m layout istifadÉ™ edir) â”€â”€â”€ */
const getCachedSiteData = unstable_cache(
  async () => {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const [settingsData, metaData] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from("site_settings")
        .select("public_site_name, site_name, logo, footer_phone")
        .eq("id", 1)
        .maybeSingle(),
      supabase
        .from("meta_tags")
        .select("*")
        .eq("page", "home")
        .maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    return {
      settings: settingsData.data,
      meta: metaData.data,
    };
  },
  ["site-settings-meta"],
  { revalidate: 300 }
);

async function getSiteData() {
  return getCachedSiteData();
}

/* â”€â”€â”€ Next.js Metadata â”€â”€â”€ */
export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const [{ settings, meta }, requestLocale] = await Promise.all([

/* â”€â”€â”€ Root Layout â”€â”€â”€ */
export default async function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) {
  const [{ settings, meta }, requestLocale] = await Promise.all([
    getSiteData(),
    getRequestLocale(),
  ]);

  const siteUrl =

import LeafLoader from "@/components/ui/LeafLoader";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

const loadingMessages: Record<string, string> = {
  az: "YÃ¼klÉ™nir...",
  en: "Loading...",
  ru: "Ð—Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ·ÐºÐ°...",
  tr: "YÃ¼kleniyor...",
};

function getLocaleFromPathname(pathname: string): string {
  const locale = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
  return locale && locale in loadingMessages ? locale : "en";
}

export default function Loading() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const locale = getLocaleFromPathname(pathname);
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex min-h-screen w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 bg-white backdrop-blur-sm">
      <LeafLoader />
      <p className="animate-pulse text-sm font-medium text-emerald-600">
        {loadingMessages[locale]}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { CartProvider } from "@/contexts/CartContext";
import { WishlistProvider } from "@/contexts/WishlistContext";
import { I18nProvider } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { SiteSettingsProvider } from "@/contexts/SiteSettingsContext";
import { ToastProvider } from "@/contexts/ToastContext";
import { ToastManager } from "@/components/common/Toast";
import type { Locale } from "@/modules/i18n/config";

// Bu widgetlÉ™r ilk yÃ¼klÉ™nmÉ™ Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n tÉ™lÉ™b olunmur - lazy load edirik
const ChatWidget = dynamic(() => import("@/components/chat/ChatWidget"), {
  ssr: false,
});
const NeuromarketingPopup = dynamic(
  () => import("@/components/marketing/NeuromarketingPopup"),
  { ssr: false }
);
const FloatingWidgets = dynamic(
  () => import("@/components/layout/FloatingWidgets"),
  { ssr: false }
);
const MobileBottomNav = dynamic(
  () => import("@/components/layout/MobileBottomNav"),
  { ssr: false }
);

type Toast = {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "info";
};

type ProvidersProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
};

export default function Providers({ children, initialLocale }: ProvidersProps) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  const showToast = useCallback((message: string, type: "success" | "error" | "info" = "success") => {
    const id = `toast-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type }]);
  }, []);

  const removeToast = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  return (
    <I18nProvider initialLocale={initialLocale}>
      <SiteSettingsProvider>
        <ToastProvider showToast={showToast}>
          <WishlistProvider showToast={showToast}>
            <CartProvider showToast={showToast}>
              {children}
              <ChatWidget />
              <FloatingWidgets />
              <MobileBottomNav />
              <NeuromarketingPopup />
              <ToastManager toasts={toasts} onRemove={removeToast} />
            </CartProvider>
          </WishlistProvider>
        </ToastProvider>
      </SiteSettingsProvider>
    </I18nProvider>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\sitemap.ts

import { MetadataRoute } from 'next';
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from '@/lib/supabase-server';
import { getCategories } from '@/modules/products/queries';

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://www.herbaformadaqal.com';
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  // Static pages
  const staticPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    {
      url: siteUrl,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 1.0,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/products`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.9,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/programs`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'weekly',
      priority: 0.8,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/about`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.7,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/contact`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.7,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/faq`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.6,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/blog`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'weekly',
      priority: 0.8,
    },
  ];

  // Categories
  const categories = await getCategories();
  const categoryPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = categories.map((cat) => ({
    url: `${siteUrl}/categories/${cat.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'weekly',
    priority: 0.8,
  }));

  // Products
  const { data: products } = await supabase
    .from('products')
    .select('slug, updated_at')
    .eq('is_active', true);
  
  const productPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = (products || []).map((product) => ({
    url: `${siteUrl}/products/${product.slug}`,
    lastModified: product.updated_at ? new Date(product.updated_at) : new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'weekly',
    priority: 0.9,
  }));

  // Blog posts
  const { data: posts } = await supabase
    .from('content_posts')
    .select('slug, updated_at')
    .eq('is_published', true);
  
  const blogPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = (posts || []).map((post) => ({
    url: `${siteUrl}/blog/${post.slug}`,
    lastModified: post.updated_at ? new Date(post.updated_at) : new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'monthly',
    priority: 0.7,
  }));

  return [...staticPages, ...categoryPages, ...productPages, ...blogPages];
}

import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { getSiteSettings } from "@/modules/settings/queries";
import { getRecommendedProducts } from "@/modules/products/queries";
import AboutClient from "./AboutClient";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";

async function getAboutData(locale = "az") {
  // Navbar Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n ÅŸemaya uyÄŸun settings
  const settings = await getSiteSettings();

  // about_content sÃ¼tunlarÄ± ÅŸemada olmaya bilÉ™r, ayrÄ±ca raw sorÄŸu ilÉ™ Ã§É™kirik
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rawSettings } = await supabase
    .from("site_settings")
    .select("about_content, about_content_az, about_content_en, about_content_tr, about_content_ru")
    .eq("id", 1)
    .maybeSingle();

  const s = rawSettings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
  const localeKey = `about_content_${locale}`;
  const aboutContent =
    (s && typeof s[localeKey] === "string" && (s[localeKey] as string).trim()
      ? (s[localeKey] as string)
      : s && typeof s.about_content_az === "string" && (s.about_content_az as string).trim()
      ? (s.about_content_az as string)
      : s && typeof s.about_content === "string"
      ? (s.about_content as string)
      : "") || "";

  const products = await getRecommendedProducts(4).catch(() => []);

  return { settings, aboutContent, products };
}

export default async function AboutPage() {
  const { settings, aboutContent, products } = await getAboutData();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar initialSettings={settings} />
      <AboutClient
        initialAboutContent={aboutContent}
        initialProducts={products}

  );
}

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import { GoogleAdsConversion } from "@/components/analytics/GoogleAdsConversion";
import type { OrderStatus } from "@/modules/orders/types";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
};

type OrderItemRow = {
  product_name: string | null;
  quantity: number | null;
  unit_price: number | null;
  total: number | null;
};

function formatOrderStatus(status: OrderStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return "GÃ¶zlÉ™mÉ™dÉ™";
    case "paid":
      return "Ã–dÉ™niÅŸ tÉ™sdiqlÉ™nib";
    case "shipped":
      return "YoldadÄ±r";
    case "completed":
      return "Ã‡atdÄ±rÄ±lÄ±b";
    case "failed":
      return "UÄŸursuz";
    case "cancelled":
      return "LÉ™ÄŸv edilib";
    case "refunded":
      return "Geri qaytarÄ±lÄ±b";
    default:
      return status;
  }
}

function formatOrderDate(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "";
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return value;
  }
  return d.toLocaleString("az-AZ");
}

export default async function AccountOrderDetailPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const idNum = Number(id);
  if (!idNum || Number.isNaN(idNum)) {
    notFound();
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    notFound();
  }

  const { data: order } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select(
      "id, status, currency, subtotal, discount_total, shipping_total, total, created_at, shipping_address"
    )
    .eq("id", idNum)
    .eq("user_id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!order) {
    notFound();
  }

    .from("order_items")
    .select("product_name, quantity, unit_price, total")
    .eq("order_id", order.id);

    (order as { shipping_address?: unknown }).shipping_address ?? null;

    const trimmed = rawShipping.trim();
    shippingText = trimmed || null;

    const addr = rawShipping as Record<string, unknown>;
    const parts: string[] = [];

    if (typeof fullName === "string" && fullName.trim()) {

      parts.push(`Tel: ${phone.trim()}`);

      parts.push(city.trim());

      addr.streetAddress;

      parts.push(addressLine.trim());

      parts.push(...extra);

      shippingText = parts.join(", ");

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import type { Category, Product } from "@/modules/products/types";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

const LOCALES = [
  { code: "az", label: "AzÉ™rbaycan" },
  { code: "en", label: "English" },
  { code: "tr", label: "TÃ¼rkÃ§e" },
  { code: "ru", label: "Ð ÑƒÑÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹" },
] as const;

type CategoryWithTranslations = Category & {
  translations?: { az: string; en: string; tr: string; ru: string };
};

export default function AdminCategories() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CategoryWithTranslations[]>([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState("");
  const [namesByLang, setNamesByLang] = useState<Record<string, string>>({ az: "", en: "", tr: "", ru: "" });
  const [iconFile, setIconFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editNames, setEditNames] = useState<Record<string, string>>({ az: "", en: "", tr: "", ru: "" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [primaryColor, setPrimaryColor] = useState("#10b981");
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/admin/categories").then((r) =>
        r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.resolve([])
      ),
      fetch("/api/admin/products").then((r) =>
        r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.resolve([])
      ),
      fetch("/api/admin/settings").then((r) =>
        r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.resolve(null)
      ),
    ])
      .then(([cats, prods, settings]) => {
        setItems((cats || []) as CategoryWithTranslations[]);
        setProducts((prods || []) as Product[]);
        if (settings && typeof settings.primary_color === "string") {
          const raw = settings.primary_color as string;
          if (raw && raw.startsWith("#")) {
            setPrimaryColor(raw);
          }
        }
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const uploadFile = async (file: File) => {
    const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
    const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop();
    const fileName = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}.${fileExt}`;
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('categories')
      .upload(fileName, file);
    
    if (error) {
      console.error('Upload error:', error);
      return null;
    }
    
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage
      .from('categories')
      .getPublicUrl(fileName);
      
    return publicUrl;
  };

  const add = async () => {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      alert("ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa kateqoriyanÄ±n adÄ±nÄ± daxil edin.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    
    try {
      let iconUrl = null;
      if (iconFile) {
        iconUrl = await uploadFile(iconFile);
        if (!iconUrl) {
          alert("ÅžÉ™kil yÃ¼klÉ™nmÉ™di. ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa yenidÉ™n cÉ™hd edin.");
          setSaving(false);
          return;
        }
      }

      const translations: Record<string, string> = {};
        LOCALES.forEach(({ code }) => {
          const v = code === "az" ? trimmed : (namesByLang[code] ?? "").trim();
          if (v) translations[code] = v;
        });
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/categories", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          name: trimmed, 
          slug: slug.trim() || null,
          icon: iconUrl,
          translations: namesByLang,
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "XÉ™ta baÅŸ verdi" }));
        alert(errorData.error || "Kateqoriya É™lavÉ™ edilmÉ™di");
        setSaving(false);
        return;
      }

      const created = await res.json();
      if (created) {
        setItems((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          {
            ...(created as Category),
            translations: {
              az: trimmed,
              en: namesByLang.en ?? "",
              tr: namesByLang.tr ?? "",
              ru: namesByLang.ru ?? "",
            },
          },
        ]);
        setName("");
        setSlug("");
        setNamesByLang({ az: "", en: "", tr: "", ru: "" });
        setIconFile(null);
        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Add category error:", err);
      alert("XÉ™ta baÅŸ verdi. ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa yenidÉ™n cÉ™hd edin.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const remove = (id: number) => {
    const prev = items;
    setItems((current) => current.filter((i) => i.id !== id));
    setExpanded((current) => {
      const copy = { ...current };
      delete copy[id];
      return copy;
    });
    setSaving(true);
    fetch("/api/admin/categories", {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.ok) {
          setItems(prev);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => setItems(prev))
      .finally(() => setSaving(false));
  };

  const toggle = (id: number) => {
    setExpanded((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  };

  const startEdit = (cat: CategoryWithTranslations) => {
    const tr: { az?: string; en?: string; tr?: string; ru?: string } = cat.translations ?? {};
    setEditingId(cat.id);
    setEditNames({
      az: tr.az ?? cat.name ?? "",
      en: tr.en ?? "",
      tr: tr.tr ?? "",
      ru: tr.ru ?? "",
    });
  };

  const saveEdit = async () => {
    if (editingId == null) return;
    const az = (editNames.az ?? "").trim();
    if (!az) {
      alert("AzÉ™rbaycan dilindÉ™ ad mÃ¼tlÉ™qdir.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/categories", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { 
  Search, 
  Trash2, 
  MessageSquare, 
  Mail, 
  Calendar, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Clock, 
  AlertCircle,
  Filter
} from "lucide-react";

type ContactStatus = "Yeni" | "Oxunub" | "BaÄŸlandÄ±";

type AdminContact = {
  id: string;
  createdAt: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  subject: string;
  message: string;
  status: ContactStatus;
  adminNotes: string;
};

export default function AdminContactsPage() {
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState<AdminContact[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<ContactStatus | "All">("All");

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/admin/contacts")
      .then((res) => res.json() as Promise<AdminContact[]>)
      .then((data) => {
        setContacts(
          data.map((row) => ({
            id: String(row.id),
            createdAt: row.createdAt,
            name: row.name,
            email: row.email,
            subject: row.subject,
            message: row.message,
            status: row.status,
            adminNotes: row.adminNotes,
          }))
        );
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const updateStatus = (id: string, status: ContactStatus) => {
    setContacts((prev) =>
      prev.map((c) => (c.id === id ? { ...c, status } : c))
    );
    setSaving(true);
    fetch("/api/admin/contacts", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id, status }),
    })
      .then(() => {})
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setSaving(false));
  };

  const updateNotes = (id: string, notes: string) => {
    setContacts((prev) =>
      prev.map((c) => (c.id === id ? { ...c, adminNotes: notes } : c))
    );
    // Debounce could be added here, but for now direct update is fine
    fetch("/api/admin/contacts", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id, adminNotes: notes }),
    }).catch(() => {});
  };

  const remove = (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm("Bu mesajÄ± silmÉ™k istÉ™diyinizÉ™ É™minsiniz?")) return;
    
    const prev = contacts;
    setContacts((current) => current.filter((c) => c.id !== id));
    
    fetch("/api/admin/contacts", {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.ok) setContacts(prev);
      })
      .catch(() => setContacts(prev));
  };

  const filteredContacts = contacts.filter(contact => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      contact.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      contact.email.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      contact.subject.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      contact.message.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "All" || contact.status === statusFilter;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const getStatusColor = (status: ContactStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "Yeni": return "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200";
      case "Oxunub": return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200";
      case "BaÄŸlandÄ±": return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200";
      default: return "bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: ContactStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "Yeni": return <AlertCircle size={14} className="mr-1.5" />;
      case "Oxunub": return <Clock size={14} className="mr-1.5" />;
      case "BaÄŸlandÄ±": return <CheckCircle size={14} className="mr-1.5" />;
      default: return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Header Section */}

          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">MÃ¼ÅŸtÉ™ri MÃ¼raciÉ™tlÉ™ri</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            GÉ™lÉ™n mesajlarÄ± oxuyun, statuslarÄ±nÄ± yenilÉ™yin vÉ™ qeydlÉ™r É™lavÉ™ edin.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-white p-1 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-100">
            {contacts.length} Mesaj
          </div>
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600">
            {contacts.filter(c => c.status === "Yeni").length} Yeni
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  description_font_weight?: string;
};

export default function AdminContentPage() {

          translations?: Record<string, string>;
          title_font_size?: string;

            title_font_size: ad.title_font_size ?? "",
            title_font_weight: ad.title_font_weight ?? "",

        // Map posts

          id: number | string;
          title?: string;

          image_url?: string;

          excerpt_font_weight?: string;
          body_font_size?: string;
          body_font_weight?: string;

            title: p.title || "",
            excerpt: p.excerpt || "",
            body: p.body || "",
            category: p.category || "",
            imageUrl: p.image_url || "",

            title_font_weight: p.title_font_weight ?? "",

            excerpt_font_weight: p.excerpt_font_weight ?? "",
            body_font_size: p.body_font_size ?? "",
            body_font_weight: p.body_font_weight ?? "",

    }

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit3,
  Save,
  X,
  HelpCircle,
  ChevronUp,
  ChevronDown,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Loader2,
  GripVertical,
} from "lucide-react";

const LOCALES = [
  { code: "az", label: "AzÉ™rbaycan" },
  { code: "en", label: "English" },
  { code: "tr", label: "TÃ¼rkÃ§e" },
  { code: "ru", label: "Ð ÑƒÑÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹" },
] as const;

type FAQTranslation = { question: string; answer: string };

type FAQ = {
  id: number;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  sort_order: number;
  is_active: boolean;
  translations?: Record<string, FAQTranslation>;
};

export default function AdminFaqsPage() {
  const [faqs, setFaqs] = useState<FAQ[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Form state
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [formTranslations, setFormTranslations] = useState<Record<string, FAQTranslation>>({
    az: { question: "", answer: "" },
    en: { question: "", answer: "" },
    tr: { question: "", answer: "" },
    ru: { question: "", answer: "" },
  });

  const fetchFaqs = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/faqs");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setFaqs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFaqs();
  }, []);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormTranslations({
      az: { question: "", answer: "" },
      en: { question: "", answer: "" },
      tr: { question: "", answer: "" },
      ru: { question: "", answer: "" },
    });
    setEditingId(null);
    setShowForm(false);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    const az = formTranslations.az || { question: "", answer: "" };
    if (!(az.question || "").trim()) {
      alert("AzÉ™rbaycan dilindÉ™ sual mÃ¼tlÉ™qdir.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (editingId) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            id: editingId,
            translations: formTranslations,
          }),
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const updated = await res.json();
          setFaqs((prev) =>
            prev.map((f) => (f.id === editingId ? { ...f, ...updated, translations: formTranslations } : f))
          );
          resetForm();
        }
      } else {
        const maxOrder = faqs.length > 0 ? Math.max(...faqs.map((f) => f.sort_order)) : 0;
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            translations: formTranslations,
            sort_order: maxOrder + 1,
            is_active: true,
          }),
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const created = await res.json();
          setFaqs((prev) => [...prev, { ...created, translations: formTranslations }]);
          resetForm();
        }
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (faq: FAQ) => {
    setEditingId(faq.id);
    const tr = faq.translations || {};
    setFormTranslations({
      az: tr.az ?? { question: faq.question, answer: faq.answer },
      en: tr.en ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
      tr: tr.tr ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
      ru: tr.ru ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Bu sualÄ± silmÉ™k istÉ™diyinizÉ™ É™minsiniz?")) return;
    const prev = faqs;
    setFaqs((current) => current.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) setFaqs(prev);
    } catch {
      setFaqs(prev);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (faq: FAQ) => {
    const nextActive = !faq.is_active;
    setFaqs((prev) =>
      prev.map((f) => (f.id === faq.id ? { ...f, is_active: nextActive } : f))
    );
    try {
      await fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: faq.id, is_active: nextActive }),
      });
    } catch {
    }
  };

  const moveUp = async (index: number) => {
    if (index === 0) return;
    const newFaqs = [...faqs];
    const temp = newFaqs[index].sort_order;
    newFaqs[index].sort_order = newFaqs[index - 1].sort_order;
    newFaqs[index - 1].sort_order = temp;
    [newFaqs[index], newFaqs[index - 1]] = [newFaqs[index - 1], newFaqs[index]];
    setFaqs(newFaqs);
    // Save both
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id: newFaqs[index].id, sort_order: newFaqs[index].sort_order }),
        }),
        fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id: newFaqs[index - 1].id, sort_order: newFaqs[index - 1].sort_order }),
        }),
      ]);
    } catch {
    }
  };

  const moveDown = async (index: number) => {
    if (index === faqs.length - 1) return;
    const newFaqs = [...faqs];
    const temp = newFaqs[index].sort_order;
    newFaqs[index].sort_order = newFaqs[index + 1].sort_order;
    newFaqs[index + 1].sort_order = temp;
    [newFaqs[index], newFaqs[index + 1]] = [newFaqs[index + 1], newFaqs[index]];
    setFaqs(newFaqs);
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id: newFaqs[index].id, sort_order: newFaqs[index].sort_order }),
        }),
        fetch("/api/admin/faqs", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id: newFaqs[index + 1].id, sort_order: newFaqs[index + 1].sort_order }),
        }),
      ]);
    } catch {
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
            Tez-tez verilÉ™n suallar
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Æsas sÉ™hifÉ™dÉ™ gÃ¶stÉ™rilÉ™cÉ™k FAQ suallarÄ±nÄ± idarÉ™ edin
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            resetForm();
            setShowForm(true);
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
        >
          <Plus size={16} />
          Yeni Sual
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Form */}
      {showForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-800">
            {editingId ? "SualÄ± RedaktÉ™ Et" : "Yeni Sual ÆlavÉ™ Et"}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">HÉ™r dil Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n sual vÉ™ cavab daxil edin. AzÉ™rbaycan mÃ¼tlÉ™qdir.</p>
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {LOCALES.map(({ code, label }) => (
              <div key={code} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 p-4 space-y-3">
                <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">{label}</h4>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">Sual</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500"
                    placeholder={code === "az" ? "MÉ™s: Herbalife mÉ™hsullarÄ± nÉ™ Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n istifadÉ™ olunur?" : "Question..."}
                    value={formTranslations[code]?.question ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setFormTranslations((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        [code]: { ...(prev[code] ?? { question: "", answer: "" }), question: e.target.value },
                      }))
                    }
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">Cavab</label>

"use client";

import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Lock, Mail, Loader2, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { isAdminRole } from "@/lib/roles";

export default function AdminLogin() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const router = useRouter();

  const supabase = createBrowserClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!
  );

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const { data, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
        email,

const UPLOAD_BUCKET = "content";

function ImageUploadField({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      setUploadError("ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa ÅŸÉ™kil faylÄ± seÃ§in (JPG, PNG, WebP).");
      return;
    }
    setUploadError(null);
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      formData.append("bucket", UPLOAD_BUCKET);
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/upload", { method: "POST", body: formData });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "YÃ¼klÉ™mÉ™ xÉ™tasÄ±");
      onChange(data.publicUrl);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setUploadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "YÃ¼klÉ™mÉ™ xÉ™tasÄ±");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1 block">{label}</label>
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={handleFile}
        disabled={disabled}
      />
      {value ? (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-3">
          <img src={value} alt="" className="h-16 w-16 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-200" />
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 truncate mb-1">YÃ¼klÉ™nmiÅŸ ÅŸÉ™kil</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
                disabled={disabled || uploading}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {uploading ? "YÃ¼klÉ™nir..." : "DÉ™yiÅŸ"}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onChange("")}
                disabled={disabled}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:text-red-700"
              >
                Sil
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
          disabled={disabled || uploading}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600 hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50/50 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          <Upload size={18} className="text-slate-400" />
          {uploading ? "YÃ¼klÉ™nir..." : "KomputerdÉ™n ÅŸÉ™kil yÃ¼klÉ™"}
        </button>
      )}
      {uploadError && <p className="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{uploadError}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({
  label, value, onChange, placeholder, textarea,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  textarea?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mb-1 block">{label}</label>
      {textarea ? (
        <textarea
          className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 text-black resize-none"
          rows={2}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        />
      ) : (
        <input
          className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 text-black"
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function InfoRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | null }) {
  if (!value) return null;
  return (
    <div>
      <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">{label}:</span>
      <p className="text-slate-700 text-sm mt-0.5 break-all">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!config) return;

    fetch(`/api/admin/sections?page=${slug}`)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data: PageSection[]) => {
        const loadedSections: Record<string, SectionContent> = {};
        data.forEach((s) => {
          loadedSections[s.section_key] = s.content;
        });
        setSections(loadedSections);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error("Failed to load sections", err))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [slug, config]);

  const handleSave = async (sectionKey: string) => {
    setSaving(sectionKey);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sections", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          page_slug: slug,
          section_key: sectionKey,
          content: sections[sectionKey] || {},
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save");
      // Optional: Show success toast
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      alert("Yadda saxlanarkÉ™n xÉ™ta baÅŸ verdi");
    } finally {
      setSaving(null);
    }
  };

  const updateField = (sectionKey: string, fieldKey: string, value: string | number | boolean | null | undefined) => {
    setSections((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [sectionKey]: {
        ...prev[sectionKey],
        [fieldKey]: value,
      },
    }));
  };

  if (!config) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-60 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-slate-500">
        <Layout size={40} className="opacity-20" />
        <p>SÉ™hifÉ™ tapÄ±lmadÄ± vÉ™ ya konfiqurasiya edilmÉ™yib.</p>
        <Link href="/admin/pages" className="text-emerald-600 hover:underline">
          GeriyÉ™ qayÄ±t
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-60 items-center justify-center text-emerald-600">
        <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={32} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pb-20">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 pb-6">
        <Link
          href="/admin/pages"
          className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 transition-colors hover:border-emerald-200 hover:text-emerald-600"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={20} />
        </Link>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">{config.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">SÉ™hifÉ™nin mÉ™zmununu redaktÉ™ edin</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sections */}
      <div className="grid gap-8">
        {config.sections.map((section) => (

            key={section.key}
            className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm"
          >
            <div className="border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 px-6 py-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h2 className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{section.label}</h2>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleSave(section.key)}
                  disabled={saving === section.key}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-70"
                >
                  {saving === section.key ? (

                        rows={4}

                        className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100"

                            placeholder="ÅžÉ™kil URL-i daxil edin..."

                      </div>

                      title={
                        hasData
                          ? product.translations[locale].title
                          : "TÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™ yoxdur"
                      }
                    >
                      {locale.toUpperCase()}{" "}
                      {hasData ? "âœ“" : "â€”"}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {/* Show AZ translation detail */}
              {product.translations.az.title && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 line-clamp-2">
                  {product.translations.az.description || "TÉ™svir yoxdur"}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* â”€â”€â”€ Translations Tab â”€â”€â”€ */
function TranslationInput({
  locale,
  label,
  titleValue,
  descValue,
  onTitleChange,
  onDescChange,
}: {
  locale: string;
  label: string;
  titleValue: string;
  descValue: string;
  onTitleChange: (v: string) => void;
  onDescChange: (v: string) => void;
}) {
  const descRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);

  const wrapSelection = (before: string, after: string) => {
    const el = descRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const start = el.selectionStart ?? 0;
    const end = el.selectionEnd ?? 0;
    const value = descValue || "";
    const selected = value.slice(start, end) || "";
    const next =
      value.slice(0, start) + before + selected + after + value.slice(end);
    onDescChange(next);
    // SeÃ§ilÉ™n sahÉ™ni tÉ™xminÉ™n yerindÉ™ saxlayaq
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const pos = start + before.length + selected.length + after.length;
      el.focus();
      el.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
    });
  };

  const makeBold = () => wrapSelection("<strong>", "</strong>");
  const makeBig = () => wrapSelection('<span style="font-size: 1.1em;">', "</span>");
  const makeBigger = () =>
    wrapSelection('<span style="font-size: 1.25em;">', "</span>");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded bg-slate-900 text-[9px] font-bold text-white uppercase">
          {locale}
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">{label}</span>
      </div>
      <input
        placeholder={`MÉ™hsulun adÄ± (${locale.toUpperCase()})`}
        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-200 transition-shadow"
        value={titleValue}
        onChange={(e) => onTitleChange(e.target.value)}
      />
      {/* SadÉ™ rich-text toolbar: qalÄ±n vÉ™ Ã¶lÃ§Ã¼ dÃ¼ymÉ™lÉ™ri */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
        <span className="mr-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">
          Format:
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={makeBold}
          className="rounded border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-xs hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          B
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={makeBig}
          className="rounded border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          A+
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={makeBigger}
          className="rounded border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-medium hover:border-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          A++
        </button>
      </div>
      <textarea
        placeholder={`TÉ™svir (${locale.toUpperCase()})`}
        rows={8}
        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-200 transition-shadow resize-y min-h-[200px]"
        ref={descRef}
        value={descValue}
        onChange={(e) => onDescChange(e.target.value)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* â”€â”€â”€ Main Page â”€â”€â”€ */
export default function AdminProducts() {

    setOriginalPrice("");
    setPrice("");
    setStock("");
    setPoints("");

    setTitleAz("");
    setTitleEn("");

        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mr-2">
          GÃ¶rÃ¼nÃ¼rlÃ¼k
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"

          QiymÉ™tlÉ™r {hidePrices ? "gizlidir" : "gÃ¶rÃ¼nÃ¼r"}
        </button>
        <button

          onClick={toggleHidePoints}
          disabled={togglingPoints}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
            hidePoints
              ? "bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-100"
              : "bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-100"
          } disabled:opacity-50`}

          Xallar {hidePoints ? "gizlidir" : "gÃ¶rÃ¼nÃ¼r"}

      {/* â”€â”€â”€ Product Form (collapsible) â”€â”€â”€ */}
      {showForm && (

            <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-semibold text-slate-900">
              {editingProductId ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil size={16} className="text-blue-500" />
                  MÉ™hsula dÃ¼zÉ™liÅŸ et
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus size={16} className="text-emerald-600" />
                  Yeni mÉ™hsul É™lavÉ™ et
                </>
              )}
            </h2>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={cancelEditing}
              className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
            {/* Row 1: Basic info */}
            <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                  <Tag size={12} /> Æsas mÉ™lumatlar
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                    Daxili ad
                  </label>
                  <input
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-3.5 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100 transition-shadow"
                    value={name}
                    onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="MÉ™s: Formula 1 Vanilla"
                  />
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                    MÉ™hsulun daxili adÄ±.
                  </p>

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit3,
  Save,
  X,
  Loader2,
  Upload,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Palette,
  Image as ImageIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

type PromoBanner = {
  id: number;
  badge_text: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  button_text: string;
  button_link: string;
  image_url: string;
  bg_color: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  sort_order: number;
};

const DEFAULT_FORM = {
  badge_text: "",
  title: "",
  description: "",
  button_text: "MÆHSULLAR",
  button_link: "/products",
  image_url: "",
  bg_color: "#2a9d8f",
  is_active: true,
  sort_order: 0,
};

export default function AdminPromoBannersPage() {
  const [banners, setBanners] = useState<PromoBanner[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(DEFAULT_FORM);

  const fetchBanners = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/promo-banners");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setBanners(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } else {
        const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "BannerlÉ™r yÃ¼klÉ™nmÉ™di" }));
        console.error("Fetch banners error:", errorData);
        setBanners([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Fetch banners error:", err);
      setBanners([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBanners();
  }, []);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setForm(DEFAULT_FORM);
    setEditingId(null);
    setShowForm(false);
  };

  const uploadImage = async (file: File) => {
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop();
      const fileName = `promo-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
      const { error } = await supabase.storage.from("content").upload(fileName, file, { upsert: true });
      if (error) throw error;
      const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage.from("content").getPublicUrl(fileName);
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, image_url: urlData.publicUrl }));
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (editingId) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/promo-banners", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id: editingId, ...form }),
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const updated = await res.json();
          setBanners((prev) => prev.map((b) => (b.id === editingId ? updated : b)));
          resetForm();
        } else {
          const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Banner yenilÉ™nmÉ™di" }));
          alert(`XÉ™ta: ${errorData.error || "Banner yenilÉ™nmÉ™di"}`);
        }
      } else {
        const maxOrder = banners.length > 0 ? Math.max(...banners.map((b) => b.sort_order)) : 0;
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/promo-banners", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ ...form, sort_order: maxOrder + 1 }),
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const created = await res.json();
          setBanners((prev) => [...prev, created]);
          resetForm();
        } else {
          const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Banner É™lavÉ™ edilmÉ™di" }));
          alert(`XÉ™ta: ${errorData.error || "Banner É™lavÉ™ edilmÉ™di"}`);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Save error:", err);
      alert(`XÉ™ta baÅŸ verdi: ${err.message || "Banner saxlanÄ±lmadÄ±"}`);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (banner: PromoBanner) => {
    setEditingId(banner.id);
    setForm({
      badge_text: banner.badge_text,
      title: banner.title,
      description: banner.description,
      button_text: banner.button_text,
      button_link: banner.button_link,
      image_url: banner.image_url,
      bg_color: banner.bg_color,
      is_active: banner.is_active,
      sort_order: banner.sort_order,
    });
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Bu banneri silmÉ™k istÉ™diyinizÉ™ É™minsiniz?")) return;
    const prev = banners;
    setBanners((current) => current.filter((b) => b.id !== id));
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/promo-banners", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) setBanners(prev);
    } catch {
      setBanners(prev);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (banner: PromoBanner) => {
    const nextActive = !banner.is_active;
    setBanners((prev) => prev.map((b) => (b.id === banner.id ? { ...b, is_active: nextActive } : b)));
    try {
      await fetch("/api/admin/promo-banners", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: banner.id, is_active: nextActive }),
      });
    } catch {
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">TanÄ±tÄ±m BannerlÉ™ri</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Æsas sÉ™hifÉ™dÉ™ gÃ¶stÉ™rilÉ™cÉ™k tanÄ±tÄ±m bannerlÉ™rini idarÉ™ edin
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { resetForm(); setShowForm(true); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors"
        >
          <Plus size={16} />
          Yeni Banner
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Form */}
      {showForm && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm space-y-5">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-800">
            {editingId ? "Banneri RedaktÉ™ Et" : "Yeni Banner ÆlavÉ™ Et"}
          </h3>

          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Etiket (Badge)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500"
                  placeholder="MÉ™s: SKIN SERÄ°YASI"
                  value={form.badge_text}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, badge_text: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">BaÅŸlÄ±q</label>

// â”€â”€â”€ Reusable MultiLang Textarea â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function MultiLangContent({
  icon,
  title,
  values,
  onChange,
  rows = 6,
  placeholder,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  values: Record<LangKey, string>;
  onChange: (lang: LangKey, value: string) => void;
  rows?: number;
  placeholder?: string;
}) {
  const [activeLang, setActiveLang] = useState<LangKey>("az");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Label */}
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
        {icon}
        {title}
      </label>

      {/* Language Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-1">
        {LANGS.map((lang) => (
          <button
            key={lang.key}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveLang(lang.key)}
            className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
              activeLang === lang.key
                ? "bg-white shadow-sm text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200"
                : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"
            }`}
          >
            <span>{lang.flag}</span>
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">{lang.key.toUpperCase()}</span>
            {values[lang.key]?.trim() && (
              <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 flex-shrink-0" />
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Textarea */}
      <textarea
        key={activeLang}
        rows={rows}
        className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:bg-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500 transition-colors"
        value={values[activeLang]}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(activeLang, e.target.value)}
        placeholder={
          placeholder ??
          `${title} â€” ${LANGS.find((l) => l.key === activeLang)?.label} dilindÉ™...`
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_SETTINGS: AdminSettings = {
  logoName: "", logoUrl: "", siteName: "", primaryColor: "", brandName: "",
  footerPhone: "", footerEmail: "", footerAddress: "",
  aboutContentAz: "", aboutContentEn: "", aboutContentRu: "", aboutContentTr: "",
  faqContentAz: "", faqContentEn: "", faqContentRu: "", faqContentTr: "",
  shippingContentAz: "", shippingContentEn: "", shippingContentRu: "", shippingContentTr: "",
  returnsContentAz: "", returnsContentEn: "", returnsContentRu: "", returnsContentTr: "",
  privacyContentAz: "", privacyContentEn: "", privacyContentRu: "", privacyContentTr: "",
  termsContentAz: "", termsContentEn: "", termsContentRu: "", termsContentTr: "",
  socialFacebook: "", socialInstagram: "", socialTwitter: "", socialYoutube: "",
  socialTiktok: "", socialLinkedin: "", socialTelegram: "", socialWhatsapp: "",

function dataToSettings(data: Record<string, unknown>): AdminSettings {
  const brand =
    (data.footer_brand_name as string) ||
    (data.public_site_name as string) ||
    (data.site_name as string) || "";
  const rawLogo = typeof data.logo === "string" ? data.logo : "";
  let displayLogoName = rawLogo;
  if (rawLogo.startsWith("http")) {
    const parts = rawLogo.split("/");
    displayLogoName = parts[parts.length - 1] || rawLogo;
  }
  if (rawLogo.startsWith("data:")) displayLogoName = "Logo";

  const s = (key: string) =>
    typeof data[key] === "string" ? (data[key] as string) : "";

  return {
    logoName: displayLogoName,
    logoUrl: rawLogo,
    siteName: s("site_name"),
    primaryColor: s("primary_color") || "#4f46e5",
    brandName: brand,
    footerPhone: s("footer_phone"),
    footerEmail: s("footer_email"),
    footerAddress: s("footer_address"),
    aboutContentAz: s("about_content_az") || s("about_content"),
    aboutContentEn: s("about_content_en"),
    aboutContentRu: s("about_content_ru"),
    aboutContentTr: s("about_content_tr"),
    faqContentAz: s("faq_content_az") || s("faq_content"),
    faqContentEn: s("faq_content_en"),
    faqContentRu: s("faq_content_ru"),
    faqContentTr: s("faq_content_tr"),
    shippingContentAz: s("shipping_content_az") || s("shipping_content"),
    shippingContentEn: s("shipping_content_en"),
    shippingContentRu: s("shipping_content_ru"),
    shippingContentTr: s("shipping_content_tr"),
    returnsContentAz: s("returns_content_az") || s("returns_content"),
    returnsContentEn: s("returns_content_en"),
    returnsContentRu: s("returns_content_ru"),
    returnsContentTr: s("returns_content_tr"),
    privacyContentAz: s("privacy_content_az") || s("privacy_content"),
    privacyContentEn: s("privacy_content_en"),
    privacyContentRu: s("privacy_content_ru"),
    privacyContentTr: s("privacy_content_tr"),
    termsContentAz: s("terms_content_az"),
    termsContentEn: s("terms_content_en"),
    termsContentRu: s("terms_content_ru"),
    termsContentTr: s("terms_content_tr"),
    socialFacebook: s("social_facebook"),
    socialInstagram: s("social_instagram"),
    socialTwitter: s("social_twitter"),
    socialYoutube: s("social_youtube"),
    socialTiktok: s("social_tiktok"),
    socialLinkedin: s("social_linkedin"),
    socialTelegram: s("social_telegram"),
    socialWhatsapp: s("social_whatsapp"),
  };
}

    footerAddress: settings.footerAddress,
    aboutContentAz: settings.aboutContentAz,
    aboutContentEn: settings.aboutContentEn,
    aboutContentRu: settings.aboutContentRu,
    aboutContentTr: settings.aboutContentTr,
    faqContentAz: settings.faqContentAz,
    faqContentEn: settings.faqContentEn,
    faqContentRu: settings.faqContentRu,
    faqContentTr: settings.faqContentTr,
    shippingContentAz: settings.shippingContentAz,
    shippingContentEn: settings.shippingContentEn,
    shippingContentRu: settings.shippingContentRu,
    shippingContentTr: settings.shippingContentTr,
    returnsContentAz: settings.returnsContentAz,

export default function AdminSettingsPage() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<AdminSettings>(EMPTY_SETTINGS);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingLogo, setUploadingLogo] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);
    fetch("/api/admin/settings")
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => { if (active) setSettings(dataToSettings(data)); })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, []);

  // Generic scalar field handler
  const handleChange =
    (field: keyof AdminSettings) =>
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement> | string) => {
      const val = typeof e === "string" ? e : e.target.value;
      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: val }));
    };

  // Multilang handler factory
  const mlHandler =
    (prefix: string) => (lang: LangKey, value: string) =>
      setSettings((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [`${prefix}${lang.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lang.slice(1)}`]: value,
      }));

  // Build values object for MultiLangContent
  const mlValues = (prefix: string): Record<LangKey, string> => ({
    az: (settings as Record<string, string>)[`${prefix}Az`] ?? "",
    en: (settings as Record<string, string>)[`${prefix}En`] ?? "",
    ru: (settings as Record<string, string>)[`${prefix}Ru`] ?? "",
    tr: (settings as Record<string, string>)[`${prefix}Tr`] ?? "",
  });

  const saveSettings = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/settings", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(settingsToPayload(settings)),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setSettings(dataToSettings(data));
        alert("MÉ™lumatlar uÄŸurla yenilÉ™ndi!");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json();
        alert(`XÉ™ta: ${err.error || "BilinmÉ™yÉ™n xÉ™ta"}`);
      }
    } catch {
      alert("XÉ™ta: ServerlÉ™ É™laqÉ™ qurmaq mÃ¼mkÃ¼n olmadÄ±.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const primaryColor =
    settings.primaryColor?.startsWith("#") ? settings.primaryColor : "#4f46e5";

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24">
        <RefreshCw className="animate-spin text-slate-400" size={24} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pb-12">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div>

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

  Image as ImageIcon,

  Save,

  Loader2,
