const LOCALES = [
  { value: "az", label: "AzÉ™rbaycan" },
  { value: "en", label: "English" },
  { value: "tr", label: "TÃ¼rkÃ§e" },
  { value: "ru", label: "Ð ÑƒÑÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹" },
] as const;

type LocaleContent = {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  button_text: string;
  button_link: string;
};

type SlideGroup = {
  sort_order: number;
  image_url: string;
  image_position: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  locales: Record<string, { id?: number; title: string; subtitle: string; button_text: string; button_link: string }>;
};

const emptyLocale = (): LocaleContent => ({
  title: "",
  subtitle: "",
  button_text: "MÉ™hsullara keÃ§ â†’",
  button_link: "/products",
});

export default function AdminSlidesPage() {
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<SlideGroup[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [editingSortOrder, setEditingSortOrder] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<(typeof LOCALES)[number]["value"]>("az");

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    image_url: "",
    image_position: "center center",
    is_active: true,
    sort_order: 0,
    translations: {
      az: emptyLocale(),
      en: emptyLocale(),
      tr: emptyLocale(),
      ru: emptyLocale(),
    } as Record<string, LocaleContent>,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSlides();
  }, []);

  const fetchSlides = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/slides?grouped=1");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setGroups(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch slides:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setForm({
      image_url: "",
      image_position: "center center",
      is_active: true,
      sort_order: groups.length,
      translations: {
        az: emptyLocale(),
        en: emptyLocale(),
        tr: emptyLocale(),
        ru: emptyLocale(),
      },
    });
    setEditingSortOrder(null);
    setActiveTab("az");
  };

  const handleEdit = (group: SlideGroup) => {
    setEditingSortOrder(group.sort_order);
    const translations: Record<string, LocaleContent> = {};
    for (const l of LOCALES) {
      const loc = group.locales[l.value];
      translations[l.value] = loc
        ? {
            title: loc.title ?? "",
            subtitle: loc.subtitle ?? "",
            button_text: loc.button_text ?? "",
            button_link: loc.button_link ?? "/products",
          }
        : emptyLocale();
    }
    setForm({
      image_url: group.image_url || "",
      image_position: group.image_position || "center center",
      is_active: group.is_active ?? true,
      sort_order: group.sort_order,
      translations,
    });
    setActiveTab("az");
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (editingSortOrder !== null) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/slides", {
          method: "PUT",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            group: true,
            sort_order: editingSortOrder,
            image_url: form.image_url,
            image_position: form.image_position,
            is_active: form.is_active,
            translations: form.translations,
          }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json();
          throw new Error(err.error || "YenilÉ™nmÉ™di");
        }
      } else {
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/slides", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            group: true,
            sort_order: form.sort_order,
            image_url: form.image_url,
            image_position: form.image_position,
            is_active: form.is_active,
            translations: form.translations,
          }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json();
          throw new Error(err.error || "ÆlavÉ™ olunmadÄ±");
        }
      }
      await fetchSlides();
      resetForm();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("XÉ™ta: " + (err.message || "BilinmÉ™yÉ™n xÉ™ta"));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (sortOrder: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Bu slaydÄ± (bÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™ri ilÉ™) silmÉ™k istÉ™diyinizÉ™ É™minsiniz?")) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/slides", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ sort_order: sortOrder }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchSlides();
        if (editingSortOrder === sortOrder) resetForm();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json();
        alert("XÉ™ta: " + (err.error || "SilinmÉ™di"));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Delete error:", err);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (group: SlideGroup) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/slides", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          group: true,
          sort_order: group.sort_order,
          is_active: !group.is_active,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) await fetchSlides();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Toggle error:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop();
      const fileName = `hero-slide-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
        .from("content")

    }
  };

  const updateTranslation = (locale: string, field: keyof LocaleContent, value: string) => {

      ...f,
      translations: {
        ...f.translations,
        [locale]: { ...f.translations[locale], [field]: value },
      },
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-600">
            <Layers size={20} />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Seksiyalar</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 sm:text-3xl">Hero Seksiyalar</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 max-w-2xl">
            Bir slayd Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n bÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™rdÉ™ (az, en, tr, ru) mÉ™tnlÉ™ri bir formda daxil edin. Æsas sÉ™hifÉ™ cari dilÉ™ gÃ¶rÉ™ uyÄŸun mÉ™tni gÃ¶stÉ™rir.

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {editingSortOrder !== null ? "SlaydÄ± redaktÉ™ et" : "Yeni slayd É™lavÉ™ et"}
              </h2>
              {editingSortOrder !== null && (
                <button onClick={resetForm} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">

                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* ÅžÉ™kil (Ã¼mumi) */}

export default function AdminSocialMediaPage() {

  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<SocialProfile[]>([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [profilePlatform, setProfilePlatform] = useState<"instagram" | "tiktok" | "facebook">("instagram");
  const [profileAccountId, setProfileAccountId] = useState("");
  const [profileToken, setProfileToken] = useState("");
  const [savingProfile, setSavingProfile] = useState(false);

  const [videoImageUrl, setVideoImageUrl] = useState("");

  const [selectedProfileIds, setSelectedProfileIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [creatingVideo, setCreatingVideo] = useState(false);
  const [generatingId, setGeneratingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [profRes, vidRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/admin/social/profiles"),
        fetch("/api/admin/social/videos"),
      ]);
      if (profRes.ok) {
        const data = await profRes.json();
        setProfiles(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      }
      if (vidRes.ok) {
        const data = await vidRes.json();
        setVideos(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const addProfile = async () => {
    const name = profileName.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    setSavingProfile(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/social/profiles", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          platform: profilePlatform,
          name,
          accountId: profileAccountId.trim() || null,
          accessToken: profileToken.trim() || null,
          isActive: true,
        }),
      });

        setProfileAccountId("");
        setProfileToken("");

      }

      alert(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "XÉ™ta");

  };

        setFetchError(null);

        setDbPrograms(data);
      }

    }
  };

    (user.phone || "").includes(searchTerm)

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const rawAddress = meta.shipping_address as Record<string, unknown> | null;

  const fullName =
    rawAddress && typeof rawAddress.fullName === "string"
      ? rawAddress.fullName
      : "";
  const phone =
    rawAddress && typeof rawAddress.phone === "string"
      ? rawAddress.phone
      : "";
  const city =
    rawAddress && typeof rawAddress.city === "string" ? rawAddress.city : "";
  const line1 =
    rawAddress && typeof rawAddress.line1 === "string"
      ? rawAddress.line1
      : "";
  const notes =
    rawAddress && typeof rawAddress.notes === "string"
      ? rawAddress.notes
      : "";

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      fullName,
      phone,
      city,
      line1,
      notes,
    },
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();

  const fullName =
    typeof body.fullName === "string"
      ? body.fullName.trim().slice(0, 200)
      : "";
  const phone =
    typeof body.phone === "string" ? body.phone.trim().slice(0, 30) : "";
  const city =
    typeof body.city === "string" ? body.city.trim().slice(0, 100) : "";
  const line1 =
    typeof body.line1 === "string" ? body.line1.trim().slice(0, 300) : "";
  const notes =
    typeof body.notes === "string" ? body.notes.trim().slice(0, 300) : "";

  const address = { fullName, phone, city, line1, notes };

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
    data: {
      shipping_address: address,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(address, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .select("id, status, total, currency, created_at")
    .eq("user_id", user.id)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(20);

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const mapped = (data || []).map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    status: row.status,
    total: row.total,
    currency: row.currency,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  }));

  return NextResponse.json(mapped, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

type PaymentMethod = {
  id: string;
  brand: string;
  last4: string;
  expiryMonth: string;
  expiryYear: string;
  isDefault?: boolean;
};

function sanitizeMethods(value: unknown): PaymentMethod[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const items: PaymentMethod[] = [];
  for (const item of value) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    const raw = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    const idRaw = raw.id;
    const brandRaw = raw.brand;
    const last4Raw = raw.last4;
    const monthRaw = raw.expiryMonth;
    const yearRaw = raw.expiryYear;
    const id =
      typeof idRaw === "string" && idRaw.trim()
        ? idRaw.trim().slice(0, 64)
        : "";
    const brand =
      typeof brandRaw === "string" && brandRaw.trim()
        ? brandRaw.trim().slice(0, 30)
        : "";
    const last4 =
      typeof last4Raw === "string" && last4Raw.trim()
        ? last4Raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-4)
        : "";
    const expiryMonth =
      typeof monthRaw === "string" && monthRaw.trim()
        ? monthRaw.trim().slice(0, 2)
        : "";
    const expiryYear =
      typeof yearRaw === "string" && yearRaw.trim()
        ? yearRaw.trim().slice(0, 4)
        : "";
    if (!id || !last4 || !expiryMonth || !expiryYear) continue;
    const isDefault = Boolean(raw.isDefault);
    items.push({
      id,
      brand,
      last4,
      expiryMonth,
      expiryYear,
      isDefault,
    });
  }
  return items;
}

function generateId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto) {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
}

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const raw = meta.payment_methods;
  const items = sanitizeMethods(raw);

  return NextResponse.json({ items }, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();

  const brandRaw = typeof body.brand === "string" ? body.brand : "";
  const last4Raw = typeof body.last4 === "string" ? body.last4 : "";
  const monthRaw =
    typeof body.expiryMonth === "string" ? body.expiryMonth : "";
  const yearRaw = typeof body.expiryYear === "string" ? body.expiryYear : "";
  const isDefault = Boolean(body.isDefault);

  const brand = brandRaw.trim().slice(0, 30);
  const last4 = last4Raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-4);
  const expiryMonth = monthRaw.trim().slice(0, 2);
  const expiryYear = yearRaw.trim().slice(0, 4);

  if (!last4 || last4.length !== 4) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Son 4 rÉ™qÉ™m dÃ¼zgÃ¼n deyil" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  if (!expiryMonth || !expiryYear) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "BitmÉ™ tarixi dÃ¼zgÃ¼n deyil" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const existing = sanitizeMethods(meta.payment_methods);

  const id = generateId();

  const next: PaymentMethod[] = existing.map((m) => ({
    ...m,
    isDefault: isDefault ? false : m.isDefault,
  }));

  next.push({
    id,
    brand,
    last4,
    expiryMonth,
    expiryYear,
    isDefault: isDefault || existing.length === 0,
  });

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
    data: {
      payment_methods: next,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ items: next }, { status: 200 });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const idRaw = body.id;
  const id =
    typeof idRaw === "string" && idRaw.trim() ? idRaw.trim().slice(0, 64) : "";

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Kart tapÄ±lmadÄ±" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const existing = sanitizeMethods(meta.payment_methods);

  const index = existing.findIndex((m) => m.id === id);
  if (index === -1) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Kart tapÄ±lmadÄ±" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const brandRaw = typeof body.brand === "string" ? body.brand : "";
  const last4Raw = typeof body.last4 === "string" ? body.last4 : "";
  const monthRaw =
    typeof body.expiryMonth === "string" ? body.expiryMonth : "";
  const yearRaw = typeof body.expiryYear === "string" ? body.expiryYear : "";
  const isDefault =
    typeof body.isDefault === "boolean" ? body.isDefault : existing[index].isDefault;

  const brand = brandRaw.trim().slice(0, 30);
  const last4 = last4Raw ? last4Raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-4) : existing[index].last4;
  const expiryMonth = monthRaw.trim() || existing[index].expiryMonth;
  const expiryYear = yearRaw.trim() || existing[index].expiryYear;

  if (!last4 || last4.length !== 4) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Son 4 rÉ™qÉ™m dÃ¼zgÃ¼n deyil" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  if (!expiryMonth || !expiryYear) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "BitmÉ™ tarixi dÃ¼zgÃ¼n deyil" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const next: PaymentMethod[] = existing.map((m) => ({ ...m }));

  next[index] = {
    ...next[index],
    brand: brand || next[index].brand,
    last4,
    expiryMonth,
    expiryYear,
  };

  if (isDefault) {
    for (const m of next) {
      m.isDefault = m.id === id;
    }
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
    data: {
      payment_methods: next,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ items: next }, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const fullNameRaw = typeof body.fullName === "string" ? body.fullName : "";
  const fullName = fullNameRaw.trim().slice(0, 200);
  const phoneRaw = typeof body.phone === "string" ? body.phone : "";
  const phone = phoneRaw.trim().slice(0, 30);
  const avatarUrlRaw = typeof body.avatarUrl === "string" ? body.avatarUrl : "";
  const avatarUrl = avatarUrlRaw.trim().slice(0, 500);
  const coverUrlRaw = typeof body.coverUrl === "string" ? body.coverUrl : "";
  const coverUrl = coverUrlRaw.trim().slice(0, 500);

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .upsert(
      {
        id: user.id,
        full_name: fullName || null,
        phone: phone || null,
        avatar_url: avatarUrl || null,
        cover_url: coverUrl || null,
      },
      { onConflict: "id" }
    )
    .select("full_name, phone, avatar_url, cover_url")
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  if (fullName || phone) {
    await supabase.auth.updateUser({
      data: {
        ...(fullName ? { full_name: fullName } : {}),
        ...(phone ? { phone } : {}),
      },
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      fullName: data?.full_name ?? "",
      phone: data?.phone ?? "",
      avatarUrl: data?.avatar_url ?? "",
      coverUrl: data?.cover_url ?? "",
    },
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

FILE: src\app\api\account\programs\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { programs } from "@/modules/programs/config";

type ProgramProgress = {
  [slug: string]: {
    startedAt?: string;
    completedTasks?: string[];
    finishedAt?: string;
  };
};

function calculateTotalPoints(progress: ProgramProgress): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const program of programs) {
    const entry = progress[program.slug];
    if (!entry || !Array.isArray(entry.completedTasks)) continue;
    for (const taskId of entry.completedTasks) {
      const task = program.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
      if (!task) continue;
      total += task.points;
    }
  }
  return total;
}

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Fetch DB programs
  const { data: dbPrograms } = await supabase
    .from("programs")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_active", true);

  const allPrograms = [
    ...programs,
    ...(dbPrograms || []).map((p) => ({
      id: String(p.id),
      slug: p.slug,
      title: p.title,
      description: p.description,
      imageUrl: p.image_url,
      duration: p.duration,
      price: p.price,
      isDbProgram: true,
    })),
  ];

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const rawProgress = meta.program_progress;

  const progress: ProgramProgress =
    rawProgress && typeof rawProgress === "object"
      ? (rawProgress as ProgramProgress)
      : {};

  const totalPoints = calculateTotalPoints(progress);

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      programs: allPrograms,
      progress,
      totalPoints,
    },
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const slug = typeof body.slug === "string" ? body.slug : "";
  const action = typeof body.action === "string" ? body.action : "";
  const taskId = typeof body.taskId === "string" ? body.taskId : "";

  // Check if program exists (either in config or DB)
  const configProgram = programs.find((p) => p.slug === slug);
  let programExists = !!configProgram;
  let dbProgram = null;

  if (!programExists) {
    let query = supabase.from("programs").select("id, slug, title");
    
    // Check if slug looks like a UUID
    const isUUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(slug);
    // Check if slug looks like a numeric ID
    const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(slug);
    
    if (isUUID) {
      query = query.or(`slug.eq.${slug},id.eq.${slug}`);
    } else if (isNumeric) {
      query = query.or(`slug.eq.${slug},id.eq.${slug}`);
    } else {
      query = query.eq("slug", slug);
    }
    
    const { data } = await query.maybeSingle();
    dbProgram = data;
    programExists = !!dbProgram;
  }

  if (!programExists) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Program not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const rawProgress = meta.program_progress;

  const current: ProgramProgress =
    rawProgress && typeof rawProgress === "object"
      ? (rawProgress as ProgramProgress)
      : {};

  const next: ProgramProgress = { ...current };
  // Use the slug from the request as key, but if it's a numeric ID and we found a DB program with a real slug, maybe use that?
  // Consistency is key. AccountDashboard uses "effectiveSlug".
  // If we store it under "17", we must read it as "17".
  const storageKey = slug; 
  const existingEntry = next[storageKey] || {};

  if (action === "start") {
    next[storageKey] = {
      ...existingEntry,
      startedAt:
        existingEntry.startedAt || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19) + "Z",
      completedTasks: Array.isArray(existingEntry.completedTasks)
        ? existingEntry.completedTasks
        : [],
      finishedAt: existingEntry.finishedAt, 
    };
  } else if (action === "finish") {
    next[storageKey] = {
      ...existingEntry,
      finishedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19) + "Z",
    };
  } else if (action === "completeTask") {
    // Only config programs support tasks for now
    if (!configProgram) {
       return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Tasks not supported for this program" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const taskExists = configProgram.tasks.some((t) => t.id === taskId);
    if (!taskExists) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Task not found in program" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const completed = Array.isArray(existingEntry.completedTasks)
      ? existingEntry.completedTasks.slice()
      : [];
    if (!completed.includes(taskId)) {
      completed.push(taskId);
    }
    next[storageKey] = {
      ...existingEntry,
      startedAt:
        existingEntry.startedAt || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19) + "Z",
      completedTasks: completed,
    };
  } else {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid action" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
    data: {
      program_progress: next,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  // Also update profiles table for admin view
  // We don't block response on this, just fire and forget or await if critical
  await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .update({ program_progress: next })
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  const totalPoints = calculateTotalPoints(next);

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      programs,
      progress: next,
      totalPoints,
    },
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

type AccountSettings = {
  emailOrders: boolean;
  emailPromotions: boolean;
  smsNotifications: boolean;
  whatsappNotifications: boolean;
};

function sanitizeSettings(value: unknown): AccountSettings {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
    return {
      emailOrders: true,
      emailPromotions: false,
      smsNotifications: false,
      whatsappNotifications: false,
    };
  }
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    emailOrders: Boolean(raw.emailOrders ?? true),
    emailPromotions: Boolean(raw.emailPromotions ?? false),
    smsNotifications: Boolean(raw.smsNotifications ?? false),
    whatsappNotifications: Boolean(raw.whatsappNotifications ?? false),
  };
}

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const meta =
    (user as { user_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }).user_metadata || {};
  const settings = sanitizeSettings(meta.account_settings);

  return NextResponse.json(settings, { status: 200 });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const next = sanitizeSettings(body);

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
    data: {
      account_settings: next,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(next, { status: 200 });
}

// POST â€“ create a campaign
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const slug = (body.slug || body.title || `campaign-${Date.now()}`)
      .toString()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

    const { data: campaign, error } = await supabase
      .from("campaigns")
      .insert({
        slug,
        campaign_type: body.campaign_type || "discount",
        starts_at: body.starts_at || null,
        ends_at: body.ends_at || null,
        is_active: body.is_active ?? true,
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    if (!campaign) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Campaign create failed" }, { status: 500 });

    // MÉ™hsullarÄ± kampaniyaya É™lavÉ™ et
    if (Array.isArray(body.productIds) && body.productIds.length > 0 && campaign.id) {
      const discountPercent = Number(body.discount_percent) || 0;
      const campaignProducts = body.productIds.map((productId: number) => ({
        campaign_id: campaign.id,
        product_id: productId,
        discount_percent: discountPercent,
      }));

      const { error: cpError } = await supabase
        .from("campaign_products")
        .insert(campaignProducts);

      if (cpError) {
        console.error("Campaign products insert error:", cpError);
        // KampaniyanÄ± sil vÉ™ xÉ™ta qaytar
        await supabase.from("campaigns").delete().eq("id", campaign.id);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "MÉ™hsullar É™lavÉ™ edilmÉ™di: " + cpError.message }, { status: 500 });
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json(campaign, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PUT â€“ update a campaign
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    if (!body.id) return NextResponse.json({ error: "id required" }, { status: 400 });

    const update: Record<string, any> = {};
    if (body.slug !== undefined) update.slug = body.slug;
    if (body.campaign_type !== undefined) update.campaign_type = body.campaign_type;
    if (body.starts_at !== undefined) update.starts_at = body.starts_at || null;
    if (body.ends_at !== undefined) update.ends_at = body.ends_at || null;
    if (body.is_active !== undefined) update.is_active = body.is_active;

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("campaigns")
      .update(update)
      .eq("id", body.id)
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    if (!data) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Campaign not found" }, { status: 404 });

    // MÉ™hsullarÄ± yenilÉ™
    if (Array.isArray(body.productIds)) {
      // KÃ¶hnÉ™ mÉ™hsullarÄ± sil
      await supabase.from("campaign_products").delete().eq("campaign_id", body.id);

      // Yeni mÉ™hsullarÄ± É™lavÉ™ et
      if (body.productIds.length > 0) {
        const discountPercent = Number(body.discount_percent) || 0;
        const campaignProducts = body.productIds.map((productId: number) => ({
          campaign_id: body.id,
          product_id: productId,
          discount_percent: discountPercent,
        }));

        const { error: cpError } = await supabase
          .from("campaign_products")
          .insert(campaignProducts);

        if (cpError) {
          console.error("Campaign products update error:", cpError);
          return NextResponse.json({ error: "MÉ™hsullar yenilÉ™nmÉ™di: " + cpError.message }, { status: 500 });
        }
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });

    const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);

    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "categories";
const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).select("*").order("id");
  if (error) {
    console.error("Categories GET error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([], { status: 200 });

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, language, value")
    .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
    .eq("field", "name")
    .in("entity_id", ids);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, string>>();
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; language: string; value: string }) => {
    if (!byId.has(t.entity_id)) byId.set(t.entity_id, {});
    byId.get(t.entity_id)![t.language] = t.value ?? "";
  });

  const result = list.map((cat: { id: number; name: string; slug: string; icon: string | null }) => {
    const tr = byId.get(cat.id) || {};
    return {
      ...cat,
      translations: {
        az: cat.name ?? "",
        en: tr.en ?? "",
        tr: tr.tr ?? "",
        ru: tr.ru ?? "",
      },
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    
    // Admin authentication
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const name =
      typeof body.name === "string" && body.name.trim() ? body.name.trim() : "";
    if (!name) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "name is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    
    // Slug - É™gÉ™r admin tÉ™rÉ™findÉ™n verilibsÉ™ istifadÉ™ et, yoxsa ad É™sasÄ±nda yarat
    let slug = (typeof body.slug === "string" && body.slug.trim() && body.slug !== "null" && body.slug !== "undefined")
      ? body.slug.trim()
      : name
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim()
          .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
          .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
          .replace(/-+/g, "-")
          .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
    
    // Slug-u tÉ™mizlÉ™ (admin daxil etsÉ™ belÉ™)
    slug = slug
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
      .replace(/-+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
    
    if (!slug) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid category name or slug" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    
    // Slug-un unikal olmasÄ±nÄ± yoxla
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .select("id")
      .eq("slug", slug)
      .maybeSingle();
    
    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Bu ad artÄ±q istifadÉ™ olunur. ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa baÅŸqa ad seÃ§in." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    
    const icon = typeof body.icon === "string" && body.icon.trim() ? body.icon.trim() : null;

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .insert({ name, slug, icon })
      .select("*")
      .single();
      
    if (error) {
      console.error("Category create error:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message || "Category create failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }
    
    if (!data) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Category create failed - no data returned" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
    for (const lang of LOCALES) {
      if (lang === "az") continue;
      const val = translations[lang];
      if (typeof val === "string" && val.trim()) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: data.id, field: "name", language: lang, value: val.trim() },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      }
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Category POST error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Internal server error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const body = await req.json();
    const id = body.id as number | undefined;
    if (!id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (typeof body.name === "string" && body.name.trim()) patch.name = body.name.trim();
    if (typeof body.slug === "string" && body.slug.trim()) {
      const slug = body.slug
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
        .replace(/-+/g, "-")
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
      if (slug) patch.slug = slug;
    }
    if (typeof body.icon === "string") patch.icon = body.icon.trim() || null;
    if (Object.keys(patch).length > 0) {
      const { data: updated, error: updError } = await supabase
        .from(TABLE)
        .update(patch)
        .eq("id", id)
        .select("*")
        .single();
      if (updError) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: updError.message }, { status: 500 });
      }
      if (!updated) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Category not found" }, { status: 404 });
      }
    }
    const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
    for (const lang of LOCALES) {
      if (lang === "az") continue;
      const val = translations[lang];
      if (typeof val === "string") {
        const value = val.trim();
        if (value) {
          await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
            { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: id, field: "name", language: lang, value },
            { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
          );
        } else {
          await supabase
            .from("translations")
            .delete()
            .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
            .eq("entity_id", id)
            .eq("field", "name")
            .eq("language", lang);
        }
      }
    }
    const { data: final } = await supabase.from(TABLE).select("*").eq("id", id).single();
    return NextResponse.json(final ?? {}, { status: 200 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Category PATCH error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Internal server error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    
    // Admin authentication
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const id = body.id as number | undefined;

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const TABLE = "contacts";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const mapped =
    data?.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      createdAt:
        typeof row.created_at === "string" ? row.created_at : String(row.created_at ?? ""),
      name: row.name ?? "",
      email: row.email ?? "",
      subject: row.subject ?? "",
      message: row.message ?? "",
      status: row.status ?? "Yeni",
      adminNotes: row.admin_notes ?? "",
    })) ?? [];
  return NextResponse.json(mapped, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const name =
    typeof body.name === "string" && body.name.trim() ? body.name.trim() : "";
  const email =
    typeof body.email === "string" && body.email.trim() ? body.email.trim() : "";
  const subject =
    typeof body.subject === "string" && body.subject.trim()
      ? body.subject.trim()
      : "";
  const message =
    typeof body.message === "string" && body.message.trim()
      ? body.message.trim()
      : "";

  if (!name || !email || !message) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "name, email and message are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).insert({
    name,
    email,
    subject,
    message,
    status: "Yeni",
    admin_notes: "",
  });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Contact create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const id = body.id as string | number | undefined;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (typeof body.status === "string") {
    patch.status = body.status;
  }
  if (typeof body.adminNotes === "string") {
    patch.admin_notes = body.adminNotes;

  if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "nothing to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).update(patch).eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(

    );

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const TABLE = "content_ads";
const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const TITLE_FIELD = "title";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([], { status: 200 });

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, language, value")
    .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .eq("field", TITLE_FIELD)
    .in("language", [...LOCALES]);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, string>>();
  list.forEach((r: { id: number }) => {
    byId.set(r.id, { az: "", en: "", tr: "", ru: "" });
  });
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; language: string; value: string }) => {
    const loc = byId.get(t.entity_id);
    if (loc && t.language in loc) loc[t.language] = t.value ?? "";
  });

  const result = list.map((ad: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const id = ad.id as number;
    const loc = byId.get(id) ?? {};
    return {
      ...ad,
      translations: {
        az: (ad.title as string) ?? "",
        en: loc.en ?? "",
        tr: loc.tr ?? "",
        ru: loc.ru ?? "",
      },
      title_font_size: ad.title_font_size ?? "",
      title_font_weight: ad.title_font_weight ?? "",
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const azTitle = (translations.az ?? body.title ?? "").trim();
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title: azTitle || (body.title || ""),
    image_url: body.imageUrl ?? body.image_url ?? "",
    link_url: body.linkUrl ?? body.link_url ?? "",
    is_active: body.isActive ?? true,
    title_font_size: typeof body.title_font_size === "string" ? body.title_font_size.trim() : "",
    title_font_weight: typeof body.title_font_weight === "string" ? body.title_font_weight.trim() : "",
  };
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .insert(payload)
    .select("*")
    .single();
  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "Ad create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  const insertedId = (data as { id: number }).id;
  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const val = translations[lang];
    if (typeof val === "string" && val.trim()) {
      await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
        { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: insertedId, field: TITLE_FIELD, language: lang, value: val.trim() },
        { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
      );
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const id = body.id as string | undefined;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (typeof body.title === "string") patch.title = body.title;
  else if (typeof translations.az === "string" && translations.az.trim()) patch.title = translations.az.trim();
  if (typeof body.imageUrl === "string") patch.image_url = body.imageUrl;
  if (typeof body.linkUrl === "string") patch.link_url = body.linkUrl;
  if (typeof body.isActive === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.isActive;
  if (typeof body.title_font_size === "string") patch.title_font_size = body.title_font_size;
  if (typeof body.title_font_weight === "string") patch.title_font_weight = body.title_font_weight;
  if (Object.keys(patch).length > 0) {
    const { error: updError } = await supabase.from(TABLE).update(patch).eq("id", id);
    if (updError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: updError.message || "Ad update failed" }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }
  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const val = translations[lang];
    if (typeof val === "string") {
      const value = val.trim();
      if (value) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: Number(id), field: TITLE_FIELD, language: lang, value },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      } else {
        await supabase
          .from("translations")
          .delete()
          .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
          .eq("entity_id", Number(id))
          .eq("field", TITLE_FIELD)
          .eq("language", lang);
      }
    }
  }
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).select("*").eq("id", id).single();
  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error?.message || "Ad fetch failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 200 });
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const id = body.id as string | undefined;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  await supabase.from("translations").delete().eq("entity_table", TABLE).eq("entity_id", Number(id));
  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Ad delete failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "content_posts";
const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const FIELDS = ["title", "excerpt", "body", "category"] as const;

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("is_pinned", { ascending: false })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([], { status: 200 });

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, language, value")
    .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", FIELDS);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, Record<string, string>>>();

    byId.set(r.id, { az: {}, en: {}, tr: {}, ru: {} });

  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; field: string; language: string; value: string }) => {

  });

    return {
      ...post,

        az: {
          title: post.title ?? "",
          excerpt: post.excerpt ?? "",
          body: post.body ?? "",
          category: post.category ?? "",
        },
        en: loc.en ?? {},
        tr: loc.tr ?? {},
        ru: loc.ru ?? {},
      },
    };

}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

    // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
    const az = translations.az || {};
    const title = (typeof az.title === "string" ? az.title : body.title) || "";
    if (!title.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Title is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Auto-generate slug from title
    const slug =
      title
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/É™/g, "e")
        .replace(/ÅŸ/g, "s")
        .replace(/Ã¶/g, "o")
        .replace(/Ã¼/g, "u")
        .replace(/Ä±/g, "i")
        .replace(/Ã§/g, "c")
        .replace(/ÄŸ/g, "g")
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, "") + "-" + Date.now();

    const fontStr = (v: unknown) => (typeof v === "string" ? v.trim() : "");
    let payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      title: title.trim(),
      excerpt: typeof az.excerpt === "string" ? az.excerpt : body.excerpt || "",
      body: typeof az.body === "string" ? az.body : body.body || "",
      slug,
      is_pinned: body.isPinned ?? false,
      image_url: body.imageUrl || body.image_url || "",
      category: typeof az.category === "string" ? az.category : body.category || "",
      title_font_size: fontStr(body.title_font_size),
      title_font_weight: fontStr(body.title_font_weight),
      excerpt_font_size: fontStr(body.excerpt_font_size),
      excerpt_font_weight: fontStr(body.excerpt_font_weight),
      body_font_size: fontStr(body.body_font_size),
      body_font_weight: fontStr(body.body_font_weight),
    };
    const optionalFields: { key: string; value: unknown }[] = [
      { key: "excerpt", value: payload.excerpt },
      { key: "body", value: payload.body },
      { key: "slug", value: payload.slug },
      { key: "is_pinned", value: payload.is_pinned },
      { key: "image_url", value: payload.image_url },
      { key: "category", value: payload.category },
      { key: "title_font_size", value: payload.title_font_size },
      { key: "title_font_weight", value: payload.title_font_weight },
      { key: "excerpt_font_size", value: payload.excerpt_font_size },
      { key: "excerpt_font_weight", value: payload.excerpt_font_weight },
      { key: "body_font_size", value: payload.body_font_size },
      { key: "body_font_weight", value: payload.body_font_weight },
    ];

    // Ä°lk cÉ™hd - bÃ¼tÃ¼n sÃ¼tunlarla
    for (const field of optionalFields) {
      payload[field.key] = field.value;
    }

    let { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .insert(payload)
      .select("*")
      .single();

    // ÆgÉ™r hÉ™r hansÄ± bir sÃ¼tun yoxdursa, onu tapÄ±b Ã§Ä±xar vÉ™ yenidÉ™n cÉ™hd et
    // Bu proses bir neÃ§É™ dÉ™fÉ™ tÉ™krarlana bilÉ™r (bir neÃ§É™ sÃ¼tun yoxdursa)
    let maxRetries = 5;
    while (error && error.message.includes("Could not find") && maxRetries > 0) {
      const missingColumnMatch = error.message.match(/Could not find the '(\w+)' column/);
      if (missingColumnMatch) {
        const missingColumn = missingColumnMatch[1];
        console.warn(`Column '${missingColumn}' not found, retrying without it`);
        delete payload[missingColumn];
        
        const retryResult = await supabase
          .from(TABLE)
          .insert(payload)
          .select("*")
          .single();
        data = retryResult.data;
        error = retryResult.error;
        maxRetries--;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    if (error) {
      console.error("Post create error:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message || "Post create failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    if (!data) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Post create failed: No data returned" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const insertedId = (data as { id: number }).id;
    for (const lang of LOCALES) {
      if (lang === "az") continue;
      const loc = translations[lang];
      if (loc && typeof loc === "object") {
        for (const field of FIELDS) {
          const val = loc[field];
          if (typeof val === "string" && val.trim()) {
            await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
              { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: insertedId, field, language: lang, value: val.trim() },
              { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("POST /api/admin/content/posts error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Internal server error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

const FIELDS = ["title", "description"] as const;

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function buildTranslationsMap(rows: { id: number }[], trans: { entity_id: number; field: string; language: string; value: string }[] | null) {
  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, Record<string, string>>>();
  rows.forEach((r) => {
    byId.set(r.id, { az: {}, en: {}, tr: {}, ru: {} });
  });
  (trans || []).forEach((t) => {
    const loc = byId.get(t.entity_id);
    if (loc && t.language in loc && FIELDS.includes(t.field as typeof FIELDS[number])) {
      loc[t.language][t.field] = t.value ?? "";
    }
  });
  return byId;
}

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([]);

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, language, value")
    .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", FIELDS);
  const byId = buildTranslationsMap(list, trans);

  const result = list.map((p: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const id = p.id as number;
    const loc = byId.get(id) ?? {};
    return {
      ...p,
      translations: {
        az: { title: p.title ?? "", description: p.description ?? "" },
        en: loc.en ?? {},
        tr: loc.tr ?? {},
        ru: loc.ru ?? {},
      },
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const body = await request.json();
  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const az = translations.az ?? {};
  const titleStr = (typeof az.title === "string" ? az.title : body.title)?.trim() || "program";
  const slug = `${titleStr.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F]+/gi, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")}-${Date.now()}`;

  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title: titleStr,
    slug,
    description: typeof az.description === "string" ? az.description : (body.description ?? ""),
    image_url: body.imageUrl ?? body.image_url ?? "",
    duration: body.duration ?? "",
    price: body.price != null ? Number(body.price) : 0,
    is_active: body.isActive !== undefined ? body.isActive : true,
    title_font_size: typeof body.title_font_size === "string" ? body.title_font_size : "",
    title_font_weight: typeof body.title_font_weight === "string" ? body.title_font_weight : "",
    description_font_size: typeof body.description_font_size === "string" ? body.description_font_size : "",
    description_font_weight: typeof body.description_font_weight === "string" ? body.description_font_weight : "",
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).insert(payload).select().single();
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  const insertedId = (data as { id: number }).id;

  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const loc = translations[lang];
    if (loc && typeof loc === "object") {
      for (const field of FIELDS) {
        const val = loc[field];
        if (typeof val === "string" && val.trim()) {
          await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
            { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: insertedId, field, language: lang, value: val.trim() },
            { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const body = await request.json();
  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });

  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const az = translations.az ?? {};
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (typeof az.title === "string" && az.title.trim()) patch.title = az.title.trim();
  else if (typeof body.title === "string" && body.title.trim()) patch.title = body.title.trim();
  if (typeof az.description === "string") patch.description = az.description;
  else if (typeof body.description === "string") patch.description = body.description;
  if (typeof body.imageUrl === "string") patch.image_url = body.imageUrl;
  if (typeof body.duration === "string") patch.duration = body.duration;
  if (body.price != null) patch.price = Number(body.price);
  if (typeof body.isActive === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.isActive;
  if (typeof body.title_font_size === "string") patch.title_font_size = body.title_font_size;
  if (typeof body.title_font_weight === "string") patch.title_font_weight = body.title_font_weight;
  if (typeof body.description_font_size === "string") patch.description_font_size = body.description_font_size;
  if (typeof body.description_font_weight === "string") patch.description_font_weight = body.description_font_weight;

  if (Object.keys(patch).length > 0) {
    const { error: updError } = await supabase.from(TABLE).update(patch).eq("id", id);
    if (updError) return NextResponse.json({ error: updError.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const loc = translations[lang];
    if (loc && typeof loc === "object") {
      for (const field of FIELDS) {
        const val = loc[field];
        if (typeof val === "string") {
          const value = val.trim();
          if (value) {
            await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
              { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: Number(id), field, language: lang, value },
              { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
            );
          } else {
            await supabase
              .from("translations")
              .delete()
              .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
              .eq("entity_id", Number(id))
              .eq("field", field)
              .eq("language", lang);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).select("*").eq("id", id).single();
  if (error || !data) return NextResponse.json({ error: error?.message || "Fetch failed" }, { status: 500 });
  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
  const body = await request.json();
  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  await supabase.from("translations").delete().eq("entity_table", TABLE).eq("entity_id", Number(id));
  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    if (!body.code) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Kupon kodu tÉ™lÉ™b olunur" }, { status: 400 });

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("coupons")
      .insert({
        code: body.code.toUpperCase().trim(),
        coupon_type: body.coupon_type || "percentage",
        value: Number(body.value) || 0,
        min_order_amount: Number(body.min_order_amount) || 0,
        max_discount_amount: body.max_discount_amount ? Number(body.max_discount_amount) : null,
        usage_limit: body.usage_limit ? Number(body.usage_limit) : null,
        starts_at: body.starts_at || null,
        ends_at: body.ends_at || null,
        is_active: body.is_active ?? true,
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

    const update: Record<string, any> = {};

    if (body.coupon_type !== undefined) update.coupon_type = body.coupon_type;

    if (body.max_discount_amount !== undefined) update.max_discount_amount = body.max_discount_amount ? Number(body.max_discount_amount) : null;
    if (body.usage_limit !== undefined) update.usage_limit = body.usage_limit ? Number(body.usage_limit) : null;
    if (body.starts_at !== undefined) update.starts_at = body.starts_at || null;
    if (body.ends_at !== undefined) update.ends_at = body.ends_at || null;

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Supabase Management API vasitÉ™silÉ™ email template-lÉ™rini idarÉ™ edir.
 * 
 * TÉ™lÉ™b olunan env variables:
 * - NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL      (project ref buradan Ã§Ä±xarÄ±lÄ±r)
 * - SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN         (Management API Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Personal Access Token)
 * 
 * QEYD: Management API (api.supabase.com) service_role key qÉ™bul ETMÄ°R.
 * Personal Access Token lazÄ±mdÄ±r:
 *   Supabase Dashboard â†’ Account (sol alt) â†’ Access Tokens â†’ Generate New Token
 */

function getProjectRef(): string | null {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!url) return null;
  // https://<ref>.supabase.co  â†’  <ref>
  const match = url.match(/https:\/\/([^.]+)\.supabase/);
  return match ? match[1] : null;
}

function getAccessToken(): string | null {
  return process.env.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN || null;
}

// Template type-lar
const TEMPLATE_TYPES = [
  "confirmation",
  "invite",
  "magic_link",
  "email_change",
  "recovery",
  "reauthentication",
] as const;

type TemplateType = (typeof TEMPLATE_TYPES)[number];

type TemplateData = {
  subject: string;
  content: string;
};

type AllTemplates = Record<TemplateType, TemplateData>;

// Supabase Management API-dÉ™n auth config oxumaq
async function fetchAuthConfig(projectRef: string, accessToken: string) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/${projectRef}/config/auth`,
    {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
    }
  );

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Supabase Management API xÉ™tasÄ± (${res.status}): ${errorText}`);
  }

  return res.json();
}

// Supabase Management API-yÉ™ auth config yazmaq
async function updateAuthConfig(
  projectRef: string,
  accessToken: string,
  payload: Record<string, string>
) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/${projectRef}/config/auth`,
    {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }
  );

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Supabase Management API xÉ™tasÄ± (${res.status}): ${errorText}`);
  }

  return res.json();
}

// Auth config-dan template mÉ™lumatlarÄ±nÄ± Ã§Ä±xarmaq
function extractTemplates(config: Record<string, unknown>): AllTemplates {
  const templates: Partial<AllTemplates> = {};

  for (const type of TEMPLATE_TYPES) {
    const subjectKey = `MAILER_SUBJECTS_${type.toUpperCase()}`;
    const contentKey = `MAILER_TEMPLATES_${type.toUpperCase()}_CONTENT`;

    templates[type] = {
      subject: (config[subjectKey] as string) || "",
      content: (config[contentKey] as string) || "",
    };
  }

  return templates as AllTemplates;
}

// GET: BÃ¼tÃ¼n email template-lÉ™ri gÉ™tir
export async function GET() {
  // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: authCheck.error },
      { status: authCheck.status }
    );
  }

  const projectRef = getProjectRef();
  const accessToken = getAccessToken();

  if (!projectRef || !accessToken) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          "Supabase konfiqurasiyasÄ± natamamdÄ±r. NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL vÉ™ SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN lazÄ±mdÄ±r. Access Token-i Supabase Dashboard â†’ Account â†’ Access Tokens bÃ¶lmÉ™sindÉ™n yarada bilÉ™rsiniz.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const config = await fetchAuthConfig(projectRef, accessToken);
    const templates = extractTemplates(config);
    return NextResponse.json({ templates }, { status: 200 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "BilinmÉ™yÉ™n xÉ™ta";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: authCheck.error },

    );
  }

  const projectRef = getProjectRef();
  const accessToken = getAccessToken();

  if (!projectRef || !accessToken) {
    return NextResponse.json(

        error:
          "Supabase konfiqurasiyasÄ± natamamdÄ±r. NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL vÉ™ SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN lazÄ±mdÄ±r.",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { templates } = body as { templates: Partial<AllTemplates> };

    if (!templates) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Templates mÉ™lumatÄ± tÉ™lÉ™b olunur" },
        { status: 400 }
      );

    // Supabase Management API formatÄ±na Ã§evir

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const TABLE = "faqs";
const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([], { status: 200 });

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, language, value")
    .eq("entity_table", TABLE)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", ["question", "answer"]);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, { question: string; answer: string }>>();
  list.forEach((r: { id: number }) => {
    byId.set(r.id, { az: { question: "", answer: "" }, en: { question: "", answer: "" }, tr: { question: "", answer: "" }, ru: { question: "", answer: "" } });
  });
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; field: string; language: string; value: string }) => {
    const loc = byId.get(t.entity_id);
    if (loc && t.language in loc) {
      if (t.field === "question") loc[t.language].question = t.value ?? "";
      if (t.field === "answer") loc[t.language].answer = t.value ?? "";
    }
  });

  const result = list.map((faq: { id: number; question: string; answer: string; sort_order: number; is_active: boolean; created_at: string; updated_at: string }) => {
    const loc = byId.get(faq.id) ?? {};
    return {
      ...faq,
      translations: {
        az: { question: faq.question, answer: faq.answer },
        en: loc.en ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
        tr: loc.tr ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
        ru: loc.ru ?? { question: "", answer: "" },
      },
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const az = translations.az || {};
  const question = (typeof az.question === "string" ? az.question : body.question) || "";
  const answer = (typeof az.answer === "string" ? az.answer : body.answer) || "";
  const payload = {
    question: question.trim() || "",
    answer: answer.trim() || "",
    sort_order: body.sort_order ?? 0,
    is_active: body.is_active ?? true,
  };
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .insert(payload)
    .select("*")
    .single();
  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "FAQ create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const loc = translations[lang];
    if (loc && typeof loc === "object") {
      const q = typeof loc.question === "string" ? loc.question.trim() : "";
      const a = typeof loc.answer === "string" ? loc.answer.trim() : "";
      if (q) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: data.id, field: "question", language: lang, value: q },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      }
      if (a) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: data.id, field: "answer", language: lang, value: a },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const translations = body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object" ? body.translations : {};
  const az = translations.az || {};
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const questionAz = typeof az.question === "string" ? az.question : body.question;
  const answerAz = typeof az.answer === "string" ? az.answer : body.answer;
  if (typeof questionAz === "string") patch.question = questionAz.trim();
  if (typeof answerAz === "string") patch.answer = answerAz.trim();
  if (typeof body.sort_order === "number") patch.sort_order = body.sort_order;
  if (typeof body.is_active === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.is_active;
  patch.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();

  if (Object.keys(patch).length > 0) {
    const { error: updError } = await supabase.from(TABLE).update(patch).eq("id", id);
    if (updError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: updError.message || "FAQ update failed" }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }
  for (const lang of LOCALES) {
    if (lang === "az") continue;
    const loc = translations[lang];
    if (loc && typeof loc === "object") {
      const q = typeof loc.question === "string" ? loc.question.trim() : "";
      const a = typeof loc.answer === "string" ? loc.answer.trim() : "";
      if (q) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: id, field: "question", language: lang, value: q },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      } else {
        await supabase.from("translations").delete().eq("entity_table", TABLE).eq("entity_id", id).eq("field", "question").eq("language", lang);
      }
      if (a) {
        await supabase.from("translations").upsert(
          { entity_table: TABLE, entity_id: id, field: "answer", language: lang, value: a },
          { onConflict: "entity_table,entity_id,field,language" }
        );
      } else {
        await supabase.from("translations").delete().eq("entity_table", TABLE).eq("entity_id", id).eq("field", "answer").eq("language", lang);
      }
    }
  }
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).select("*").eq("id", id).single();
  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error?.message || "FAQ fetch failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 200 });
}

}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\orders\route.ts
