import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseAdminClient, getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

type OrderRow = {
  id: number;
  user_id: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  total: number | null;
  currency: string | null;
  created_at: string | null;
};

type ProfileRow = {
  id: string;
  full_name: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
};

type OrderItemRow = {
  order_id: number;
  product_id: number | null;
  quantity: number | null;
  unit_price: number | null;
  total: number | null;
};

type ProductRow = {
  id: number;
  slug: string | null;
};

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const adminClient = getSupabaseAdminClient();

  const { data: orders, error: ordersError } = await adminClient
    .from("orders")
    .select("id, user_id, status, total, currency, created_at")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(100);

  if (ordersError) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: ordersError.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const orderRows = (orders ?? []) as OrderRow[];
  if (!orderRows.length) {
    return NextResponse.json([]);
  }

  const userIds = Array.from(new Set(orderRows.map((o) => o.user_id).filter(Boolean))) as string[];
  const orderIds = orderRows.map((o) => o.id);

  const [profilesResult, itemsResult] = await Promise.all([
    userIds.length
      ? adminClient
          .from("profiles")
          .select("id, full_name, phone")
          .in("id", userIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
    adminClient
      .from("order_items")
      .select("order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total")
      .in("order_id", orderIds),
  ]);

  if (profilesResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: profilesResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (itemsResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: itemsResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const profiles = (profilesResult.data ?? []) as ProfileRow[];
  const items = (itemsResult.data ?? []) as OrderItemRow[];
  const productIds = Array.from(
    new Set(items.map((item) => item.product_id).filter((id): id is number => typeof id === "number"))
  );

  const [productsResult, translationsResult] = await Promise.all([
    productIds.length
      ? adminClient.from("products").select("id, slug").in("id", productIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
    productIds.length
      ? adminClient
          .from("translations")
          .select("entity_id, language, field, value")
          .eq("entity_table", "products")
          .eq("field", "name")
          .in("entity_id", productIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
  ]);

  if (productsResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: productsResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (translationsResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: translationsResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const profileById = new Map<string, ProfileRow>(profiles.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const productById = new Map<number, ProductRow>(
    ((productsResult.data ?? []) as ProductRow[]).map((p) => [p.id, p])
  );
  const productTranslations = new Map<number, Array<{ language?: string; value?: string }>>();
  ((translationsResult.data ?? []) as Array<{ entity_id: number; language?: string; value?: string }>).forEach((t) => {
    const list = productTranslations.get(t.entity_id) ?? [];
    list.push({ language: t.language, value: t.value });
    productTranslations.set(t.entity_id, list);
  });

  const itemsByOrderId = new Map<number, OrderItemRow[]>();
  for (const item of items) {
    const list = itemsByOrderId.get(item.order_id) ?? [];
    list.push(item);
    itemsByOrderId.set(item.order_id, list);
  }

  const response = orderRows.map((order) => {
    const profile = order.user_id ? profileById.get(order.user_id) : undefined;
    const orderItems = itemsByOrderId.get(order.id) ?? [];
    return {
      id: order.id,
      created_at: order.created_at,
      status: order.status ?? "pending",
      total: Number(order.total ?? 0),
      currency: order.currency ?? "AZN",
      customer: {
        id: order.user_id,
        full_name: profile?.full_name ?? null,
        phone: profile?.phone ?? null,
      },
      items: orderItems.map((item) => {
        const product = item.product_id ? productById.get(item.product_id) : undefined;
        const names = item.product_id ? productTranslations.get(item.product_id) ?? [] : [];
        const nameAz = names.find((t) => t.language === "az")?.value;
        const nameAny = names.find((t) => !!t.value)?.value;
        return {
          product_name: nameAz || nameAny || product?.slug || (item.product_id ? `MÉ™hsul #${item.product_id}` : "MÉ™hsul"),
          quantity: Number(item.quantity ?? 0),
          unit_price: Number(item.unit_price ?? 0),
          total: Number(item.total ?? 0),
        };
      }),
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json(response);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseAdminClient, getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const ALLOWED_STATUSES = new Set([
  "pending",
  "paid",
  "shipped",
  "completed",
  "cancelled",
  "failed",
  "refunded",
]);

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const { params } = context;
  const { id: rawId } = await params;
  const id = rawId?.trim();
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid order id" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  const nextStatus = typeof body?.status === "string" ? body.status : "";
  if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.has(nextStatus)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid status" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const adminClient = getSupabaseAdminClient();
  const { data, error } = await adminClient
    .from("orders")
    .update({ status: nextStatus })
    .eq("id", id)
    .select("id, status")
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

export async function DELETE(
  _req: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const { params } = context;
  const { id: rawId } = await params;
  const id = rawId?.trim();
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid order id" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const adminClient = getSupabaseAdminClient();

  // Delete children first for schemas without ON DELETE CASCADE.
  const { error: itemsError } = await adminClient
    .from("order_items")
    .delete()
    .eq("order_id", id);
  if (itemsError) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: itemsError.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const { error: orderError } = await adminClient
    .from("orders")
    .delete()
    .eq("id", id);
  if (orderError) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: orderError.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// PUT - Update popup settings
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const fullName = typeof body.fullName === "string" ? body.fullName.trim() : "AD SOYAD";
  const title = typeof body.title === "string" ? body.title.trim() : "MÃ¼stÉ™qil Herbalife TÉ™rÉ™fdaÅŸÄ±";
  const description = typeof body.description === "string" ? body.description.trim() : "Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i ÅŸirkÉ™tin rÉ™smi saytÄ± deyil, mÃ¼stÉ™qil tÉ™rÉ™fdaÅŸÄ±n sÉ™hifÉ™sindÉ™dir.";

  // Try to update first
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("id")
    .eq("id", 1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (existing) {
    // Update existing
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update({
        full_name: fullName,
        title,
        description,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", 1)
      .select("*")
      .single();

    return NextResponse.json({
      fullName:    data.full_name,
      title:       data.title,
      description: data.description,
      updatedAt:   data.updated_at,
    }, { status: 200 });

    // Insert new
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .insert({
        id: 1,
        full_name: fullName,
        title,
        description,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),

      })
      .select("*")
      .single();

      console.error("Popup settings create error:", error);

FILE: src\app\api\admin\products\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  // 1. Fetch products (without joins to avoid relationship errors)
  const { data: products, error: productsError } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .order("id");

  if (productsError) {
    console.error("Fetch products error:", productsError);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: productsError.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const productIds = (products || []).map(p => p.id);
  let images: any[] = [];
  let translations: any[] = [];
  let productCategories: any[] = [];
  
  if (productIds.length > 0) {
    // 2. Fetch images separately
    const { data: imgs, error: imgError } = await supabase
      .from("product_images")
      .select("*")
      .in("product_id", productIds)
      .order("position");
      
    if (imgError) {
      console.error("Fetch images error:", imgError);
      // We don't fail, just show no images
    } else {
      images = imgs || [];
    }

    // 3. Fetch translations separately
    const { data: trans, error: transError } = await supabase
      .from("translations")
      .select("*")
      .eq("entity_table", "products")
      .in("entity_id", productIds);

    if (transError) {
      console.error("Translations fetch error:", transError);
    } else {
      translations = trans || [];
    }

    // 4. Fetch product categories
    const { data: pc, error: pcError } = await supabase
      .from("product_categories")
      .select("product_id, category_id")
      .in("product_id", productIds);

    if (pcError) {
      console.error("Product categories fetch error:", pcError);
    } else {
      productCategories = pc || [];
    }
  }

  // 5. Merge data
  const result = (products || []).map(p => {
    const categoryIds = productCategories
      .filter(pc => pc.product_id === p.id)
      .map(pc => pc.category_id);
    
    return {
      ...p,
      product_images: images.filter(img => img.product_id === p.id),
      translations: translations.filter(t => t.entity_id === p.id),
      categoryIds: categoryIds.length > 0 ? categoryIds : (p.category_id ? [p.category_id] : [])
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Explicit admin check
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  // Admin formundan gÉ™lÉ™n qiymÉ™tlÉ™ri dÃ¼zgÃ¼n xÉ™ritÉ™lÉ™yÉ™k:
  // - originalPrice: endirimdÉ™n É™vvÉ™lki É™sas qiymÉ™t
  // - price: endirimdÉ™n sonrakÄ± real satÄ±ÅŸ qiymÉ™ti
  // DB-dÉ™ isÉ™ base_price + discount_percent saxlanÄ±lÄ±r
  const originalPriceInput = Number(body.originalPrice);
  const currentPriceInput = Number(body.price);

  const basePrice =
    !Number.isNaN(originalPriceInput) && originalPriceInput > 0
      ? originalPriceInput
      : !Number.isNaN(currentPriceInput) && currentPriceInput > 0
      ? currentPriceInput
      : 0;

  const finalPrice =
    !Number.isNaN(currentPriceInput) && currentPriceInput > 0
      ? currentPriceInput
      : basePrice;
  
  // Calculate discount safely to avoid numeric overflow
  // Postgres numeric(5,2) max value is 999.99
  let discountPercent = 0;
  if (basePrice > finalPrice && basePrice > 0) {
    discountPercent = ((basePrice - finalPrice) / basePrice) * 100;
  }
  
  // Clamp discount percent to valid range for numeric(5,2)
  if (discountPercent > 999.99) discountPercent = 999.99;
  if (discountPercent < -999.99) discountPercent = -999.99;

  // Adminin yazdÄ±ÄŸÄ± slug-u istifadÉ™ et, yoxdursa name-dÉ™n generasiya et
  let slug = "";
  if (typeof body.slug === "string" && body.slug.trim()) {
    slug = body.slug.trim();
  } else {
    const slugSource =
      typeof body.name === "string" && body.name.trim()
        ? body.name.trim()
        : "product";
    slug = slugSource
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
      .replace(/-+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
  }

  // Slug-un unikal olmasÄ±nÄ± yoxla (yalnÄ±z yeni mÉ™hsul Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
  if (slug) {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("id")
      .eq("slug", slug)
      .maybeSingle();
    
    if (existing) {
      // ÆgÉ™r slug artÄ±q istifadÉ™ olunursa, xÉ™ta ver
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Bu slug artÄ±q istifadÉ™ olunur. ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa baÅŸqa slug seÃ§in." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
  }

  const insertPayload = {
    slug,
    base_price: basePrice,
    discount_percent: discountPercent,
    stock: Number(body.stock) || 0,
    points: Number(body.points) || 0,
    is_active: true,
    weight_goal_tag: "neutral" as const,
    image_url: body.imageUrl || null,
    usage_count: typeof body.usageCount === "string" ? body.usageCount.trim() : "",
    badge_color: typeof body.badgeColor === "string" && body.badgeColor.startsWith("#") ? body.badgeColor : "#16a34a",
    category_id:
      Array.isArray(body.categoryIds) && body.categoryIds.length > 0
        ? Number(body.categoryIds[0])
        : null,
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .insert(insertPayload)
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    console.error("Product create error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "Product create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  // Save multiple categories to product_categories table
  if (Array.isArray(body.categoryIds) && body.categoryIds.length > 0 && data.id) {
    const categoryInserts = body.categoryIds.map((catId: number) => ({
      product_id: data.id,
      category_id: Number(catId),
    }));

    const { error: pcError } = await supabase
      .from("product_categories")
      .insert(categoryInserts);

    if (pcError) {
      console.error("Product categories insert error:", pcError);
      // Don't fail the request, but log the error
    }
  }

  // Insert gallery images
  if (Array.isArray(body.galleryImages) && body.galleryImages.length > 0) {
    const galleryRows = body.galleryImages.map((url: string, index: number) => ({
      product_id: data.id,
      url,
      position: index,
    }));
    
    const { error: galleryError } = await supabase
      .from("product_images")
      .insert(galleryRows);

    if (galleryError) {
      console.error("Gallery upload error:", galleryError);
      // We don't fail the whole request if gallery fails, but we log it
    }
  }

  const translations = body.translations;

  if (translations && typeof translations === "object") {
    type TranslationRow = {
      entity_table: string;
      entity_id: number;
      field: "title" | "description";
      language: string;
      value: string;
    };
    const rows: TranslationRow[] = [];
    Object.entries(translations).forEach(([locale, value]) => {
      const v = value as { title?: string; description?: string };
      if (v.title) {
        rows.push({
          entity_table: "products",
          entity_id: data.id,
          field: "title",
          language: locale,
          value: v.title,
        });
      }
      if (v.description) {
        rows.push({
          entity_table: "products",
          entity_id: data.id,
          field: "description",
          language: locale,
          value: v.description,
        });
      }
    });

    if (rows.length > 0) {
      const { error: textsError } = await supabase
        .from("translations")
        .insert(rows);
      if (textsError) {
        console.error("Translations create error:", textsError);
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: textsError.message || "Product translations create failed" },
          { status: 500 }
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Explicit admin check
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  if (!body.id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product ID is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Eyni mÉ™ntiqi update zamanÄ± da tÉ™tbiq edirik
  const originalPriceInput = Number(body.originalPrice);
  const currentPriceInput = Number(body.price);

  const basePrice =
    !Number.isNaN(originalPriceInput) && originalPriceInput > 0
      ? originalPriceInput
      : !Number.isNaN(currentPriceInput) && currentPriceInput > 0
      ? currentPriceInput
      : 0;

  const finalPrice =
    !Number.isNaN(currentPriceInput) && currentPriceInput > 0
      ? currentPriceInput
      : basePrice;

  let discountPercent = 0;
  if (basePrice > finalPrice && basePrice > 0) {
    discountPercent = ((basePrice - finalPrice) / basePrice) * 100;
  }

  if (discountPercent > 999.99) discountPercent = 999.99;
  if (discountPercent < -999.99) discountPercent = -999.99;

  // Adminin yazdÄ±ÄŸÄ± slug-u istifadÉ™ et
  let slug = "";
  if (typeof body.slug === "string" && body.slug.trim()) {
    slug = body.slug.trim();
  } else {
    // ÆgÉ™r slug gÃ¶ndÉ™rilmÉ™yibsÉ™, mÃ¶vcud slug-u saxla
    const { data: currentProduct } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("slug")
      .eq("id", body.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    slug = currentProduct?.slug || "";
  }

  // Slug-un unikal olmasÄ±nÄ± yoxla (yalnÄ±z baÅŸqa mÉ™hsullar Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
  if (slug) {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("id")
      .eq("slug", slug)
      .neq("id", body.id) // Ã–zÃ¼ istisna olmaqla
      .maybeSingle();
    
    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Bu slug artÄ±q istifadÉ™ olunur. ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa baÅŸqa slug seÃ§in." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
  }

  const updatePayload: any = {
    base_price: basePrice,
    discount_percent: discountPercent,
    stock: Number(body.stock) || 0,
    points: Number(body.points) || 0,
    usage_count: typeof body.usageCount === "string" ? body.usageCount.trim() : "",
    badge_color: typeof body.badgeColor === "string" && body.badgeColor.startsWith("#") ? body.badgeColor : "#16a34a",
    category_id:
      Array.isArray(body.categoryIds) && body.categoryIds.length > 0
        ? Number(body.categoryIds[0])
        : null,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // Slug-u update et
  if (slug) {
    updatePayload.slug = slug;
  }
  
  if (body.imageUrl) {
    updatePayload.image_url = body.imageUrl;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .update(updatePayload)
    .eq("id", body.id)
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    console.error("Product update error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "Product update failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  // Update product categories
  // Strategy: Delete all existing categories for this product and re-insert new ones
  if (Array.isArray(body.categoryIds)) {
    // 1. Delete existing categories
    await supabase.from("product_categories").delete().eq("product_id", body.id);

    // 2. Insert new categories
    if (body.categoryIds.length > 0) {
      const categoryInserts = body.categoryIds.map((catId: number) => ({
        product_id: body.id,
        category_id: Number(catId),
      }));

      const { error: pcError } = await supabase
        .from("product_categories")
        .insert(categoryInserts);

      if (pcError) {
        console.error("Product categories update error:", pcError);
        // Don't fail the request, but log the error
      }
    }
  }

  // Update gallery images
  // Strategy: Delete all existing images for this product and re-insert new ones
  // This is simpler than diffing.
  if (Array.isArray(body.galleryImages)) {
    // 1. Delete existing
    await supabase.from("product_images").delete().eq("product_id", body.id);

    // 2. Insert new
    if (body.galleryImages.length > 0) {
      const galleryRows = body.galleryImages.map((url: string, index: number) => ({
        product_id: body.id,
        url,
        position: index,
      }));
      
      const { error: galleryError } = await supabase
        .from("product_images")
        .insert(galleryRows);

      if (galleryError) {
        console.error("Gallery update error:", galleryError);
      }
    }
  }

  // Update translations
  // Strategy: Delete all existing translations for this product and re-insert new ones
  const translations = body.translations;

  if (translations && typeof translations === "object") {
    // 1. Delete existing
    await supabase
      .from("translations")
      .delete()
      .eq("entity_table", "products")
      .eq("entity_id", body.id);

    // 2. Insert new
    type TranslationRow = {
      entity_table: string;
      entity_id: number;
      field: "title" | "description";
      language: string;
      value: string;
    };
    const rows: TranslationRow[] = [];
    Object.entries(translations).forEach(([locale, value]) => {
      const v = value as { title?: string; description?: string };
      if (v.title) {
        rows.push({
          entity_table: "products",
          entity_id: body.id,
          field: "title",
          language: locale,
          value: v.title,
        });
      }
      if (v.description) {
        rows.push({
          entity_table: "products",
          entity_id: body.id,
          field: "description",
          language: locale,
          value: v.description,
        });
      }
    });

    if (rows.length > 0) {
      const { error: textsError } = await supabase
        .from("translations")
        .insert(rows);
      if (textsError) {
        console.error("Translations update error:", textsError);
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: textsError.message || "Product translations update failed" },
          { status: 500 }
        );
      }
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 200 });
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  // Explicit admin check
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Delete product (cascade deletes images and translations)
  const { error } = await supabase.from("products").delete().eq("id", id);
  
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Product delete failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {

  if (typeof body.is_active === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.is_active;
  if (typeof body.sort_order === "number") patch.sort_order = body.sort_order;

  if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "DÉ™yiÅŸiklik yoxdur" }, { status: 400 });

      { error: "Banner tapÄ±lmadÄ±" },

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  const pageSlug = searchParams.get("page");

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
          );
        },
      },
    }
  );

  let query = supabase.from("page_sections").select("*");
  if (pageSlug) {
    query = query.eq("page_slug", pageSlug);
  }

  const { data, error } = await query;

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

export async function PUT(request: Request) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
          );
        },
      },
    }
  );

  // Check admin role
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (profile?.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await request.json();
  const { page_slug, section_key, content } = body;

  if (!page_slug || !section_key || !content) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required fields" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("page_sections")
    .upsert(
      { page_slug, section_key, content, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() },
      { onConflict: "page_slug, section_key" }
    )
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  SUPABASE_CONFIGURED,

} from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const TABLE = "site_settings";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", 1)
    .maybeSingle();
    
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  
  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({}, { status: 200 });
  }
  
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 200 });

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  
  // Æsas ayarlar payload-u (hide_prices/hide_points BURDA OLMAMALIDIR â€” ayrÄ±ca handle olunur)
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    id: 1, 
    logo: body.logoName ?? "",
    site_name: body.siteName ?? "",
    primary_color: body.primaryColor ?? "",
    rules: body.rules ?? "",
    public_site_name: body.publicSiteName ?? "",
    footer_brand_name: body.footerBrandName ?? body.publicSiteName ?? "",
    footer_phone: body.footerPhone ?? "",
    footer_email: body.footerEmail ?? "",
    footer_address: body.footerAddress ?? "",
    // About
    about_content_az: body.aboutContentAz ?? "",
    about_content_en: body.aboutContentEn ?? "",
    about_content_ru: body.aboutContentRu ?? "",
    about_content_tr: body.aboutContentTr ?? "",
    // FAQ
    faq_content_az: body.faqContentAz ?? "",
    faq_content_en: body.faqContentEn ?? "",
    faq_content_ru: body.faqContentRu ?? "",
    faq_content_tr: body.faqContentTr ?? "",
    // Shipping
    shipping_content_az: body.shippingContentAz ?? "",
    shipping_content_en: body.shippingContentEn ?? "",
    shipping_content_ru: body.shippingContentRu ?? "",
    shipping_content_tr: body.shippingContentTr ?? "",
    // Returns
    returns_content_az: body.returnsContentAz ?? "",
    returns_content_en: body.returnsContentEn ?? "",
    returns_content_ru: body.returnsContentRu ?? "",
    returns_content_tr: body.returnsContentTr ?? "",
    // Privacy
    privacy_content_az: body.privacyContentAz ?? "",
    privacy_content_en: body.privacyContentEn ?? "",
    privacy_content_ru: body.privacyContentRu ?? "",
    privacy_content_tr: body.privacyContentTr ?? "",
    // Terms
    terms_content_az: body.termsContentAz ?? "",
    terms_content_en: body.termsContentEn ?? "",
    terms_content_ru: body.termsContentRu ?? "",
    terms_content_tr: body.termsContentTr ?? "",
    social_facebook: body.socialFacebook ?? "",
    social_instagram: body.socialInstagram ?? "",
    social_twitter: body.socialTwitter ?? "",
    social_youtube: body.socialYoutube ?? "",
    social_tiktok: body.socialTiktok ?? "",
    social_linkedin: body.socialLinkedin ?? "",
    social_telegram: body.socialTelegram ?? "",
    social_whatsapp: body.socialWhatsapp ?? "",
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // YalnÄ±z aÃ§Ä±q-aÅŸkar gÃ¶ndÉ™rildikdÉ™ hide_prices/hide_points É™lavÉ™ et
  if (body.hidePrices !== undefined) {
    payload.hide_prices = !!body.hidePrices;
  }
  if (body.hidePoints !== undefined) {
    payload.hide_points = !!body.hidePoints;
  }

  if (!SUPABASE_CONFIGURED) {
    return NextResponse.json(payload, { status: 200 });
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Explicit admin check
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }
  
  // Upsert with onConflict on 'id'
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .upsert(payload, { onConflict: "id" })
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error) {
    // ÆgÉ™r hide_prices/hide_points sÃ¼tunlarÄ± yoxdursa, onlarÄ± Ã§Ä±xarÄ±b yenidÉ™n cÉ™hd et
    if (error.message && (error.message.includes("hide_prices") || error.message.includes("hide_points"))) {
      delete payload.hide_prices;
      delete payload.hide_points;
      const { data: retryData, error: retryError } = await supabase
        .from(TABLE)
        .upsert(payload, { onConflict: "id" })
        .select("*")
        .single();
      
      if (retryError) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: retryError.message || "Settings create failed" },
          { status: 500 }
        );
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ ...retryData, _visibility_columns_missing: true }, { status: 201 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Settings create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

// PUT is essentially the same as POST for this singleton pattern
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  return POST(req);
}

export async function DELETE() {
  if (!SUPABASE_CONFIGURED) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
  }
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Explicit admin check
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).delete().eq("id", 1);
  
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Settings delete failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("site_settings")
      .select("hide_prices, hide_points")
      .eq("id", 1)
      .maybeSingle();
    
    if (error) {
      // SÃ¼tunlar yoxdursa default qaytar
      return NextResponse.json({ hide_prices: false, hide_points: false }, { status: 200 });
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json({
      hide_prices: !!(data as any)?.hide_prices,
      hide_points: !!(data as any)?.hide_points,
    }, { status: 200 });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ hide_prices: false, hide_points: false }, { status: 200 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const hidePrices = typeof body.hidePrices === "boolean" ? body.hidePrices : undefined;
  const hidePoints = typeof body.hidePoints === "boolean" ? body.hidePoints : undefined;

  // ÆvvÉ™lcÉ™ sÃ¼tunlarÄ±n mÃ¶vcud olub-olmadÄ±ÄŸÄ±nÄ± yoxla, yoxdursa yarat
  try {
    await supabase.rpc("exec_sql", {
      query: `
        ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hide_prices BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
        ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hide_points BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
      `
    });
  } catch {
    // RPC mÃ¶vcud olmaya bilÉ™r, manual update cÉ™hd edÉ™k
  }

  // Update
  const updatePayload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (hidePrices !== undefined) updatePayload.hide_prices = hidePrices;
  if (hidePoints !== undefined) updatePayload.hide_points = hidePoints;
  updatePayload.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("site_settings")
    .update(updatePayload)
    .eq("id", 1)
    .select("hide_prices, hide_points")
    .single();

  if (error) {
    console.error("Visibility update error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { 
        error: error.message,
        hint: "ZÉ™hmÉ™t olmasa bu SQL-i Supabase-dÉ™ icra edin: ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hide_prices BOOLEAN DEFAULT false; ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS hide_points BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;"
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    hide_prices: !!(data as any)?.hide_prices,
    hide_points: !!(data as any)?.hide_points,
    success: true,
  }, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "hero_slides";
const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

type LocaleRow = {
  id?: number;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  button_text: string;
  button_link: string;
};

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const grouped = searchParams.get("grouped") === "1";

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const rows = data ?? [];

  if (!grouped) {
    return NextResponse.json(rows, { status: 200 });
  }

  // Qrupla: eyni sort_order Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n bÃ¼tÃ¼n locale sÉ™tirlÉ™ri bir obyektdÉ™
  const byOrder = new Map<
    number,
    {
      sort_order: number;
      image_url: string;
      image_position: string;
      is_active: boolean;
      locales: Record<string, { id: number; title: string; subtitle: string; button_text: string; button_link: string }>;
    }
  >();

  for (const row of rows as any[]) {
    const so = row.sort_order ?? 0;
    if (!byOrder.has(so)) {
      byOrder.set(so, {
        sort_order: so,
        image_url: row.image_url ?? "",
        image_position: row.image_position ?? "center center",
        is_active: row.is_active ?? true,
        locales: {},
      });
    }
    const g = byOrder.get(so)!;
    const loc = row.locale && LOCALES.includes(row.locale) ? row.locale : "az";
    g.locales[loc] = {
      id: row.id,
      title: row.title ?? "",
      subtitle: row.subtitle ?? "",
      button_text: row.button_text ?? "",
      button_link: row.button_link ?? "/products",
    };
    if (row.image_url) g.image_url = row.image_url;
    if (row.image_position) g.image_position = row.image_position;
    if (typeof row.is_active === "boolean") g.is_active = row.is_active;
  }

  const groupedList = Array.from(byOrder.entries())
    .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
    .map(([, v]) => v);

  return NextResponse.json(groupedList, { status: 200 });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  // Qruplu yaratma: bÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n bir slayd (eyni ÅŸÉ™kil, eyni sÄ±ra)
  if (body.group && body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object") {
    const sortOrder = typeof body.sort_order === "number" ? body.sort_order : 0;
    const imageUrl = body.image_url || "";
    const imagePosition = body.image_position || "center center";
    const isActive = body.is_active ?? true;

    const inserted: any[] = [];
    for (const loc of LOCALES) {
      const t = body.translations[loc] || {};
      const payload = {
        title: t.title ?? "",
        subtitle: t.subtitle ?? "",
        button_text: t.button_text ?? "",
        button_link: t.button_link ?? "/products",
        image_url: imageUrl,
        image_position: imagePosition,
        is_active: isActive,
        sort_order: sortOrder,
        locale: loc,
      };
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from(TABLE)
        .insert(payload)
        .select("*")
        .single();
      if (error) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: error.message || "Slide create failed" },
          { status: 500 }
        );
      }
      if (data) inserted.push(data);
    }
    return NextResponse.json(inserted, { status: 201 });
  }

  // TÉ™k sÉ™tir (kÃ¶hnÉ™ format)
  const locale = LOCALES.includes(body.locale) ? body.locale : "az";
  const payload = {
    title: body.title || "",
    subtitle: body.subtitle || "",
    button_text: body.button_text || "",
    button_link: body.button_link || "/products",
    image_url: body.image_url || "",
    image_position: body.image_position || "center center",
    is_active: body.is_active ?? true,
    sort_order: body.sort_order ?? 0,
    locale,
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .insert(payload)
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "Slide create failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  // Qruplu yenilÉ™mÉ™: sort_order + translations (hÉ™r dil Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n update/insert)
  if (body.group && body.sort_order !== undefined && body.translations && typeof body.translations === "object") {
    const sortOrder = Number(body.sort_order);
    const imageUrl = body.image_url ?? "";
    const imagePosition = body.image_position ?? "center center";
    const isActive = body.is_active ?? true;

    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .select("id, locale")
      .eq("sort_order", sortOrder);

    const byLocale = (existing || []).reduce((acc: Record<string, any>, r: any) => {
      acc[r.locale] = r;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    for (const loc of LOCALES) {
      const t = body.translations[loc] || {};
      const row = byLocale[loc];
      const payload = {
        title: t.title ?? "",
        subtitle: t.subtitle ?? "",
        button_text: t.button_text ?? "",
        button_link: t.button_link ?? "/products",
        image_url: imageUrl,
        image_position: imagePosition,
        is_active: isActive,
        sort_order: sortOrder,
        locale: loc,
      };
      if (row?.id) {
        await supabase.from(TABLE).update(payload).eq("id", row.id);
      } else {
        await supabase.from(TABLE).insert(payload);
      }
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
  }

  // YalnÄ±z is_active toggle qrupa gÃ¶rÉ™
  if (body.group && body.sort_order !== undefined && typeof body.is_active === "boolean") {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update({ is_active: body.is_active })
      .eq("sort_order", Number(body.sort_order));
    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
  }

  // TÉ™k sÉ™tir yenilÉ™mÉ™ (id ilÉ™)
  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (typeof body.title === "string") patch.title = body.title;
  if (typeof body.subtitle === "string") patch.subtitle = body.subtitle;
  if (typeof body.button_text === "string") patch.button_text = body.button_text;
  if (typeof body.button_link === "string") patch.button_link = body.button_link;
  if (typeof body.image_url === "string") patch.image_url = body.image_url;
  if (typeof body.image_position === "string") patch.image_position = body.image_position;
  if (typeof body.is_active === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.is_active;
  if (typeof body.sort_order === "number") patch.sort_order = body.sort_order;
  if (LOCALES.includes(body.locale)) patch.locale = body.locale;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .update(patch)
    .eq("id", id)
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error || !data) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error?.message || "Slide update failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 200 });
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  // Qrupu sil: eyni sort_order olan bÃ¼tÃ¼n sÉ™tirlÉ™ri sil
  if (body.sort_order !== undefined) {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .delete()
      .eq("sort_order", Number(body.sort_order));
    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error.message || "Slide delete failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
  }

  const id = body.id;
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id or sort_order is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).delete().eq("id", id);
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Slide delete failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true }, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "social_profiles";

export type SocialPlatform = "instagram" | "tiktok" | "facebook";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from(TABLE)
    .select("*")
    .order("platform")
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json(data ?? []);
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const platform = (body.platform as string)?.toLowerCase();
    if (!["instagram", "tiktok", "facebook"].includes(platform)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Platform instagram, tiktok vÉ™ ya facebook olmalÄ±dÄ±r" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const name = String(body.name || "").trim();
    if (!name) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Profil adÄ± tÉ™lÉ™b olunur" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const payload = {
      platform,
      name,
      account_id: body.accountId ?? body.account_id ?? null,
      access_token: body.accessToken ?? body.access_token ?? null,
      refresh_token: body.refreshToken ?? body.refresh_token ?? null,
      token_expires_at: body.tokenExpiresAt ?? body.token_expires_at ?? null,
      is_active: body.isActive !== false,
    };
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .insert(payload)
      .select("*")
      .single();
    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const id = body.id ?? body.profileId;
    if (id == null) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "id tÉ™lÉ™b olunur" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (body.platform !== undefined) patch.platform = body.platform;
    if (body.name !== undefined) patch.name = body.name;
    if (body.accountId !== undefined) patch.account_id = body.accountId;
    if (body.account_id !== undefined) patch.account_id = body.account_id;
    if (body.accessToken !== undefined) patch.access_token = body.accessToken;
    if (body.access_token !== undefined) patch.access_token = body.access_token;
    if (body.refreshToken !== undefined) patch.refresh_token = body.refreshToken;
    if (body.refresh_token !== undefined) patch.refresh_token = body.refresh_token;
    if (body.tokenExpiresAt !== undefined) patch.token_expires_at = body.tokenExpiresAt;
    if (body.token_expires_at !== undefined) patch.token_expires_at = body.token_expires_at;
    if (typeof body.isActive === "boolean") patch.is_active = body.isActive;
    patch.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update(patch)
      .eq("id", id)
      .select("*")
      .single();
    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
    const id = searchParams.get("id") ?? (await req.json().then((b) => b.id).catch(() => null));
    if (id == null) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "id tÉ™lÉ™b olunur" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const { error } = await supabase.from(TABLE).delete().eq("id", id);
    if (error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "social_video_posts";
const PROFILES_TABLE = "social_profiles";

export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const body = await _req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const profileIds = Array.isArray(body.profileIds) ? body.profileIds : [];
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const { data: row, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .select("id, video_url, caption, status, profile_ids")
      .eq("id", id)
      .single();
    if (fetchError || !row) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Video tapÄ±lmadÄ±" }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (row.status !== "pending_approval") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "YalnÄ±z tÉ™sdiq gÃ¶zlÉ™yÉ™n videolar tÉ™sdiqlÉ™nÉ™ bilÉ™r" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const idsToPost = profileIds.length > 0 ? profileIds : (row.profile_ids ?? []);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data: profiles } = await supabase
      .from(PROFILES_TABLE)
      .select("id, platform, name, access_token, is_active")
      .in("id", idsToPost)
      .eq("is_active", true);
    await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update({
        status: "posting",
        profile_ids: idsToPost,
        approved_at: now,
        updated_at: now,
      })
      .eq("id", id);
    const results: { platform: string; name: string; success: boolean; error?: string }[] = [];
    for (const profile of profiles ?? []) {
      const token = profile.access_token;
      let success = false;
      let errMsg = "";
      if (token && row.video_url) {
        try {
          if (profile.platform === "instagram") {
            errMsg = "Instagram API inteqrasiyasÄ± Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Meta Graph API token vÉ™ media endpoint tÉ™lÉ™b olunur.";
          } else if (profile.platform === "tiktok") {
            errMsg = "TikTok API inteqrasiyasÄ± Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n TikTok for Developers token tÉ™lÉ™b olunur.";
          } else if (profile.platform === "facebook") {
            errMsg = "Facebook API inteqrasiyasÄ± Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Graph API token tÉ™lÉ™b olunur.";
          }
        } catch (e) {
          errMsg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
        }
      } else {
        errMsg = !token ? "Profil Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n access token yoxdur" : "Video URL yoxdur";
      }
      results.push({
        platform: profile.platform,
        name: profile.name,
        success,
        error: errMsg || undefined,
      });
    }
    await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update({
        status: "posted",
        posted_at: now,
        updated_at: now,
      })
      .eq("id", id);
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Video tÉ™sdiqlÉ™ndi. Sosial platformalara paylaÅŸÄ±m Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n hÉ™r platformda token vÉ™ API konfiqurasiyasÄ± tÉ™lÉ™b olunur.",
      postResults: results,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient, getSupabaseAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

const TABLE = "social_video_posts";
const VEO_MODEL = "veo-3.1-generate-preview";

async function generateVideoWithVeo(prompt: string, imageUrl: string | null): Promise<{ videoUrl?: string; error?: string }> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY ?? process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    return { error: "GEMINI_API_KEY vÉ™ ya GOOGLE_API_KEY tÉ™yin edilmÉ™yib. Veo 3.1 Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Google AI Studio-dan aÃ§ar alÄ±n." };
  }
  const baseUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta";
  try {
    const startRes = await fetch(
      `${baseUrl}/models/${VEO_MODEL}:generateVideos`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "x-goog-api-key": apiKey },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          prompt,
          ...(imageUrl && { referenceImages: [{ imageUrl }] }),
          aspectRatio: "9:16",
          numberOfVideos: 1,
        }),
      }
    );
    if (!startRes.ok) {
      const errBody = await startRes.text();
      return { error: `Veo API xÉ™tasÄ± (${startRes.status}): ${errBody.slice(0, 300)}` };
    }
    const startData = (await startRes.json()) as { name?: string; done?: boolean; response?: { generatedVideos?: Array<{ video?: { uri?: string } }> } };
    let operation = startData;
    const maxWait = 5 * 60 * 1000;
    const step = 15000;
    const start = Date.now();
    while (!operation.done && operation.name && Date.now() - start < maxWait) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, step));
      const pollRes = await fetch(
        `${baseUrl}/${operation.name}`,
        { headers: { "x-goog-api-key": apiKey } }
      );
      if (!pollRes.ok) break;
      operation = (await pollRes.json()) as typeof operation;
    }
    const response = operation as { response?: { generatedVideos?: Array<{ video?: { uri?: string } }> }; done?: boolean };
    if (!response.done || !response.response?.generatedVideos?.length) {
      return { error: "Video yaradÄ±lmasÄ± tamamlanmadÄ± vÉ™ ya nÉ™ticÉ™ boÅŸdur. Veo 3.1 beta Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Google AI Studio / Vertex AI sÉ™nÉ™dlÉ™rinÉ™ baxÄ±n." };
    }
    const videoUri = response.response.generatedVideos[0].video?.uri;
    if (!videoUri) {
      return { error: "Video URI alÄ±nmadÄ±" };
    }
    return { videoUrl: videoUri };
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    return { error: `Veo xÉ™tasÄ±: ${message}` };
  }
}

export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
    if (authCheck.error) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
    }
    const { data: row, error: fetchError } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .select("id, prompt, image_url, status")
      .eq("id", id)
      .single();
    if (fetchError || !row) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Video tapÄ±lmadÄ±" }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (row.status !== "generating" && row.status !== "draft") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Bu video Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n yalnÄ±z generating/draft statusunda generasiya baÅŸlada bilÉ™rsiniz" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    const result = await generateVideoWithVeo(row.prompt, row.image_url);
    if (result.error) {
      await supabase
        .from(TABLE)
        .update({
          status: "failed",
          error_message: result.error,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("id", id);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 502 });
    }
    let videoUrl = result.videoUrl;
    if (videoUrl && (videoUrl.startsWith("http") || videoUrl.startsWith("gs://"))) {
      const admin = getSupabaseAdminClient();
      const bucket = "content";
      const fileName = `social-videos/${id}.mp4`;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(videoUrl);
        if (res.ok) {
          const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
          const { error: uploadErr } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).upload(fileName, buf, {
            contentType: "video/mp4",
            upsert: true,
          });
          if (!uploadErr) {
            const { data: urlData } = admin.storage.from(bucket).getPublicUrl(fileName);
            videoUrl = urlData.publicUrl;
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // keep original URI if download/upload fails
      }
    }
    const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .update({
        status: "pending_approval",
        video_url: videoUrl ?? undefined,
        error_message: null,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq("id", id);
    if (updateErr) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: updateErr.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, videoUrl });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient, getSupabaseAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { verifyAdmin } from "@/lib/auth-utils";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const userId = searchParams.get("userId");

  if (!userId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing userId" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
  const authCheck = await verifyAdmin(supabase);
  if (authCheck.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.error }, { status: authCheck.status });
  }

  // RLS-i bypass etmÉ™k Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n Admin client istifadÉ™ edirik
  const adminClient = getSupabaseAdminClient();

  const { data: orders, error } = await adminClient
    .from("orders")
    .select(`
      id,
      created_at,
      total,
      status,
      points_earned,
      order_items (
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price
      )
    `)
    .eq("user_id", userId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching user orders:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  // Process translations for product name
  type OrderItemRow = {
    id: number;
    product_id?: number | null;
    quantity: number | null;
    unit_price: number | null;
  };
  type OrderRow = { [key: string]: unknown; total?: number | null; order_items?: OrderItemRow[] | null };

  const orderRows = (orders as OrderRow[]) ?? [];
  const productIds = Array.from(
    new Set(
      orderRows
        .flatMap((order) => order.order_items ?? [])
        .map((item) => item.product_id)
        .filter((id): id is number => typeof id === "number")
    )
  );

  const [productsResult, translationsResult] = await Promise.all([
    productIds.length
      ? adminClient.from("products").select("id, slug, points").in("id", productIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
    productIds.length
      ? adminClient
          .from("translations")
          .select("entity_id, language, field, value")
          .eq("entity_table", "products")
          .eq("field", "name")
          .in("entity_id", productIds)
      : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
  ]);

  if (productsResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: productsResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (translationsResult.error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: translationsResult.error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const productById = new Map<number, { slug?: string | null; points?: number | null }>(
    ((productsResult.data ?? []) as Array<{ id: number; slug?: string | null; points?: number | null }>).map((p) => [
      p.id,
      { slug: p.slug, points: p.points },
    ])
  );
  const productTranslations = new Map<number, Array<{ language?: string; value?: string }>>();
  ((translationsResult.data ?? []) as Array<{ entity_id: number; language?: string; value?: string }>).forEach((t) => {
    const list = productTranslations.get(t.entity_id) ?? [];
    list.push({ language: t.language, value: t.value });
    productTranslations.set(t.entity_id, list);
  });

  const formattedOrders = orderRows.map((order) => ({
    ...order,
    total_amount: Number(order.total ?? 0),
    order_items: (order.order_items ?? []).map((item) => {
      const product = item.product_id ? productById.get(item.product_id) : undefined;
      const names = item.product_id ? productTranslations.get(item.product_id) ?? [] : [];
      const nameAz = names.find((t) => t.language === "az")?.value;
      const nameAny = names.find((t) => !!t.value)?.value;
      
      const productName =
        nameAz || nameAny || product?.slug || (item.product_id ? `MÉ™hsul #${item.product_id}` : "Unknown Product");
      
      return {
        id: item.id,
        quantity: Number(item.quantity ?? 0),
        price: Number(item.unit_price ?? 0),
        productName,
        productPoints: Number(product?.points ?? 0),
      };
    })
  }));

  return NextResponse.json(formattedOrders);
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

const MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;

  if (!apiKey) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { errorKey: "error_not_configured" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  const genderRaw = typeof body.gender === "string" ? body.gender : "male";
  const gender = genderRaw === "female" ? "female" : "male";

  const weightKg = Number(body.weightKg);
  const localeRaw =
    typeof body.locale === "string" ? body.locale.toLowerCase() : "az";
  const locale: "az" | "en" | "ru" | "tr" =
    localeRaw === "en" || localeRaw === "ru" || localeRaw === "tr"
      ? localeRaw
      : "az";

      { errorKey: "error_validation" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  const languageName =
    locale === "en"
      ? "English"
      : locale === "ru"
      ? "Russian"
      : locale === "tr"
      ? "Turkish"
      : "Azerbaijani";

  const genderText =
    locale === "en"
      ? gender === "male"
        ? "male"
        : "female"
      : locale === "ru"

          { role: "user", content: userMessage },

      }),
    });

      return NextResponse.json(
        { errorKey: "error_response_failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[];
    };

    const content = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";

    let parsed: {
      targetWeightKg?: number;
      differenceKg?: number;
      message?: string;
    };

    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(content);
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { errorKey: "error_parse_failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const targetWeightKg =
      typeof parsed.targetWeightKg === "number" && parsed.targetWeightKg > 0
        ? parsed.targetWeightKg
        : null;

    const differenceKg =
      typeof parsed.differenceKg === "number" ? parsed.differenceKg : null;

    const message =
      typeof parsed.message === "string" && parsed.message.trim()
        ? parsed.message.trim()
        : null;

    if (!targetWeightKg || !message) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { errorKey: "error_incomplete" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        targetWeightKg,
        differenceKg,
        message,
      },
      { status: 200 }
    );
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { errorKey: "error_connection" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\auth\check-role\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { normalizeRole } from "@/lib/roles";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
      error: authError,
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (authError || !user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ role: null }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role, is_admin")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (profileError || !profile) {
      return NextResponse.json({ role: "user" }, { status: 200 });
    }

    const normalizedRole = normalizeRole(profile.role);
    const resolvedRole =
      normalizedRole !== "user"
        ? normalizedRole
        : profile.is_admin
          ? "admin"
          : "user";

    return NextResponse.json({ role: resolvedRole }, { status: 200 });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ role: null }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const sessionId = url.searchParams.get("sessionId") || "";
    const mode = url.searchParams.get("mode") || "";

    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

    if (mode === "sessions") {
    // Check for admin role
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();
      
      if (!profile || profile.role !== "admin") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from(TABLE)
        .select("session_id, message, sender_type, created_at")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
      if (error) {
        console.error("Error fetching chat sessions:", error);
        return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
      }
      const bySession: Record<
        string,
        { sessionId: string; lastMessage: string; lastSender: string; lastAt: string }
      > = {};
      for (const row of data || []) {
        const s = String((row as { session_id: unknown }).session_id ?? "");
        if (!s) continue;
        if (!bySession[s]) {
          const m = row as {
            message?: unknown;
            sender_type?: unknown;
            created_at?: unknown;
          };
          bySession[s] = {
            sessionId: s,
            lastMessage: typeof m.message === "string" ? m.message : "",
            lastSender: typeof m.sender_type === "string" ? m.sender_type : "",
            lastAt: String(m.created_at ?? ""),
          };
        }
      }
      return NextResponse.json(Object.values(bySession), { status: 200 });
    }

    if (!sessionId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ messages: [] }, { status: 200 });
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .select("*")
      .eq("session_id", sessionId)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: true });
    
    if (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching chat messages:", error);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json({ messages: data ?? [] }, { status: 200 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Chat GET error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err?.message || "Internal server error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const sessionId =
      typeof body.sessionId === "string" ? body.sessionId.trim() : "";
    const message =
      typeof body.message === "string" ? body.message.trim() : "";
    const locale =
      typeof body.locale === "string" && ["az", "en", "ru", "tr"].includes(body.locale)
        ? body.locale
        : "az"; // Default to Azerbaijani
    
    let sender = "user";
    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

    // Only allow admin sender if authenticated as admin
    if (typeof body.sender === "string" && body.sender === "admin") {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (user) {
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("role")
          .eq("id", user.id)
          .single();
        
        if (profile && profile.role === "admin") {
          sender = "admin";
        }
      }
    }

    if (!sessionId || !message) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "sessionId and message are required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Save user message
    const payload = {
      session_id: sessionId,
      message,
      sender_type: sender,
    };

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from(TABLE)
      .insert(payload)
      .select("*")
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      console.error("Error saving chat message:", error);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: error?.message || "Message send failed" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    // If the sender is user, generate AI response asynchronously
    if (sender === "user") {
    // Don't await - let it run in the background so user gets immediate response
    (async () => {
      try {
        // Fetch conversation history for context
        const { data: history } = await supabase
          .from(TABLE)
          .select("message, sender_type")
          .eq("session_id", sessionId)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
          .limit(20);

        const conversationHistory = (history || []).map((h: any) => ({
          role: h.sender_type === "user" ? "user" : "assistant",
          content: h.message,
        }));

        // Add a small delay for realistic typing effect
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500 + Math.random() * 2000));

        const aiResult = await getAIResponse(message, conversationHistory, locale);

        // If AI needs admin help, send to WhatsApp and notify user
        if (aiResult.needsAdmin) {
          // Get admin phone from settings
          const { data: settings } = await supabase
            .from("site_settings")
            .select("footer_phone")
            .eq("id", 1)
            .maybeSingle();
          
          const adminPhone = settings?.footer_phone || "";
          
          if (adminPhone) {
            // Create WhatsApp link with question
            const cleanPhone = adminPhone.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, "");
            const whatsappMessage = encodeURIComponent(
              `Yeni sual:\n\n"${message}"\n\nSessiya ID: ${sessionId}`
            );
            const whatsappUrl = `https://wa.me/${cleanPhone.replace("+", "")}?text=${whatsappMessage}`;
            
            // Save notification to admin (you can create a notifications table later)
            // For now, we'll just send WhatsApp link
            
            // Save message to user that admin will respond
            await supabase.from(TABLE).insert({
              session_id: sessionId,
              message: "TÉ™ÅŸÉ™kkÃ¼r edirÉ™m sualÄ±nÄ±z Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n! ðŸ˜Š MÃ¼tÉ™xÉ™ssis sizinlÉ™ tezliklÉ™ É™laqÉ™ saxlayacaq. SualÄ±nÄ±z adminÉ™ gÃ¶ndÉ™rildi.",
              sender_type: "admin",
            });
            
            // Log for admin (you can enhance this with a notifications system)
            console.log("Admin notification needed:", { sessionId, message, whatsappUrl });
          } else {
            // No admin phone, just save generic response
            await supabase.from(TABLE).insert({
              session_id: sessionId,
              message: "TÉ™ÅŸÉ™kkÃ¼r edirÉ™m sualÄ±nÄ±z Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n! ðŸ˜Š MÃ¼tÉ™xÉ™ssis sizinlÉ™ tezliklÉ™ É™laqÉ™ saxlayacaq.",
              sender_type: "admin",
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Save AI response
          await supabase.from(TABLE).insert({
            session_id: sessionId,

            sender_type: "admin",

}

FILE: src\app\api\checkout\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { calculateTotals } from "@/modules/orders/pricing";
import { azGateway } from "@/modules/payments/az-gateway";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const body = await req.json();
  const pricing = await calculateTotals({
    lines: body.lines || [],
    couponCode: body.couponCode,
    shippingMethodId: body.shippingMethodId,
    shippingAddress: body.shippingAddress,
    userId: user.id,
  });
  const result = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .insert({
      user_id: user.id,
      status: "pending",
      currency: "AZN",
      subtotal: pricing.subtotal,
      discount_total: pricing.discount,
      shipping_total: pricing.shipping,
      total: pricing.total,
      coupon_id: pricing.couponId,
      shipping_method_id: pricing.shippingMethodId,
      shipping_address: pricing.shippingAddress,
    })
    .select("id")
    .single();
  if (result.error || !result.data) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: result.error?.message || "Order create failed" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const orderId = result.data.id as number;

  const lines = Array.isArray(body.lines) ? body.lines : [];
  if (lines.length > 0) {
    const productIds = lines
      .map((l: { productId?: number }) => l.productId)
      .filter((id: unknown): id is number => typeof id === "number");
    if (productIds.length > 0) {
      const { data: products } = await supabase
        .from("products")
        .select("id, base_price, discount_percent, name")
        .in("id", productIds);
      const itemsPayload =
        products?.flatMap((p) => {
          const productLines = lines.filter(
            (l: { productId?: number }) => l.productId === p.id
          );
          return productLines.map((line: { productId?: number; quantity?: number | string }) => {
            const qty = Number(line.quantity) || 0;
            const base = Number(p.base_price) || 0;
            const discountPercent = Number(p.discount_percent) || 0;
            const unit = base * (1 - discountPercent / 100);
            const total = unit * qty;
            return {
              order_id: orderId,
              product_id: p.id,
              product_name:
                (p as { name?: string }).name && typeof (p as { name?: string }).name === "string"
                  ? (p as { name?: string }).name
                  : `MÉ™hsul #${p.id}`,
              quantity: qty,
              unit_price: unit,
              total,
            };
          });
        }) || [];
      if (itemsPayload.length > 0) {
        await supabase.from("order_items").insert(itemsPayload);
      }
    }
  }

  const payment = await azGateway.createPaymentIntent({
    amount: pricing.total,
    currency: "AZN",
    orderId,
  });
  return NextResponse.json({
    orderId,
    paymentUrl: payment.redirectUrl,
  });
}

FILE: src\app\api\content\faqs\route.ts
