import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const locale = (searchParams.get("locale") || "az") as string;
  const useTranslations = LOCALES.includes(locale as typeof LOCALES[number]) && locale !== "az";

  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from("faqs")
    .select("id, question, answer, sort_order")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (!useTranslations || list.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(list, { status: 200 });
  }

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, value")
    .eq("entity_table", "faqs")
    .eq("language", locale)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", ["question", "answer"]);

  const byId = new Map<number, { question?: string; answer?: string }>();
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; field: string; value: string }) => {
    if (!byId.has(t.entity_id)) byId.set(t.entity_id, {});
    const o = byId.get(t.entity_id)!;
    if (t.field === "question") o.question = t.value ?? "";
    if (t.field === "answer") o.answer = t.value ?? "";
  });

  const result = list.map((faq: { id: number; question: string; answer: string; sort_order: number }) => {
    const tr = byId.get(faq.id);
    return {
      id: faq.id,
      question: tr?.question ?? faq.question,
      answer: tr?.answer ?? faq.answer,
      sort_order: faq.sort_order,
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const FIELDS = ["title", "excerpt", "body", "category"] as const;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const locale = (searchParams.get("locale") || "az") as string;
  const useTranslations = LOCALES.includes(locale as typeof LOCALES[number]) && locale !== "az";

  const { data: rows, error } = await supabase
    .from("content_posts")
    .select("id, title, excerpt, body, category, slug, image_url, is_pinned, created_at, title_font_size, title_font_weight, excerpt_font_size, excerpt_font_weight, body_font_size, body_font_weight")
    .order("is_pinned", { ascending: false })
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (!useTranslations || list.length === 0) return NextResponse.json(list, { status: 200 });

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, value")
    .eq("entity_table", "content_posts")
    .eq("language", locale)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", FIELDS);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, string>>();
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; field: string; value: string }) => {
    if (!byId.has(t.entity_id)) byId.set(t.entity_id, {});
    byId.get(t.entity_id)![t.field] = t.value ?? "";
  });

  const result = list.map((post: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const tr = byId.get(post.id as number) || {};
    return {
      ...post,
      title: tr.title ?? post.title,
      excerpt: tr.excerpt ?? post.excerpt,
      body: tr.body ?? post.body,
      category: tr.category ?? post.category,
    };
  });
  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
}

FILE: src\app\api\content\posts\[slug]\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const FIELDS = ["title", "excerpt", "body", "category"] as const;

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const locale = (request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("locale") || "az") as string;
  const useTranslations = LOCALES.includes(locale as typeof LOCALES[number]) && locale !== "az";

  let post: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;

  const postFields = "id, title, excerpt, body, category, slug, image_url, is_pinned, created_at, title_font_size, title_font_weight, excerpt_font_size, excerpt_font_weight, body_font_size, body_font_weight";
  const { data: bySlug } = await supabase
    .from("content_posts")
    .select(postFields)
    .eq("slug", slug)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (bySlug) post = bySlug as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (!post) {
    const { data: byId } = await supabase
      .from("content_posts")
      .select(postFields)
      .eq("id", slug)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (byId) post = byId as Record<string, unknown>;
  }

  if (!post) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Post not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  if (!useTranslations) {
    return NextResponse.json(post, { status: 200 });
  }

  const id = post.id as number;
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("field, value")
    .eq("entity_table", "content_posts")
    .eq("entity_id", id)
    .eq("language", locale)
    .in("field", FIELDS);

  const merged = { ...post };
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { field: string; value: string }) => {
    if (FIELDS.includes(t.field as typeof FIELDS[number])) merged[t.field] = t.value ?? merged[t.field];
  });
  return NextResponse.json(merged, { status: 200 });
}

FILE: src\app\api\marketing\activity\route.ts
========================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  try {
    // Create a timeout promise that resolves with an error object
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<{ data: null; error: { message: string } }>((resolve) =>
      setTimeout(() => resolve({ data: null, error: { message: "RPC timeout" } }), 3000)
    );

    // Use the secure RPC function to fetch marketing activity
    // This bypasses RLS to get public-safe data while protecting sensitive profile info
    // Race against timeout
    const { data, error } = await Promise.race([
      supabase.rpc('get_marketing_activity'),
      timeoutPromise
    ]) as any;

    if (error) {
      console.warn("Marketing activity fetch warning:", error.message);
      // Fallback to empty if RPC fails or times out
      return NextResponse.json({ profiles: [], orders: [] });
    }

    // Ensure data structure matches expectation
    type ActivityProfile = { full_name?: string; city?: string; created_at?: string };
    type ActivityOrder = { id?: number; profiles?: { full_name?: string; city?: string }; created_at?: string; total?: number };
    type ActivityData = { profiles?: ActivityProfile[]; orders?: ActivityOrder[] };
    const activityData = (data ?? {}) as ActivityData;
    
    return NextResponse.json({
      profiles: activityData?.profiles || [],
      orders: activityData?.orders || []
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn("Marketing activity API error (handled):", error.message);
    return NextResponse.json({ profiles: [], orders: [] }, { status: 200 }); // Return 200 with empty data to avoid frontend errors
  }
}

import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { productId } = await req.json();

    if (!productId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product ID is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      // If user is not logged in, we can't track in profile
      // But we could return success to not break the client
      return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: "User not logged in" });
    }

    // Insert view record
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("product_views")
      .insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        product_id: productId,
        viewed_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });

    if (error) {
      console.error("Error tracking product view:", error);
      // We don't want to fail the request if tracking fails, just log it
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error in view tracking:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Internal Server Error" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

  const { slug } = await params;

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("slug", slug)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const { data: textRow } = await supabase
    .from("product_texts")
    .select("*")
    .eq("product_id", data.id)
    .eq("locale", locale)
    .maybeSingle();

  const base = Number(data.base_price) || 0;
  const discount = Number(data.discount_percent) || 0;
  const finalPrice = base * (1 - discount / 100);
  const fallbackTitle =
    data.slug?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
      String(data.slug).slice(1).replace(/-/g, " ") || "Product";

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      id: data.id,
      slug: data.slug,
      price: finalPrice,
      originalPrice: discount ? base : null,
      title:
        (textRow &&
          typeof textRow.title === "string" &&
          textRow.title.trim().length > 0 &&
          textRow.title) ||
        fallbackTitle,
      description:
        (textRow &&
          typeof textRow.description === "string" &&
          textRow.description) ||
        "",
    },
    { status: 200 }
  );
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { maskUserName } from "@/lib/mask-name";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const productId = parseInt(slug);

  if (isNaN(productId)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Invalid product ID" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const {
    data: { user },
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Unauthorized" },
      { status: 401 }
    );
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { rating, comment } = body;

  if (!rating || rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rating must be between 1 and 5" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("reviews")
    .insert({
      product_id: productId,
      user_id: user.id,
      rating,
      comment,
    })
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("full_name")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  const fullName = (profile as { full_name?: string | null } | null)?.full_name;
  const userDisplayNameMasked = maskUserName(fullName ?? "Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i");

  return NextResponse.json(
    { ...data, user_display_name_masked: userDisplayNameMasked },
    { status: 201 }
  );
}

FILE: src\app\api\programs\[slug]\route.ts

import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const FIELDS = ["title", "description"] as const;

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { slug } = await params;
  const locale = (request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("locale") || "az") as string;
  const useTranslations =
    LOCALES.includes(locale as (typeof LOCALES)[number]) && locale !== "az";

  // 1. Try to find by slug
  let { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("programs")
    .select("*")
    .eq("slug", slug)
    .maybeSingle();

  // 2. If not found by slug, try by ID (numeric or slug ending with -id)
  if (!data) {
    const decoded = decodeURIComponent(slug);
    const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(decoded);
    const isUUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(decoded);
    const match = decoded.match(/^(.+)-(\d+)$/);

    if (isNumeric || isUUID) {
      const { data: dataById } = await supabase
        .from("programs")
        .select("*")
        .eq("id", decoded)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (dataById) {
        data = dataById;
        error = null;
      }
    } else if (match) {
      const numericId = match[2];
      const { data: dataById } = await supabase
        .from("programs")
        .select("*")
        .eq("id", numericId)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (dataById) {
        data = dataById;
        error = null;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!data) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Program not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  if (!useTranslations) {
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  }

  const id = (data as { id: number }).id;
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("field, value")
    .eq("entity_table", "programs")
    .eq("entity_id", id)
    .eq("language", locale)
    .in("field", FIELDS);

  const merged = { ...data };
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { field: string; value: string }) => {
    if (FIELDS.includes(t.field as (typeof FIELDS)[number])) {
      merged[t.field] = t.value ?? merged[t.field];
    }
  });
  return NextResponse.json(merged);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/** Resolve program id from slug: exact slug, numeric id, or "baseSlug-numericId" format. */
async function resolveProgramId(supabase: SupabaseClient, slug: string): Promise<number | null> {
  const trimmed = (slug || "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const bySlug = await supabase
    .from("programs")
    .select("id")
    .eq("slug", trimmed)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (bySlug.data?.id != null) return Number(bySlug.data.id);

  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(trimmed);
  if (isNumeric) {
    const byId = await supabase
      .from("programs")
      .select("id")
      .eq("id", trimmed)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (byId.data?.id != null) return Number(byId.data.id);
  }

  const match = trimmed.match(/^(.+)-(\d+)$/);
  if (match) {
    const numericId = match[2];
    const byId = await supabase
      .from("programs")
      .select("id")
      .eq("id", numericId)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (byId.data?.id != null) return Number(byId.data.id);
  }

  return null;
}

// GET - Fetch all reviews for a program
export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { slug } = await params;

  const programId = await resolveProgramId(supabase, decodeURIComponent(slug));
  if (programId == null) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Program not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return fetchReviews(supabase, programId);
}

async function fetchReviews(supabase: SupabaseClient, programId: number) {
  const { data: reviews, error } = await supabase
    .from("program_reviews")
    .select(`
      id,
      program_id,
      user_id,
      rating,
      comment,
      image_urls,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    `)
    .eq("program_id", programId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  const list = reviews || [];
  const userIds = [...new Set(list.map((r: { user_id?: string | null }) => r.user_id).filter(Boolean))] as string[];
  let profiles: Record<string, { full_name?: string | null; avatar_url?: string | null }> = {};

  if (userIds.length > 0) {
    try {
      const { data: profileData } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("id, full_name, avatar_url")
        .in("id", userIds);
      if (profileData) {
        for (const p of profileData) {
          profiles[p.id] = p;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // continue without profile names
    }
  }

  const enrichedReviews = list.map((r: { user_id?: string | null; [key: string]: unknown }) => ({
    ...r,
    user_name: profiles[r.user_id as string]?.full_name || "Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i",
    user_avatar: profiles[r.user_id as string]?.avatar_url ?? null,
  }));

  const total = enrichedReviews.length;
  const avgRating =
    total > 0
      ? enrichedReviews.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (Number((r as { rating?: number }).rating) || 0), 0) / total
      : 0;

  return NextResponse.json({
    reviews: enrichedReviews,
    stats: {
      total,
      avgRating: Math.round(avgRating * 10) / 10,
    },
  });
}

// POST - Create or update a review
export async function POST(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { slug } = await params;

  let body: { rating?: number; comment?: string; imageUrls?: string[] };
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "YanlÄ±ÅŸ sorÄŸu gÃ¶vdÉ™si" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const {
    data: { user },
    error: authError,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (authError || !user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Daxil olmalÄ±sÄ±nÄ±z" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const programId = await resolveProgramId(supabase, decodeURIComponent(slug));
  if (programId == null) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Proqram tapÄ±lmadÄ±" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const rating = Number(body.rating);
  const comment = (body.comment || "").trim();
  const imageUrls: string[] = Array.isArray(body.imageUrls) ? body.imageUrls : [];

  if (!Number.isFinite(rating) || rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Reytinq 1-5 arasÄ± olmalÄ±dÄ±r" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const row = {
    program_id: programId,
    user_id: user.id,
    rating,
    comment: comment || null,
    image_urls: imageUrls.length > 0 ? imageUrls : null,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("program_reviews")
    .upsert(row, { onConflict: "program_id,user_id" })
    .select("*")
    .single();

  if (error) {
    console.error("Review upsert error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });

// DELETE - Delete own review
export async function DELETE(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }
) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const body = await request.json();
  const reviewId = body.reviewId;

  if (!reviewId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "reviewId is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check authentication
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: authError,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (authError || !user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Daxil olmalÄ±sÄ±nÄ±z" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("program_reviews")
    .delete()
    .eq("id", reviewId)
    .eq("user_id", user.id);

  if (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

FILE: src\app\api\webhooks\payment\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import { azGateway } from "@/modules/payments/az-gateway";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const signature = req.headers.get("x-webhook-signature") || "";
  const payload = await req.text();
  const valid = azGateway.verifySignature(payload, signature);

  if (!valid) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid signature" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const data = JSON.parse(payload);
  const orderId = data.order_id as number;
  const status = data.status as string;

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  if (!orderId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing order" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const nextStatus =
    status === "success"
      ? "paid"
      : status === "failed"
      ? "failed"
      : "cancelled";

  // Update order status and get user_id for points calculation
  const { data: orderData, error: orderError } = await supabase
    .from("orders")
    .update({ status: nextStatus, payment_reference: data.transaction_id })
    .eq("id", orderId)
    .select("user_id")
    .single();

  if (orderError) {
    console.error("Error updating order:", orderError);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Order update failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }

  // If payment is successful, calculate and award loyalty points
  if (nextStatus === "paid" && orderData?.user_id) {
    try {
      // 1. Fetch order items with product points
      // We join products table to get the points value for each item
      const { data: items } = await supabase
        .from("order_items")
        .select(`
          quantity,
          product:products (
            points
          )
        `)
        .eq("order_id", orderId);

      // 2. Calculate total points earned
      let totalPoints = 0;
      if (items) {
        type OrderItemRow = {
          quantity?: number;
          product?: { points?: number } | Array<{ points?: number }>;
        };
        items.forEach((item: OrderItemRow) => {
          // item.product might be an array or object depending on relationship,
          // but usually object for FK. Safely access points.
          const productPoints = Array.isArray(item.product) 
            ? item.product[0]?.points 
            : item.product?.points;
            
          const points = Number(productPoints) || 0;
          totalPoints += points * (item.quantity || 1);
        });
      }

      // 3. Update User Profile with new points
      if (totalPoints > 0) {
        // Fetch current points
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("loyalty_points")
          .eq("id", orderData.user_id)
          .single();

        const currentPoints = Number(profile?.loyalty_points) || 0;
        const newPoints = currentPoints + totalPoints;

        // Update profile
        await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .update({ 
            loyalty_points: newPoints,
            // We could also update a 'tier' here if needed based on points
          })
          .eq("id", orderData.user_id);
          
        console.log(`Awarded ${totalPoints} points to user ${orderData.user_id}. Total: ${newPoints}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error processing loyalty points:", err);
      // Don't fail the webhook response, just log the error
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);
  const code = searchParams.get("code");
  // if "next" is in param, use it as the redirect URL
  const next = searchParams.get("next") ?? "/";

  if (code) {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const supabase = createServerClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
      {
        cookies: {
          getAll() {
            return cookieStore.getAll();
          },
          setAll(cookiesToSet) {
            try {
              cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
                cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
              );
            } catch {
              // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
              // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing
              // user sessions.
            }
          },
        },
      }
    );
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    if (!error) {
      const forwardedHost = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-host"); // original origin before load balancer
      const isLocalEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV === "development";
      if (isLocalEnv) {
        // we can be sure that there is no load balancer in between, so no need to watch for X-Forwarded-Host
        return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${next}`);
      } else if (forwardedHost) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(`https://${forwardedHost}${next}`);
      } else {
        return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}${next}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // return the user to an error page with instructions
  return NextResponse.redirect(`${origin}/auth/auth-code-error`);
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { ArrowRight, Loader2, Mail } from "lucide-react";

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const onSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setEmailError("");
    setSuccess(null);
    setError(null);
    const trimmed = email.trim();
    let hasError = false;
    if (!trimmed) {
      setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else {
      const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
      if (!emailRegex.test(trimmed)) {
        setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_invalid"));
        hasError = true;
      }
    }
    if (hasError) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const origin =
        typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "";
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(trimmed, {
        redirectTo: origin ? `${origin}/auth/callback?next=/auth/update-password` : undefined,
      });

      if (error) {
        setError(error.message);
      } else {
        setSuccess(t("auth.forgot.success"));
      }
    } catch {
      setError(t("auth.forgot.error"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar />
      <main className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col items-center px-6 py-10">

          <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-700 text-lg font-semibold text-emerald-50">
              S
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
              {t("auth.forgot.title")}
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-700">
              {t("auth.forgot.subtitle")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <form className="mt-8 space-y-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
                {t("auth.forgot.email_label")}
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
                <span className="mr-2 text-emerald-500 text-sm">âœ‰</span>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                  placeholder={t("auth.forgot.email_placeholder")}
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              {emailError && (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-red-500">{emailError}</p>
              )}
            </div>
            {success && (
              <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">{success}</p>
            )}
            {error && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{error}</p>}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 transition-colors"
            >
              {submitting ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <ArrowRight size={16} />}
              <span>
                {submitting ? t("auth.forgot.submitting") : t("auth.forgot.submit")}
              </span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </main>
      <HomeFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return buildPageMetadata({
    locale: "az",
    pageKey: "login",

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { isAdminRole } from "@/lib/roles";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useToast, ToastContainer } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { Mail, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

export default function LoginForm() {
  const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const next = searchParams.get("next");
  const toast = useToast();
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState("");
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const onSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setEmailError("");
    setPasswordError("");

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    const trimmedPassword = password;
    let hasError = false;

    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else {
      const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
      if (!emailRegex.test(trimmedEmail)) {
        setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_invalid"));
        hasError = true;
      }
    }

    if (!trimmedPassword) {
      setPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else if (trimmedPassword.length < 6) {
      setPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_min"));
      hasError = true;
    }

    if (hasError) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("__TIMEOUT__")), TIMEOUT_MS)
    );

    let authData, authError;
    try {
      ({ data: authData, error: authError } = await Promise.race([
        supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
          email: trimmedEmail,
          password,
        }),
        timeoutPromise,
      ]));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "";
      if (errMsg === "__TIMEOUT__") {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.timeout_title"), t("auth.toast.timeout_message"));
      } else {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.connection_error_title"), t("auth.toast.connection_error_check"));
      }
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    if (authError) {
      const msg = (authError.message || "").toLowerCase();
      if (
        authError.name === "AuthRetryableFetchError" ||
        msg === "" || msg === "{}" ||
        msg.includes("fetch") || msg.includes("network") ||
        msg.includes("504") || msg.includes("timeout")
      ) {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.connection_error_title"), t("auth.toast.connection_error_message"));
      } else if (msg.includes("invalid login credentials") || msg.includes("invalid_credentials")) {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.login_failed_title"), t("auth.toast.login_failed_message"));
      } else if (msg.includes("email not confirmed")) {
        toast.info(t("auth.toast.email_not_confirmed_title"), t("auth.toast.email_not_confirmed_message"));
      } else if (msg.includes("too many requests") || msg.includes("rate limit")) {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.too_many_requests_title"), t("auth.toast.too_many_requests_message"));
      } else {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.generic_error_title"), authError.message);
      }
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    // Admin yoxlamasÄ±
    let isAdmin = false;

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role, is_admin")
      .eq("id", authData?.user?.id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (
      !profileError &&
      (isAdminRole(profile?.role) || Boolean(profile?.is_admin))
    ) {
      isAdmin = true;
    }

    if (!isAdmin) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/check-role");
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (isAdminRole(data.role)) isAdmin = true;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    toast.success(t("auth.toast.login_success_title"), t("auth.toast.login_success_message"));

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (isAdmin) {
        window.location.href = "/admin";
      } else {
        if (next && !next.startsWith("/admin")) {
          window.location.href = next;
        } else {
          window.location.href = "/account";
        }
      }
    }, 1000);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ToastContainer toasts={toast.toasts} onClose={toast.close} />

      <div className="mt-8 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-8 py-10 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
          <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-700 text-emerald-50">
            <ShieldCheck size={24} />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
            {t("auth.login.title")}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-700">
            {t("auth.login.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <form className="mt-8 space-y-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
          {/* Email */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.login.email_label")}
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
              <Mail size={16} className="mr-2 text-emerald-500" />
              <input
                type="email"
                className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                placeholder={t("auth.login.email_placeholder")}
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
            {emailError && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-500">{emailError}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ÅžifrÉ™ */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.login.password_label")}
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
              <span className="mr-2 text-emerald-500 text-sm">ðŸ”’</span>
              <input
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                placeholder={t("auth.login.password_placeholder")}
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="ml-2 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600 focus:outline-none"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={16} /> : <Eye size={16} />}
              </button>
            </div>
            {passwordError && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-500">{passwordError}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* XatÄ±rla / ÅžifrÉ™ni unut */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 text-xs text-emerald-700">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="h-3 w-3 rounded border-emerald-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500"
              />
              <span>{t("auth.login.remember_me")}</span>
            </label>
            <Link
              href="/auth/forgot"
              className="text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 hover:underline"
            >
              {t("auth.login.forgot_password")}
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Submit */}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="group flex w-full items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-emerald-900/20 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {isSubmitting ? t("auth.login.submitting") : t("auth.login.submit")}
            {!isSubmitting && (
              <ArrowRight size={16} className="ml-2 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" />
            )}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-8 text-center text-xs text-emerald-600">
          {t("auth.login.no_account")}{" "}
          <Link
            href="/auth/register"
            className="font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:underline"
          >
            {t("auth.login.register_link")}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useToast, ToastContainer } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { Mail, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, ArrowRight, UserPlus, User, MapPin } from "lucide-react";

export default function RegisterForm({ siteName }: { siteName?: string }) {
  const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState("");
  const [usernameError, setUsernameError] = useState("");
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState("");
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState("");
  const [confirmPasswordError, setConfirmPasswordError] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const onSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setEmailError("");
    setUsernameError("");
    setLocationError("");
    setPasswordError("");
    setConfirmPasswordError("");

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    const trimmedUsername = username.trim();
    const trimmedLocation = location.trim();
    const trimmedPassword = password;
    let hasError = false;

    if (!trimmedEmail) {
      setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else {
      const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
      if (!emailRegex.test(trimmedEmail)) {
        setEmailError(t("auth.validation.email_invalid"));
        hasError = true;
      }
    }

    if (!trimmedUsername) {
      setUsernameError(t("auth.validation.username_required"));
      hasError = true;
    }

    if (!trimmedLocation) {
      setLocationError(t("auth.validation.location_required"));
      hasError = true;
    }

    if (!trimmedPassword) {
      setPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else if (trimmedPassword.length < 6) {
      setPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_min"));
      hasError = true;
    }

    if (!confirmPassword) {
      setConfirmPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else if (confirmPassword !== trimmedPassword) {
      setConfirmPasswordError(t("auth.validation.password_mismatch"));
      hasError = true;
    }

    if (hasError) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("__TIMEOUT__")), TIMEOUT_MS)
    );

    try {
      const { data: authData, error: authError } = await Promise.race([
        supabase.auth.signUp({
          email: trimmedEmail,
          password: trimmedPassword,
          options: {
            data: {
              full_name: trimmedUsername,
              city: trimmedLocation,
            },
            emailRedirectTo:
              typeof window !== "undefined"
                ? `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback`
                : undefined,
          },
        }),
        timeoutPromise,
      ]);
      console.log(authError);
      if (authError) {
        const msg = (authError.message || "").toLowerCase();
        const isNetworkError =
          authError.name === "AuthRetryableFetchError" ||
          msg === "" || msg === "{}" ||
          msg.includes("fetch") || msg.includes("networkerror") ||
          msg.includes("failed to fetch") || msg.includes("504") ||
          msg.includes("timeout");
        const isConfirmationEmailError =
          msg.includes("confirmation email") || msg.includes("sending confirmation");

        if (msg.includes("already registered") || msg.includes("already exists")) {
          toast.error(
            t("auth.toast.email_exists_title"),
            t("auth.toast.email_exists_message")
          );
        } else if (msg.includes("password")) {
          toast.error(t("auth.toast.password_weak_title"), t("auth.toast.password_weak_message"));
        } else if (isConfirmationEmailError) {
          toast.error(
            t("auth.toast.confirmation_email_failed_title"),
            t("auth.toast.confirmation_email_failed_message")
          );
        } else if (isNetworkError) {
          toast.error(
            t("auth.toast.connection_error_title"),
            t("auth.toast.connection_error_message")
          );
        } else {
          toast.error(t("auth.toast.register_failed_title"), authError.message || t("auth.error.register_generic"));
        }
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      if (!authData?.user) {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.generic_error_title"), t("auth.error.register_generic"));
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      // XoÅŸ gÉ™lmisiniz emailini arxa planda gÃ¶ndÉ™r
      const locale =
        typeof window !== "undefined"
          ? window.localStorage.getItem("locale") || "az"
          : "az";
      fetch("/api/auth/send-welcome-email", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: trimmedEmail, fullName: trimmedUsername, locale }),
      }).catch(() => {});

      if (authData.user.email_confirmed_at) {
        toast.success(t("auth.toast.register_success_title"), t("auth.toast.register_success_message"));
        setTimeout(() => router.push("/account"), 1200);
      } else {
        toast.info(
          t("auth.toast.register_success_email_title"),
          t("auth.toast.register_success_email_message")
        );
        setTimeout(() => router.push("/auth/login?registered=true"), 2000);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      if (errMsg === "__TIMEOUT__") {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.timeout_title"), t("auth.toast.timeout_message"));
      } else if (
        errMsg.toLowerCase().includes("fetch") ||
        errMsg.toLowerCase().includes("network") ||
        errMsg === "{}"
      ) {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.connection_error_title"), t("auth.toast.connection_error_check"));
      } else {
        toast.error(t("auth.toast.generic_error_title"), t("auth.error.register_generic"));
      }
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ToastContainer toasts={toast.toasts} onClose={toast.close} />

      <div className="mt-8 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-8 py-10 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
          <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-700 text-emerald-50">
            <UserPlus size={24} />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
            {t("auth.register.title")}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-700">
            {siteName
              ? t("auth.register.subtitle_with_site", { siteName })
              : t("auth.register.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <form className="mt-8 space-y-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
          {/* Ad Soyad */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.register.username_label")}
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
              <User size={16} className="mr-2 text-emerald-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                placeholder={t("auth.register.username_placeholder")}
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
            {usernameError && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-500">{usernameError}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ÅžÉ™hÉ™r */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.register.location_label")}
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
              <MapPin size={16} className="mr-2 text-emerald-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                placeholder={t("auth.register.location_placeholder")}
                value={location}
                onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
            {locationError && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-500">{locationError}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Email */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.register.email_label")}
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
              <Mail size={16} className="mr-2 text-emerald-500" />

                disabled={isSubmitting}

            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
              {t("auth.register.password_label")}
            </label>

                placeholder={t("auth.register.password_placeholder")}

              />

            {confirmPasswordError && (

            )}
          </div>

          {/* Submit */}
          <button

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { Lock } from "lucide-react";

export default function UpdatePasswordPage() {
  const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const onSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setError(null);

    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError(t("auth.validation.password_min"));
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError(t("auth.validation.password_mismatch"));
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
        password: password,
      });

      if (error) {
        setError(error.message);
      } else {
        // Password updated successfully
        router.push("/auth/login?updated=true");
      }
    } catch {
      setError(t("auth.forgot.error"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar />
      <main className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col items-center px-6 py-10">
        <div className="mt-8 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-8 py-10 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
              {t("auth.reset.title")}
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-700">
              {t("auth.reset.subtitle")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <form className="mt-8 space-y-4" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
                {t("auth.register.password_label")}
              </label>
              <input
                type="password"
                className="w-full rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                placeholder="******"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-900">
                {t("auth.register.confirm_password_label")}
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 focus-within:border-emerald-500">
                <Lock size={16} className="mr-2 text-emerald-500" />
                <input
                  type="password"
                  className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-emerald-900 placeholder:text-emerald-300 outline-none"
                  placeholder="******"
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {error && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{error}</p>}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-700 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <span>{submitting ? "..." : t("auth.reset.submit")}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

const CATEGORY_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  "SaÄŸlam hÉ™yat tÉ™rzi": "bg-emerald-600",
  "SaÄŸlam qidalanma": "bg-orange-500",
  "Enerji vÉ™ gÃ¼ndelik performans": "bg-blue-600",

  "Metabolizma vÉ™ Ã§É™ki idarÉ™si": "bg-purple-600",
  "Stress idarÉ™etmÉ™si": "bg-red-500",
};

function getCategoryColor(category: string) {
  if (CATEGORY_COLORS[category]) return CATEGORY_COLORS[category];
  const colors = [
    "bg-emerald-600", "bg-orange-500", "bg-blue-600",
    "bg-pink-600", "bg-purple-600", "bg-red-500",
    "bg-teal-600", "bg-amber-600",
  ];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < category.length; i++) {
    hash = category.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
}

  title_font_weight?: string;
  excerpt_font_size?: string;
  excerpt_font_weight?: string;
  body_font_size?: string;
  body_font_weight?: string;

export default function BlogPostPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const unwrappedParams = React.use(params);
  const slug = unwrappedParams.slug;
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [post, setPost] = useState<BlogPost | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);

    fetch(`/api/content/posts/${slug}?locale=${locale}`)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Not found");
        return res.json();
      })
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setPost(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setPost(null);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [slug, locale]);

  const localeMap: Record<string, string> = {
    az: "az-AZ",
    en: "en-US",
    ru: "ru-RU",
    tr: "tr-TR",
  };

  const createdDate =
    post?.created_at
      ? new Date(post.created_at).toLocaleDateString(localeMap[locale] || "az-AZ", {
          year: "numeric",
          month: "long",
          day: "numeric",
        })
      : "";

  if (loading) {

          <p className="text-emerald-600">{t("common.loading")}</p>
        </main>
        <HomeFooter />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!post) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950 flex flex-col">
        <SiteNavbar />
        <main className="flex-grow flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">

          <Link
            href="/"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors"

            <ArrowLeft size={16} />

        </main>
        <HomeFooter />

    );

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, Suspense } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useCart } from "@/contexts/CartContext";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useSiteSettings } from "@/contexts/SiteSettingsContext";
import { useGlobalToast } from "@/contexts/ToastContext";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { getLocalizedPath } from "@/lib/localized-path";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import { Minus, Plus, Trash2, ArrowRight, ShoppingBag, Loader2, MessageCircle, LogIn } from "lucide-react";

function CartContent() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { items, updateQty, remove, total } = useCart();
  const { hidePrices } = useSiteSettings();
  const { showToast } = useGlobalToast();

  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [checkingOut, setCheckingOut] = useState(false);
  const [checkoutError, setCheckoutError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState("");
  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState("");
  const [cityError, setCityError] = useState("");
  const [addressError, setAddressError] = useState("");
  const [adminPhone, setAdminPhone] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const subtotal = total;
  const grandTotal = total;
  const loginUrl = `/auth/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname || "/cart")}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data: { user } }) => {
      setIsLoggedIn(!!user);
      if (user) {
        setName(user.user_metadata?.full_name || "");
        setPhone(user.user_metadata?.phone || "");
      }
    });

    fetch("/api/admin/settings")
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (data?.footer_phone) setAdminPhone(data.footer_phone);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const fromParam = searchParams?.get("from")?.trim() || "";
  const canReturnToFrom =
    fromParam.startsWith("/") &&
    !fromParam.includes("/cart") &&
    !fromParam.includes("/wishlist");

  const handleGoBack = () => {
    if (canReturnToFrom) {
      router.push(fromParam);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.history.length > 1) {
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    router.push("/");
  };

  const handleProceedToCheckout = () => {
    if (!items.length) return;
    const checkoutPath = getLocalizedPath(
      `/checkout?from=${encodeURIComponent(pathname || "/cart")}`,
      locale
    );
    router.push(checkoutPath);
  };

  const handleCheckout = async () => {
    if (!items.length || checkingOut) return;
    if (isLoggedIn === false) {
      window.location.href = loginUrl;
      return;
    }
    setCheckoutError(null);
    setNameError("");
    setPhoneError("");
    setCityError("");
    setAddressError("");
    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    const trimmedPhone = phone.trim();
    const trimmedCity = city.trim();
    const trimmedAddress = address.trim();
    let hasError = false;
    if (!trimmedName) {
      setNameError(t("cart.checkout.validation.name_required"));
      hasError = true;
    }
    if (!trimmedPhone) {
      setPhoneError(t("cart.checkout.validation.phone_required"));
      hasError = true;
    } else if (!/^[0-9+\-\s]{7,20}$/.test(trimmedPhone)) {
      setPhoneError(t("cart.checkout.validation.phone_invalid"));
      hasError = true;
    }
    if (!trimmedCity) {
      setCityError(t("cart.checkout.validation.city_required"));
      hasError = true;
    }
    if (!trimmedAddress) {
      setAddressError(t("cart.checkout.validation.address_required"));
      hasError = true;
    }
    if (hasError) {
      showToast(t("cart.checkout.validation_fill_all"), "error");
      return;
    }
    setCheckingOut(true);
    try {
      const lines = items
        .map((i) => {
          const idNum = Number(i.product.id);
          if (!idNum || Number.isNaN(idNum)) return null;
          return { productId: idNum, quantity: i.qty };
        })
        .filter(
          (
            v
          ): v is {
            productId: number;
            quantity: number;
          } => v !== null
        );
      if (!lines.length) {
        showToast(t("cart.error.checkout"), "error");
        setCheckingOut(false);
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch("/api/checkout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          lines,
          shippingAddress: {
            fullName: trimmedName,
            phone: trimmedPhone,
            city: trimmedCity,
            address: trimmedAddress,
          },
        }),
      });
      if (res.status === 401) {
        showToast(t("cart.checkout.login_required"), "info");
        setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = loginUrl; }, 800);
        return;
      }
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const errMsg = errData.error || t("cart.error.checkout");
        showToast(errMsg, "error");
        setCheckoutError(errMsg);
        setCheckingOut(false);
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data && typeof data.paymentUrl === "string" && data.paymentUrl) {
        showToast(t("cart.checkout.redirecting_to_payment"), "success");
        setTimeout(() => { window.location.href = data.paymentUrl as string; }, 600);
        return;
      }
      showToast(t("cart.error.payment_link"), "error");
      setCheckoutError(t("cart.error.payment_link"));
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "";
      const displayMsg = msg && msg !== "Checkout failed" ? msg : t("cart.error.checkout");
      showToast(displayMsg, "error");
      setCheckoutError(displayMsg);
    } finally {
      setCheckingOut(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10 space-y-8">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleGoBack}
          className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          â† {t("common.back")}
        </button>
        <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
          {t("cart.title")}
        </h1>
      </div>
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-6 text-sm text-emerald-700">
          {t("cart.empty")}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2.2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {items.map((i) => (
              <div
                key={i.product.id}
                className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 sm:gap-6 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-4 sm:px-5 py-4 shadow-sm"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-4 min-w-0">
                  <div className="relative h-20 w-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50">
                    {i.product.image ? (
                      <img
                        src={i.product.image}
                        alt={i.product.title}

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { getCategoryBySlug, getProductsByCategory } from "@/modules/products/queries";
import ProductCard from "@/components/products/ProductCard";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export const revalidate = 60;

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
};

export default async function CategoryPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const category = await getCategoryBySlug(slug);

  if (!category) {
    notFound();
  }

  // Ensure category has name
  const categoryName = category.name || category.slug.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ");

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const [products, settingsResult] = await Promise.all([
    getProductsByCategory(category.id),
    supabase.from("site_settings").select("public_site_name, site_name, logo, footer_phone").eq("id", 1).maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  const settings = settingsResult.data;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar initialSettings={settings} />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10 space-y-8">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <nav className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
            <a href="/" className="hover:underline">Ana sÉ™hifÉ™</a>
            <span className="mx-1">/</span>
            <a href="/products" className="hover:underline">MÉ™hsullar</a>
            <span className="mx-1">/</span>
            <span className="font-medium">{categoryName}</span>
          </nav>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
            {categoryName}
          </h1>
          {category.description && (
            <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700 max-w-2xl">
              {category.description}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {products.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-8 text-center">
            <p className="text-emerald-700">Bu kateqoriyada hÉ™lÉ™lik mÉ™hsul yoxdur.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:gap-6">
            {products.map((product) => {
              const basePrice = Number(product.base_price) || 0;
              const discount = Number(product.discount_percent) || 0;
              const finalPrice = basePrice * (1 - discount / 100);
              const title = product.translations?.find(t => t.field === "title")?.value || product.slug?.split("-").map(s => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ") || "MÉ™hsul";
              return (
                <ProductCard
                  key={product.id}
                  id={product.id}
                  name={title}
                  price={finalPrice}
                  originalPrice={discount > 0 ? basePrice : null}
                  imageUrl={product.image_url}
                  slug={product.slug}
                  rating={product.rating_average}
                  reviewCount={product.review_count}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
      <HomeFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, Suspense } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useCart } from "@/contexts/CartContext";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useGlobalToast } from "@/contexts/ToastContext";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";
import { getLocalizedPath } from "@/lib/localized-path";

function CheckoutContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { items, total } = useCart();
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { showToast } = useGlobalToast();
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");
  const [cardHolder, setCardHolder] = useState("");
  const [cardNumber, setCardNumber] = useState("");
  const [expiry, setExpiry] = useState("");
  const [cvv, setCvv] = useState("");

  const fromParam = searchParams?.get("from")?.trim() || "";
  const canReturnToFrom = fromParam.startsWith("/");
  const loginUrl = `/auth/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname || "/checkout")}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data: { user } }) => setIsLoggedIn(!!user));
    const { data: sub } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setIsLoggedIn(!!session?.user);
    });
    return () => sub?.subscription?.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  const lines = useMemo(
    () =>
      items
        .map((i) => {
          const idNum = Number(i.product.id);
          if (!idNum || Number.isNaN(idNum)) return null;
          return { productId: idNum, quantity: i.qty };
        })
        .filter(
          (
            v
          ): v is {
            productId: number;
            quantity: number;
          } => v !== null
        ),
    [items]
  );

  const handleCancel = () => {
    showToast(t("checkout.cancelled"), "info");
    if (canReturnToFrom) {
      router.push(fromParam);
      return;
    }
    router.push(getLocalizedPath("/cart", locale));
  };

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!items.length) {
      showToast(t("cart.empty"), "error");
      router.push(getLocalizedPath("/cart", locale));
      return;
    }
    if (isLoggedIn === false) {
      showToast(t("cart.checkout.login_required"), "info");
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.location.href = loginUrl;
      }, 800);
      return;
    }
    if (
      !fullName.trim() ||
      !phone.trim() ||
      !city.trim() ||
      !address.trim() ||
      !cardHolder.trim() ||
      !cardNumber.trim() ||
      !expiry.trim() ||
      !cvv.trim()
    ) {
      showToast(t("checkout.validation.required"), "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\d{16}$/.test(cardNumber.replace(/\s/g, ""))) {
      showToast(t("checkout.validation.card_number"), "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\d{2}\/\d{2}$/.test(expiry)) {
      showToast(t("checkout.validation.expiry"), "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\d{3,4}$/.test(cvv)) {
      showToast(t("checkout.validation.cvv"), "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!lines.length) {
      showToast(t("cart.error.checkout"), "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/checkout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          lines,
          shippingAddress: {
            fullName: fullName.trim(),
            phone: phone.trim(),
            city: city.trim(),
            address: address.trim(),
          },
        }),
      });
      if (res.status === 401) {
        showToast(t("cart.checkout.login_required"), "info");
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = loginUrl;
        }, 800);
        return;
      }
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        const errMsg = errData.error || t("cart.error.checkout");
        showToast(errMsg, "error");
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      showToast(t("checkout.success"), "success");
      if (data && typeof data.paymentUrl === "string" && data.paymentUrl) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          window.location.href = data.paymentUrl as string;
        }, 700);
      }
    } catch {
      showToast(t("cart.error.checkout"), "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-6 py-10 space-y-6">
      <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold">{t("checkout.title")}</h1>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("cart.checkout.name_label")} value={fullName} onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)} />
          <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("cart.checkout.phone_label")} value={phone} onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)} />
          <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("cart.checkout.city_label")} value={city} onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)} />
          <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("cart.checkout.address_label")} value={address} onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)} />
        </div>

        <div className="border-t border-emerald-100 pt-4 space-y-3">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-900">{t("checkout.card_info")}</h2>
          <input className="w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("checkout.card_holder")} value={cardHolder} onChange={(e) => setCardHolder(e.target.value)} />
          <input className="w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("checkout.card_number")} value={cardNumber} onChange={(e) => setCardNumber(e.target.value)} />
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("checkout.expiry")} value={expiry} onChange={(e) => setExpiry(e.target.value)} />
            <input className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={t("checkout.cvv")} value={cvv} onChange={(e) => setCvv(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>{t("cart.summary.total")}</span>
          <span className="font-semibold">{total.toFixed(2)} â‚¼</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCancel}
            className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
          >
            {t("checkout.cancel")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={submitting}
            className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {submitting ? `${t("checkout.confirm")}...` : t("checkout.confirm")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CheckoutPage() {

import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { defaultLocale, locales, type Locale } from "@/modules/i18n/config";

async function getLocaleForRedirect(): Promise<Locale> {
  const h = await headers();
  const c = await cookies();

  const fromHeader = h.get("x-locale")?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (locales.includes(fromHeader as Locale)) return fromHeader as Locale;

  const fromCookie = c.get("locale")?.value?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (locales.includes(fromCookie as Locale)) return fromCookie as Locale;

  return defaultLocale;
}

export default async function ContactRedirectPage() {
  const locale = await getLocaleForRedirect();
  redirect(`/${locale}/contact`);
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const product = await getProductBySlug(slug);
  
  if (!product) {
    return {
      title: "MÉ™hsul tapÄ±lmadÄ±",
    };
  }

  // Basic title from slug if translation not available immediately on server

  };
}
