FILE: src\app\programs\[slug]\page.tsx
========================================

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import ProgramReviews from "@/components/programs/ProgramReviews";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useSiteSettings } from "@/contexts/SiteSettingsContext";
import {
  getProgramBySlug,
  type Program,
  type ProgramTask,
} from "@/modules/programs/config";
import { MessageCircle } from "lucide-react";

type PageProps = {
  params: {
    slug: string;
  };
};

type ProgramProgressEntry = {
  startedAt?: string;
  completedTasks?: string[];
};

type ProgramsApiResponse = {
  programs: Program[];
  progress: Record<string, ProgramProgressEntry>;
  totalPoints: number;
};

type UnifiedProgram = {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  imageUrl?: string;
  duration?: string;
  price?: number;
  // Config specific
  tasks?: ProgramTask[];
  featureKeys?: string[];
  typeKey?: string;
  cardTitleKey?: string;
  cardDescriptionKey?: string;
  durationKey?: string;
  participantsKey?: string;
  isDbProgram?: boolean;
};

export default function ProgramDetailsPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const unwrappedParams = React.use(params);
  const slug = unwrappedParams.slug;
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { hidePrices, hidePoints } = useSiteSettings();

  const [program, setProgram] = useState<UnifiedProgram | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<
    Record<string, ProgramProgressEntry>
  >({});
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [adminPhone, setAdminPhone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [currentUserId, setCurrentUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        // Fetch site settings for admin phone
        const settingsRes = await fetch("/api/settings");
        if (settingsRes.ok) {
          const settings = await settingsRes.json();
          if (settings.footer_phone) {
             setAdminPhone(settings.footer_phone);
          }
        }

        // 1. Try config first
        const configProgram = getProgramBySlug(slug);
        let currentProgram: UnifiedProgram | null = null;

        if (configProgram) {
          currentProgram = {
            ...configProgram,
            title: t(configProgram.cardTitleKey),
            description: t(configProgram.cardDescriptionKey),
            isDbProgram: false,
          };
        } else {
          // 2. Try DB
          const res = await fetch(`/api/programs/${slug}?locale=${locale}`);
          if (res.ok) {
            const dbProgram = await res.json();
            currentProgram = {
              slug: dbProgram.slug,
              title: dbProgram.title,
              description: dbProgram.description,
              imageUrl: dbProgram.image_url,
              duration: dbProgram.duration,
              price: dbProgram.price,
              isDbProgram: true,
            };
          }
        }

        if (cancelled) return;

        if (!currentProgram) {
          setProgram(null);
          return;
        }

        setProgram(currentProgram);

        // 3. Load user progress & get user ID
        const authRes = await fetch("/api/account/programs");
        if (!authRes.ok) {
          if (authRes.status === 401) {
            setIsAuthenticated(false);
            setCurrentUserId(null);
          }
        } else {
          const authData = await authRes.json();
          setIsAuthenticated(true);
          setProgress(authData.progress || {});
        }

        // Get current user ID for reviews
        const { getSupabaseBrowserClient } = await import("@/lib/supabase-browser");
        const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();
        const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (user && !cancelled) {
          setCurrentUserId(user.id);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          console.error(err);
          // Don't show error if it's just auth error, handled above
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadData();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [slug, locale, t]);

  const entry: ProgramProgressEntry = progress[program?.slug || slug] || {};
  const completedTasks = new Set(entry.completedTasks || []);
  const hasStarted = Boolean(entry.startedAt);

  const programPointsForThisProgram =
    !program || !program.tasks
      ? 0
      : program.tasks.reduce((sum: number, task: ProgramTask) => {
          if (!completedTasks.has(task.id)) return sum;
          return sum + task.points;
        }, 0);

  const handleStartProgram = async () => {
    if (!program || isAuthenticated === false) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/account/programs", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ slug: program.slug || slug, action: "start" }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(t("programs.details.start_error"));
      }
      const data: ProgramsApiResponse = await res.json();
      setProgress(data.progress || {});
    } catch {
      setError(t("programs.details.start_error"));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCompleteTask = async (taskId: string) => {
    if (!program || isAuthenticated === false) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/account/programs", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ slug: program.slug || slug, action: "completeTask", taskId }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(t("programs.details.task_error"));
      }
      const data: ProgramsApiResponse = await res.json();
      setProgress(data.progress || {});
    } catch {
      setError(t("programs.details.task_error"));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleConsult = () => {
    const text = encodeURIComponent(
      t("programs.details.whatsapp_message").replace("{title}", program?.title || "")
    );
    const phone = adminPhone || ""; // Use fetched phone or empty
    const url = phone 
      ? `https://wa.me/${phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")}?text=${text}`
      : `https://wa.me/?text=${text}`;
    window.open(url, "_blank");
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950 flex items-center justify-center">
        <p className="text-emerald-600">{t("common.loading")}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!program) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
        <SiteNavbar />
        <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10">

            <p>{t("programs.details.not_found")}</p>

                href="/programs"

              >
                <span>{t("programs.details.back_to_programs")}</span>
                <span>â†’</span>

import { Suspense } from "react";
import { searchProducts, getCategories } from "@/modules/products/queries";
import ProductsClient from "@/components/products/ProductsClient";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export default async function SearchPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q: string }>;
}) {
  const { q: query } = await searchParams;
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  const [products, categories, settingsResult] = await Promise.all([
    searchProducts(query || ""),
    getCategories(),
    supabase.from("site_settings").select("public_site_name, site_name, logo, footer_phone").eq("id", 1).maybeSingle(),
  ]);

  const settings = settingsResult.data;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar initialSettings={settings} />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10 space-y-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-900">
          AxtarÄ±ÅŸ nÉ™ticÉ™lÉ™ri: &quot;{query}&quot;
        </h1>
        <Suspense fallback={<div className="h-96 flex items-center justify-center">AxtarÄ±lÄ±r...</div>}>
          <ProductsClient products={products} categories={categories} />
        </Suspense>
      </main>
      <HomeFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

export default function TermsPage() {

    fetch("/api/settings")
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active || !data) return;

            ? data[localeKey]
            : typeof data[fallbackKey] === "string" && data[fallbackKey].trim()
            ? data[fallbackKey]
            : "") as string;
        setContent(text);
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setLoading(false);

"use client";

import { useWishlist } from "@/contexts/WishlistContext";
import { useCart } from "@/contexts/CartContext";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Suspense } from "react";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";

function WishlistContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { items, remove } = useWishlist();
  const { add: addToCart } = useCart();
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const fromParam = searchParams?.get("from")?.trim() || "";
  const canReturnToFrom =
    fromParam.startsWith("/") &&
    !fromParam.includes("/cart") &&
    !fromParam.includes("/wishlist");

  const handleGoBack = () => {
    if (canReturnToFrom) {
      router.push(fromParam);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.history.length > 1) {
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    router.push("/");
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10 space-y-8">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleGoBack}
          className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          â† {t("common.back")}
        </button>
        <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
          {t("wishlist.title")}
        </h1>
      </div>
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-6 text-sm text-emerald-700">
          {t("wishlist.empty")}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2.2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {items.map((p) => (
              <div
                key={p.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 shadow-sm"
              >
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-950">
                    {p.title}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-emerald-500">
                    {p.description || t("wishlist.item.default_description")}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-900">
                    {p.price.toFixed(2)} â‚¼
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <button
                    className="rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-emerald-700"
                    onClick={() => addToCart(p)}
                  >
                    {t("wishlist.item.add_to_cart")}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="rounded-full border border-emerald-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:border-red-400 hover:text-red-500"
                    onClick={() => remove(p.id)}
                  >
                    {t("wishlist.item.remove")}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
              <div className="text-base font-semibold text-emerald-950">
                {t("wishlist.summary.title")}
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-emerald-800">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>{t("wishlist.summary.count")}</span>
                  <span>{items.length}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <Link
                  href="/cart"
                  className="block w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-600 py-3 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-emerald-700"
                >
                  {t("wishlist.summary.go_to_cart")}
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>

        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { locales, defaultLocale, type Locale } from "@/modules/i18n/config";
import LocaleSync from "@/components/navigation/LocaleSync";

export default async function LocaleLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  params: Promise<{ locale: string }>;
}) {
  const { locale } = await params;
  const validLocale = locales.includes(locale as Locale) ? (locale as Locale) : null;

  if (!validLocale) {
    redirect(`/${defaultLocale}`);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <LocaleSync locale={validLocale} />
      {children}
    </>
  );
}

function getLocaleFromPathname(pathname: string): string {
  const locale = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
  return locale && locale in loadingMessages ? locale : "en";
}

    getHomeProducts(),
    getCategories(locale),
    getSiteSettings(),
    getPageSections("home"),
    getHeroSlides(locale),
    getMessages(locale),
  ]);

  const brandFallback = messages["hero.brand_fallback"] || "SaÄŸlam Bazar";
  const productFallback = messages["home.product_fallback"] || "MÉ™hsul";
  const structuredDesc = messages["home.structured_description"] || "Herbalife mÉ™hsullarÄ± ilÉ™ saÄŸlam hÉ™yat tÉ™rzi. ArÄ±qlama, Ã§É™ki artÄ±rma vÉ™ saÄŸlam qidalanma Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n professional hÉ™llÉ™r.";

  const brandName =
    (settings?.public_site_name && settings.public_site_name.trim()) ||
    (settings?.site_name && settings.site_name.trim()) ||
    brandFallback;

  const featuredProducts = rawProducts.map((p) => {
    const basePrice = Number(p.base_price) || 0;
    const discount = Number(p.discount_percent) || 0;
    const finalPrice = basePrice * (1 - discount / 100);
    const name = p.translations?.find((tr: any) => tr.language === locale && tr.field === "title")?.value
      || p.translations?.find((t: any) => t.field === "title")?.value
      || (p.slug ? p.slug.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slug.slice(1).replace(/-/g, " ") : null)
      || productFallback;
    return {
      id: p.id,
      slug: p.slug,
      name,
      price: finalPrice,
      originalPrice: discount > 0 ? basePrice : null,
      imageUrl: p.image_url,
      rating: p.rating_average || 0,
      reviewCount: p.review_count || 0,
      tag: null,
      searchBlob: productSearchHaystack(p),
    };
  });

  const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || "https://www.herbaformadaqal.com";

  const logoUrl = ensureAbsoluteImageUrl(settings?.logo, siteUrl) || `${siteUrl}/logo.png`;
  const defaultImage = ensureAbsoluteImageUrl(settings?.logo, siteUrl) || `${siteUrl}/og-image.jpg`;
  const structuredData = {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "HealthAndBeautyBusiness",
    "name": brandName,
    "description": structuredDesc,
    "url": siteUrl,
    "logo": logoUrl,
    "image": defaultImage,
    "telephone": settings?.footer_phone || "+994 50 123 45 67",

      "@type": "PostalAddress",

      "addressLocality": "BakÄ±",
    },
    "sameAs": [],
    "offers": {
      "@type": "AggregateOffer",
      "offerCount": featuredProducts.length,
      "lowPrice": featuredProducts.length > 0 ? Math.min(...featuredProducts.map(p => p.price)) : 0,
      "highPrice": featuredProducts.length > 0 ? Math.max(...featuredProducts.map(p => p.price)) : 0,
      "priceCurrency": "AZN",
    },
  };

  return (

async function getAboutData(locale = "az") {
  // Navbar Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n ÅŸemaya uyÄŸun settings
  const settings = await getSiteSettings();

  // about_content sÃ¼tunlarÄ± ÅŸemada olmaya bilÉ™r, ayrÄ±ca raw sorÄŸu ilÉ™ Ã§É™kirik
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rawSettings } = await supabase
    .from("site_settings")
    .select("about_content, about_content_az, about_content_en, about_content_tr, about_content_ru")
    .eq("id", 1)
    .maybeSingle();

  const s = rawSettings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
  const localeKey = `about_content_${locale}`;
  const aboutContent =
    (s && typeof s[localeKey] === "string" && (s[localeKey] as string).trim()
      ? (s[localeKey] as string)
      : s && typeof s.about_content_az === "string" && (s.about_content_az as string).trim()
      ? (s.about_content_az as string)
      : s && typeof s.about_content === "string"
      ? (s.about_content as string)
      : "") || "";

  const products = await getRecommendedProducts(4).catch(() => []);

  return { settings, aboutContent, products };
}

  params: Promise<{ locale: string; slug: string }>;
};

export default async function CategoryPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { locale, slug } = await params;
  const category = await getCategoryBySlug(slug, locale);
  if (!category) notFound();
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const [products, settingsResult] = await Promise.all([
    getProductsByCategory(category.id),
    supabase.from("site_settings").select("public_site_name, site_name, logo, footer_phone").eq("id", 1).maybeSingle(),
  ]);
  const settings = settingsResult.data;
  return (
    <CategoryPageContent
      category={category}
      products={products}
      settings={settings}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { Phone, Mail, MapPin, Send, CheckCircle2, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";

type Props = {
  initialPhone: string;
  initialEmail: string;
  initialAddress: string;
};

export default function ContactClient({
  initialPhone,
  initialEmail,
  initialAddress,
}: Props) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitted(false);
    setError("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/contact", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, email, subject, message }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(t("contact.form.error"));
      } else {
        setSubmitted(true);
        setName("");
        setEmail("");
        setSubject("");
        setMessage("");
      }
    } catch {
      setError(t("contact.form.error"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main>
      <section className="border-b border-emerald-100 bg-[#e3f3ea]">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-10 text-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-emerald-950 md:text-4xl">
            {t("contact.title")}
          </h1>
          <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm text-emerald-800 md:text-base">
            {t("contact.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10">
        <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          {/* â”€â”€ Contact info (server-dÉ™n gÉ™lir, layout shift yoxdur) â”€â”€ */}
          <div className="space-y-6 text-sm text-emerald-900">
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-emerald-950">
              {t("contact.info.title")}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">{t("contact.subtitle")}</p>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                  <Phone size={24} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
                    {t("contact.info.phone_label")}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-base font-medium text-emerald-950">
                    {initialPhone || t("footer.contact.phone")}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                  <Mail size={24} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
                    {t("contact.info.email_label")}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-base font-medium text-emerald-950">
                    {initialEmail || t("footer.contact.email")}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-start gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
                <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                  <MapPin size={24} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
                    {t("contact.info.address_label")}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-base font-medium text-emerald-950">
                    {initialAddress || t("footer.contact.address")}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* â”€â”€ Form â”€â”€ */}
          {submitted ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-5 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-6 py-12 text-center shadow-sm shadow-emerald-50">
              <div className="flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-50">
                <CheckCircle2 size={44} className="text-emerald-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-emerald-950">
                  {t("contact.form.success_title")}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">
                  {t("contact.form.success")}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSubmitted(false)}
                className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700 transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-100"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={14} />
                {t("contact.form.send_another")}
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form
              className="space-y-4 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-6 py-6 text-sm text-emerald-900 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-50"
              onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            >

                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800">
                  {t("contact.form.email_label")}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 outline-none placeholder:text-emerald-400"
                  placeholder={t("contact.form.email_placeholder")}
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800">
                  {t("contact.form.subject_label")}
                </label>
                <input
                  className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 outline-none placeholder:text-emerald-400"
                  placeholder={t("contact.form.subject_placeholder")}
                  value={subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-emerald-800">
                  {t("contact.form.message_label")}
                </label>
                <textarea
                  className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-900 outline-none placeholder:text-emerald-400"
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={t("contact.form.message_placeholder")}
                  value={message}
                  onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              {error && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-100 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3">
                  <span className="mt-0.5 text-red-500">&#9888;</span>
                  <p className="text-xs text-red-700">{error}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="mt-2 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-60"
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                <Send size={16} />
                <span>
                  {submitting
                    ? t("contact.form.submitting")
                    : t("contact.form.submit")}
                </span>
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

const tabs: { id: TabId; labelKey: string; icon: React.ElementType }[] = [

  { id: "addresses", labelKey: "tabs.addresses", icon: MapPin },
  { id: "settings", labelKey: "tabs.settings", icon: Settings },
];

function getInitials(fullName: string, fallback: string) {
  const trimmed = fullName.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return fallback.toUpperCase().slice(0, 2) || "U";
  }
  const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
  const letters = parts.slice(0, 2).map((p) => p.charAt(0).toUpperCase());
  return letters.join("");
}

function formatOrderStatus(status: OrderStatus, t: (key: string) => string) {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return t("orders.status.pending");
    case "paid":
      return t("orders.status.paid");
    case "shipped":
      return t("orders.status.shipped");
    case "completed":
      return t("orders.status.completed");
    case "failed":
      return t("orders.status.failed");
    case "cancelled":
      return t("orders.status.cancelled");
    case "refunded":
      return t("orders.status.refunded");
    default:
      return status;
  }
}

function getStatusTone(status: OrderStatus): "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error" {
  if (status === "completed" || status === "paid" || status === "shipped") {
    return "success";
  }
  if (status === "pending") {
    return "info";
  }
  if (status === "cancelled" || status === "failed" || status === "refunded") {
    return "error";
  }
  return "warning";
}

function formatOrderDate(value: string, locale: string) {
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return value;
  }
  return d.toLocaleDateString(locale, {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric"
  });
}

        if (cancelled) return;
        // Data contains programs (all available) and progress (user's started programs)
        const allPrograms = data.programs || [];
        const progress = data.progress || {};
        
        // Filter programs that the user has started
        const started: UserProgram[] = [];
        
        // Handle programs
         allPrograms.forEach((p: any) => {
           // Check by slug or by ID (in case data was stored with ID)
           // Use p.slug if available, otherwise fallback to p.id (stringified)
           const effectiveSlug = p.slug || String(p.id);
           
           // Try to find progress entry by effective slug, or original id/slug
           const entry = progress[effectiveSlug] || progress[p.id] || progress[p.slug];

           if (entry && entry.startedAt) {
             started.push({
               slug: effectiveSlug,
               title: p.cardTitleKey ? (t(p.cardTitleKey) || p.title) : p.title,
               description: p.cardDescriptionKey ? (t(p.cardDescriptionKey) || p.description) : p.description,
               imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
               startedAt: entry.startedAt,
               finishedAt: entry.finishedAt
             });
           }
         });
        
        setUserPrograms(started);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setUserPrograms([]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setUserProgramsLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [t]);

  const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setOrdersLoading(true);
    setOrdersError(null);
    fetch("/api/account/orders")
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(t('orders.error.load_failed'));
        }
        return res.json();

        if (cancelled) return;
        setOrders(data || []);
      })

        if (cancelled) return;
        // User requested to show empty state instead of error

      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setOrdersLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

        if (!res.ok) {
          if (res.status === 401) {
            return null;

                emailPromotions?: boolean;
                smsNotifications?: boolean;
                whatsappNotifications?: boolean;

            typeof data.emailOrders === "boolean" ? data.emailOrders : true
          );
          setSettingsEmailPromotions(
            typeof data.emailPromotions === "boolean"
              ? data.emailPromotions
              : false
          );
          setSettingsSmsNotifications(
            typeof data.smsNotifications === "boolean"
              ? data.smsNotifications
              : false
          );
          setSettingsWhatsappNotifications(
            typeof data.whatsappNotifications === "boolean"
              ? data.whatsappNotifications
              : false
          );

        if (cancelled) return;
        setSettingsError(t('settings.error.load_failed'));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setSettingsLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

          if (res.status === 401) {
            return null;

          throw new Error(t('payment.error.load_failed'));

                  const tone = getStatusTone(order.status);

                      : tone === "info"
                      ? "bg-sky-100 text-sky-800"
                      : tone === "error"
                      ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800"
                      : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800";
                  return (

                            onClick={() => {
                              setPaymentError(null);
                              setEditingPaymentId(card.id);

                              setPaymentLast4("");
                              setPaymentExpiryMonth(card.expiryMonth || "");
                              setPaymentExpiryYear(card.expiryYear || "");

                      }

                        setPaymentError(null);
                        const rawNumber = paymentLast4.replace(/\D/g, "");

                          const cvvDigits = paymentCvv.replace(/\D/g, "");

                            brand: paymentBrand,
                            expiryMonth: paymentExpiryMonth,
                            expiryYear: paymentExpiryYear,
                            isDefault: paymentIsDefault,

                          if (!editingPaymentId) {

                          }

                            {
                              method,
                              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                              body: JSON.stringify(body),
                            }
                          );
                          if (!res.ok) {

                              (data &&
                                typeof data.error === "string" &&

                              t('payment.error.save_failed');

                          setPaymentExpiryMonth("");
                          setPaymentExpiryYear("");
                          setPaymentIsDefault(false);
                          setPaymentCvv("");

                        setEditingPaymentId(null);

                        setPaymentLast4("");
                        setPaymentExpiryMonth("");
                        setPaymentExpiryYear("");
                        setPaymentIsDefault(false);
                        setShowPaymentForm(false);

                    >
                      {t('common.cancel')}

FILE: src\components\analytics\GoogleAdsConversion.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

const CONVERSION_ID = "AW-18011122927";
const CONVERSION_LABEL = "c8ZYCMq4jYgcEO_Zr4xD";
const STORAGE_KEY = "gads_conversion_sent";

/**
 * Fires Google Ads conversion event once per order when order is paid.
 * Use on order confirmation / thank-you page (e.g. account/orders/[id] when status is paid).
 */
export function GoogleAdsConversion({
  orderId,
  orderStatus,
}: {
  orderId: number;
  orderStatus: string;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (orderStatus !== "paid") return;

    const sentKey = `${STORAGE_KEY}_${orderId}`;
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    try {
      if (sessionStorage.getItem(sentKey) === "1") return;
      sessionStorage.setItem(sentKey, "1");
    } catch {
      return;
    }

    const gtag = (window as unknown as { gtag?: (...args: unknown[]) => void })
      .gtag;
    if (typeof gtag !== "function") return;

    gtag("event", "conversion", {
      send_to: `${CONVERSION_ID}/${CONVERSION_LABEL}`,
    });
  }, [orderId, orderStatus]);

  return null;
}

"use client";

import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { LocalizedLink } from "@/components/navigation/LocalizedLink";
import ProductCard from "@/components/products/ProductCard";
import SiteNavbar from "@/components/layout/SiteNavbar";
import HomeFooter from "@/components/home/HomeFooter";

type Category = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  description?: string | null;
};

type Product = {
  id: number;
  base_price: number;
  discount_percent: number;
  image_url: string | null;
  slug: string;
  rating_average?: number;
  review_count?: number;
  translations?: { field: string; value: string }[];
};

type Props = {
  category: Category;
  products: Product[];
  settings: { public_site_name?: string; site_name?: string; logo?: string; footer_phone?: string } | null;
};

export default function CategoryPageContent({ category, products, settings }: Props) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const categoryName = category.name || category.slug.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ");

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5faf7] text-emerald-950">
      <SiteNavbar initialSettings={settings} />
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10 space-y-8">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <nav className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
            <LocalizedLink href="/" className="hover:underline">{t("nav.home")}</LocalizedLink>
            <span className="mx-1">/</span>
            <LocalizedLink href="/products" className="hover:underline">{t("nav.products")}</LocalizedLink>
            <span className="mx-1">/</span>
            <span className="font-medium">{categoryName}</span>
          </nav>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">{categoryName}</h1>
          {category.description && (
            <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700 max-w-2xl">{category.description}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        {products.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-8 text-center">
            <p className="text-emerald-700">{t("categories.no_products")}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:gap-6">
            {products.map((product) => {
              const basePrice = Number(product.base_price) || 0;
              const discount = Number(product.discount_percent) || 0;
              const finalPrice = basePrice * (1 - discount / 100);
              const title = product.translations?.find((tr) => tr.field === "title")?.value || product.slug?.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ") || t("categories.product_fallback");
              return (
                <ProductCard
                  key={product.id}
                  id={product.id}
                  name={title}
                  price={finalPrice}
                  originalPrice={discount > 0 ? basePrice : null}
                  imageUrl={product.image_url}
                  slug={product.slug}
                  rating={product.rating_average}
                  reviewCount={product.review_count}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
      <HomeFooter />
    </div>
  );
}

type ChatMessage = {
  id: string;
  session_id: string;
  message: string;
  sender_type: string;
  created_at?: string;
};

function createSessionId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto) {
    return (crypto as { randomUUID?: () => string }).randomUUID?.() || "";
  }
  return (
    "chat-" +
    Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) +
    "-" +
    Date.now().toString(36)
  );
}

const FAQ_KEYS = [
  "chat.faq.q1",
  "chat.faq.q2",
  "chat.faq.q3",
  "chat.faq.q4",
  "chat.faq.q5",
];

function formatTime(dateStr?: string) {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const h = d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, "0");
  const m = d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, "0");
  return `${h}:${m}`;
}

function TypingIndicator() {

      </div>

          <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-emerald-400" style={{ animationDelay: "0ms" }} />
          <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-emerald-400" style={{ animationDelay: "150ms" }} />
          <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-emerald-400" style={{ animationDelay: "300ms" }} />
        </div>
      </div>

export default function ChatWidget() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState("");
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const [showBubble, setShowBubble] = useState(false);
  const [bubbleDismissed, setBubbleDismissed] = useState(false);
  const pollRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  // Show invite bubble after 5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open || bubbleDismissed) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setShowBubble(true), 5000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [open, bubbleDismissed]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
    const key = "sb_chat_session_id";
    const existing = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (existing && existing.trim()) {
      setSessionId(existing.trim());
      return;
    }
    const id = createSessionId();
    setSessionId(id);
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, id);
  }, []);

  const fetchMessages = useMemo(
    () =>
      async (currentSessionId: string) => {
        if (!currentSessionId) return;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(
            `/api/chat?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(currentSessionId)}`
          );
          if (!res.ok) {
            // ÆgÉ™r rate limit xÉ™tasÄ± gÉ™lsÉ™, polling-i dayandÄ±r
            if (res.status === 429) {
              if (pollRef.current) {
                window.clearInterval(pollRef.current);
                pollRef.current = null;
              }
              return;
            }
            return;
          }
          const data = (await res.json()) as { messages?: ChatMessage[] };
          const rows = Array.isArray(data.messages) ? data.messages : [];
          setMessages(rows);
        } catch {
          // XÉ™ta zamanÄ± polling-i dayandÄ±rma, sadÉ™cÉ™ ignore et
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !sessionId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    fetchMessages(sessionId);
    if (pollRef.current) {
      window.clearInterval(pollRef.current);
      pollRef.current = null;
    }
    pollRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      fetchMessages(sessionId);
    }, 15000); // 15 saniyÉ™ interval (É™vvÉ™l 5 saniyÉ™ idi)
    return () => {
      if (pollRef.current) {
        window.clearInterval(pollRef.current);
        pollRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [open, sessionId, fetchMessages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!listRef.current) return;
    listRef.current.scrollTop = listRef.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [messages, open, isTyping]);

  const sendMessage = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim() || !sessionId) return;
    setSending(true);
    setIsTyping(false);

    // Optimistic: add user message instantly
    const tempUserMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `temp-${Date.now()}`,
      session_id: sessionId,
      message: text.trim(),
      sender_type: "user",
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, tempUserMsg]);
    setInput("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/chat", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          sessionId,
          message: text.trim(),
          sender: "user",
          locale: locale, // Send current locale to API
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        // Show typing indicator
        setIsTyping(true);
        // Fetch updated messages (includes AI response)
        // Wait a bit for realistic feel then poll
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
        await fetchMessages(sessionId);
        // Keep polling for the AI response
        let attempts = 0;
        const checkForResponse = async () => {
          attempts++;
          const checkRes = await fetch(`/api/chat?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`);
          if (checkRes.ok) {
            const data = await checkRes.json();
            const rows = Array.isArray(data.messages) ? data.messages : [];
            setMessages(rows);
            const lastMsg = rows[rows.length - 1];
            if (lastMsg && lastMsg.sender_type !== "user") {
              setIsTyping(false);
              return;
            }
          }
          if (attempts < 15) {
            setTimeout(checkForResponse, 1500);
          } else {
            setIsTyping(false);
          }
        };
        checkForResponse();
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }, [sessionId, fetchMessages]);

  const handleSend = async () => {
    await sendMessage(input);
  };

  const handleFAQ = async (question: string) => {
    await sendMessage(question);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  const hasMessages = messages.length > 0;

  if ((pathname || "").startsWith("/admin")) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Invite Bubble */}
      {showBubble && !open && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-20 right-5 z-40 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-500">
          <div className="relative max-w-[260px] rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 shadow-xl border border-emerald-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setShowBubble(false); setBubbleDismissed(true); }}
              className="absolute -top-2 -right-2 flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 text-[10px] hover:bg-slate-300"
            >
              Ã—
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow">
                  A
                </div>
                <span className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-green-400" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{t("chat.operator_name")}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 font-medium">{t("chat.online")}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
              {t("chat.bubble_message")}
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setOpen(true); setShowBubble(false); setBubbleDismissed(true); }}
              className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors"
            >
              {t("chat.start_chat")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {/* Triangle pointer */}
          <div className="absolute -bottom-2 right-8 h-4 w-4 rotate-45 bg-white border-r border-b border-emerald-100" />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Chat Toggle Button - mobil gÃ¶rÃ¼nÃ¼ÅŸdÉ™ navbar-dan yuxarÄ±da */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => { setOpen((prev) => !prev); setShowBubble(false); setBubbleDismissed(true); }}
        className={`fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-5 right-5 z-40 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 ${

import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const SpeedInsightsInner = dynamic(

    import("@vercel/speed-insights/next")
      .then((m) => m.SpeedInsights)
      .catch(() => () => null),
  { ssr: false }
);

const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";

export default function SpeedInsightsWrapper() {
  const [canLoad, setCanLoad] = useState(isProd);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isProd) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setCanLoad(true), 100);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);

  if (!canLoad) return null;
  return <SpeedInsightsInner />;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, Info, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";

type ToastProps = {
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "info";
  duration?: number;
  onClose?: () => void;
};

export function Toast({ message, type = "success", duration = 3000, onClose }: ToastProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const isTranslationKey = /^(notification|cart|wishlist|programs|product|auth|common)\./.test(message);
  const displayMessage = isTranslationKey ? t(message) : message;
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setVisible(false);
      setTimeout(() => onClose?.(), 300); // Wait for animation
    }, duration);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [duration, onClose]);

  if (!visible) return null;

  const bgColor =
    type === "success"
      ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900"
      : type === "error"
      ? "bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-900"
      : "bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-900";

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 shadow-lg max-w-[90vw] sm:max-w-md animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-5 fade-in duration-300 ${bgColor}`}
    >
      {type === "success" && <CheckCircle2 size={20} className="text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />}
      {type === "error" && <XCircle size={20} className="text-red-600 shrink-0" />}
      {type === "info" && <Info size={20} className="text-blue-600 shrink-0" />}
      <span className="text-sm font-medium flex-1">{displayMessage}</span>
      <button
        onClick={() => {
          setVisible(false);
          setTimeout(() => onClose?.(), 300);
        }}
        className="text-current opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0"
      >
        <X size={16} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

type ToastManagerProps = {
  toasts: Array<{ id: string; message: string; type?: "success" | "error" | "info" }>;
  onRemove: (id: string) => void;
};

export function ToastManager({ toasts, onRemove }: ToastManagerProps) {
  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 items-center pointer-events-none">
      {toasts.map((toast) => (
        <div key={toast.id} className="pointer-events-auto">
          <Toast
            message={toast.message}
            type={toast.type}
            onClose={() => onRemove(toast.id)}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { LocalizedLink } from "@/components/navigation/LocalizedLink";
import { ArrowRight, BookOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";

type BlogPost = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  excerpt: string;
  body: string;
  category: string;
  slug: string;
  image_url: string;
  is_pinned: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  title_font_size?: string;
  title_font_weight?: string;
  excerpt_font_size?: string;
  excerpt_font_weight?: string;
  body_font_size?: string;
  body_font_weight?: string;
};

const CATEGORY_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  "SaÄŸlam hÉ™yat tÉ™rzi": "bg-emerald-600",
  "SaÄŸlam qidalanma": "bg-orange-500",
  "Enerji vÉ™ gÃ¼ndelik performans": "bg-blue-600",
  "Derinin qorunmasÄ± ve genc qalma": "bg-pink-600",
  "Metabolizma vÉ™ Ã§É™ki idarÉ™si": "bg-purple-600",
  "Stress idarÉ™etmÉ™si": "bg-red-500",
};

function getCategoryColor(category: string) {
  if (CATEGORY_COLORS[category]) return CATEGORY_COLORS[category];
  // Generate a consistent color from the string
  const colors = [
    "bg-emerald-600",
    "bg-orange-500",
    "bg-blue-600",
    "bg-pink-600",
    "bg-purple-600",
    "bg-red-500",
    "bg-teal-600",
    "bg-amber-600",
  ];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < category.length; i++) {
    hash = category.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
}

export default function BlogSection() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<BlogPost[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch(`/api/content/posts?locale=${locale}`)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setPosts(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setPosts([]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [locale]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-950">
            {t("blog.title")}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">
            {t("blog.subtitle")}
          </p>

              <div className="mt-2 h-3 w-2/3 rounded bg-emerald-100" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (posts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";

type FAQItem = {
  id: number;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
};

export default function FAQSection() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const [faqs, setFaqs] = useState<FAQItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch(`/api/content/faqs?locale=${locale}`)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
      .then((data) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setFaqs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setFaqs([]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [locale]);

  const toggle = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setOpenId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <section className="space-y-6">
        <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-950 text-center">
          {t("faq.title")}
        </h2>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="animate-pulse rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4"
            >
              <div className="h-4 w-3/4 rounded bg-slate-200" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (faqs.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-950 text-center">
        {t("faq.title")}
      </h2>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {faqs.map((faq) => {
          const isOpen = openId === faq.id;
          return (
            <div
              key={faq.id}
              className={`rounded-xl border transition-all duration-200 ${
                isOpen
                  ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40 shadow-sm"
                  : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-emerald-100 hover:shadow-sm"
              }`}
            >
              {/* Question */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggle(faq.id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-5 py-4 text-left"
              >
                <ChevronRight
                  size={18}
                  className={`shrink-0 text-emerald-600 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                    isOpen ? "rotate-90" : ""
                  }`}
                />
                <span
                  className={`text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                    isOpen ? "text-emerald-800" : "text-slate-700"
                  }`}
                >
                  {faq.question}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Answer */}
              <div
                className={`overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isOpen ? "max-h-96 opacity-100" : "max-h-0 opacity-0"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="px-5 pb-4 pl-11">
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                    {faq.answer}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { LocalizedLink } from "@/components/navigation/LocalizedLink";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import ProductCard from "@/components/products/ProductCard";

type FeaturedProduct = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  originalPrice?: number | null;
  tag?: "popular" | "new" | null;
  imageUrl?: string | null;
  slug?: string;
  rating?: number;
  reviewCount?: number;
  /** BÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™rdÉ™ mÉ™tn axtarÄ±ÅŸÄ± (slug + tÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™lÉ™r) */
  searchBlob?: string;
};

type FeaturedProductsSectionProps = {
  products: FeaturedProduct[];
};

export default function FeaturedProductsSection({
  products,
}: FeaturedProductsSectionProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // URL-dÉ™n search query-ni oxu (dil dÉ™yiÅŸÉ™ndÉ™ vÉ™ ilk yÃ¼kdÉ™)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const q = params.get("search") || "";
      setSearchQuery(q);
    }
  }, [pathname]);

  // AxtarÄ±ÅŸ nÉ™ticÉ™lÉ™rini filter et
  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      return products;
    }
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return products.filter((p) => {
      const name = p.name?.toLowerCase() || "";
      const slug = p.slug?.toLowerCase() || "";
      const blob = p.searchBlob || "";
      return (
        blob.includes(q) ||
        name.includes(q) ||
        slug.includes(q) ||
        slug.replace(/-/g, " ").includes(q.replace(/-/g, " "))
      );
    });
  }, [products, searchQuery]);

  // Global search event listener (SiteNavbar-dan gÉ™lÉ™n axtarÄ±ÅŸ)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleSearch = (e: CustomEvent<string>) => {
      setSearchQuery(e.detail);
    };
    window.addEventListener("homepage-search" as any, handleSearch as EventListener);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("homepage-search" as any, handleSearch as EventListener);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="flex-1">
          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
            {t("home.featured.title")}
          </h2>
          {searchQuery && (
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-emerald-700 mt-1">
              {t("home.featured.products_found", { count: filteredProducts.length, query: searchQuery })}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <LocalizedLink
          href="/products"
          className="text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-base font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-900 whitespace-nowrap"
        >
          {t("home.featured.view_all")} â†’
</LocalizedLink>
        </div>
      {filteredProducts.length === 0 && searchQuery ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-emerald-700">
            {t("home.featured.no_products_for", { query: searchQuery })}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3">
          {filteredProducts.map((p) => (
            <ProductCard
              key={p.id}
              id={p.id}
              name={p.name}
              price={p.price}
              originalPrice={p.originalPrice}
              tag={p.tag}
              imageUrl={p.imageUrl}
              slug={p.slug}
              rating={p.rating}
              reviewCount={p.reviewCount}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\home\HeroSection.tsx

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { LocalizedLink } from "@/components/navigation/LocalizedLink";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

export type HeroSlide = {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  button_text: string;
  button_link: string;
  image_url: string;
  image_position?: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  sort_order: number;
  locale?: string;
};

// Default slide data when no slides from DB
const DEFAULT_SLIDES: HeroSlide[] = [
  {
    id: 0,
    title: "",
    subtitle: "",
    button_text: "",
    button_link: "/products",
    image_url: "",
    is_active: true,
    sort_order: 0,
  },
];

export default function HeroSection({
  brandName,
  sectionData,
  slides: externalSlides,
}: {
  brandName?: string;
  sectionData?: { title?: string; subtitle?: string; buttonText?: string };
  slides?: HeroSlide[];
}) {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const heroTitleFallback = (brandName && brandName.trim()) || t("hero.title");

  const slides =
    externalSlides && externalSlides.length > 0
      ? externalSlides
      : DEFAULT_SLIDES;

  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [isTransitioning, setIsTransitioning] = useState(false);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const goTo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      if (isTransitioning) return;
      setIsTransitioning(true);
      setCurrent(index);
      setTimeout(() => setIsTransitioning(false), 600);
    },
    [isTransitioning]
  );

  const goNext = useCallback(() => {
    goTo((current + 1) % slides.length);
  }, [current, slides.length, goTo]);

  const goPrev = useCallback(() => {
    goTo((current - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length);
  }, [current, slides.length, goTo]);

  // Auto-play
  useEffect(() => {
    if (slides.length <= 1) return;
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(goNext, 5000);
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [goNext, slides.length]);

  const activeSlide = slides[current];

  // HÉ™r slaydÄ±n Ã¶z baÅŸlÄ±q/mÉ™tn/dÃ¼ymÉ™si olsun; boÅŸdursa bÃ¶lmÉ™ vÉ™ ya tÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™ fallback
  const slideLocale = activeSlide.locale;
  const slideMatchesLocale = slideLocale && slideLocale === locale;
  const useTranslatedContent = !slideMatchesLocale;

  const title =
    (activeSlide.title && activeSlide.title.trim()) ||
    (useTranslatedContent ? heroTitleFallback : (sectionData?.title || heroTitleFallback));
  const subtitle =
    (activeSlide.subtitle && activeSlide.subtitle.trim()) ||
    (useTranslatedContent ? t("hero.subtitle") : (sectionData?.subtitle || t("hero.subtitle")));
  const buttonText =
    (activeSlide.button_text && activeSlide.button_text.trim()) ||
    (useTranslatedContent ? t("hero.cta_secondary") : (sectionData?.buttonText || t("hero.cta_secondary")));
  const buttonLink = (activeSlide.button_link && activeSlide.button_link.trim()) || "/products";
  const bgImage = activeSlide.image_url;

  return (
    <section className="hidden md:block relative w-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Slides */}
      <div className="relative min-h-[600px] md:min-h-[780px]">
        {/* YalnÄ±z aktiv slayd render olunur: eyni anda Ã§ox ÅŸÉ™kil yÃ¼klÉ™nmÉ™sinin qarÅŸÄ±sÄ±nÄ± alÄ±r */}
        <div
          key={activeSlide.id}
          className="absolute inset-0 z-10 opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-700 ease-in-out"
        >
          {/* Background Image - next/image ilÉ™ optimallaÅŸdÄ±rÄ±lmÄ±ÅŸ */}
          {activeSlide.image_url ? (
            <div className="absolute inset-0">
              <Image
                src={activeSlide.image_url}
                alt={activeSlide.title || t("common.hero_alt")}
                fill
                className="object-cover object-center"
                style={{
                  objectPosition: activeSlide.image_position || "center center",
                }}
                priority={current === 0}
                sizes="100vw"
                quality={85}
              />
              {/* Overlay - darker on left for text readability */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/50 via-black/20 to-transparent" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 via-emerald-100/50 to-white" />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Content - always on top; key ensures text/buttons update when slide changes */}
        <div key={`hero-content-${current}`} className="relative z-20 flex min-h-[600px] md:min-h-[780px] items-center">
          <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-8 md:px-12">
            {/* Left - Text Overlay */}
            <div className="max-w-2xl">
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <h1
                  className={`text-4xl font-bold leading-tight md:text-6xl transition-all duration-500 ${
                    bgImage ? "text-white" : "text-emerald-950"
                  }`}
                >
                  {title}
                </h1>
                <p
                  className={`max-w-xl text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed transition-all duration-500 ${
                    bgImage ? "text-white" : "text-emerald-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {subtitle}
                </p>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 pt-2">
                  <LocalizedLink
                    href={buttonLink}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-8 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg transition-colors ${
                      bgImage
                        ? "bg-white text-black hover:bg-emerald-50"
                        : "bg-emerald-700 text-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {buttonText}
                  </LocalizedLink>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Navigation Arrows */}
        {slides.length > 1 && (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={goPrev}
              className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 z-30 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-white/20 p-2 text-white transition-all hover:bg-white/40"
              aria-label={t("hero.prev_slide")}
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={24} />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={goNext}
              className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 z-30 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-white/20 p-2 text-white transition-all hover:bg-white/40"
              aria-label={t("hero.next_slide")}
            >
              <ChevronRight size={24} />
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Dots */}
        {slides.length > 1 && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 z-30 flex -translate-x-1/2 gap-2">
            {slides.map((_, idx) => (
              <button
                key={idx}
                onClick={() => goTo(idx)}
                className={`h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                  idx === current
                    ? "w-8 bg-white"
                    : "w-2.5 bg-white/40 hover:bg-white/60"
                }`}
                aria-label={`${t("hero.slide")} ${idx + 1}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { LocalizedLink } from "@/components/navigation/LocalizedLink";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useI18n } from "@/contexts/I18nContext";
import { useSiteSettings } from "@/contexts/SiteSettingsContext";
import { Clock, ArrowRight, ImageOff } from "lucide-react";

type ProgramCard = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  duration: string;
  price: number;
  title_font_size?: string;
  title_font_weight?: string;
  description_font_size?: string;
  description_font_weight?: string;
};

export default function ProgramsSection() {
  const { t, locale } = useI18n();
  const { hidePrices } = useSiteSettings();
  const [programs, setPrograms] = useState<ProgramCard[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    fetch(`/api/content/programs?locale=${locale}`)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : []))
      .then((rows) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
        const mapped: ProgramCard[] = list
          .filter((row) => row.is_active !== false)
          .map((row) => ({
            id: String(row.id),
            slug: row.slug || String(row.id),
            title: row.title || "",
            description: row.description || "",
            imageUrl: row.image_url || "",
            duration: row.duration || "",
            price: Number(row.price) || 0,
            title_font_size: row.title_font_size,
            title_font_weight: row.title_font_weight,
            description_font_size: row.description_font_size,
            description_font_weight: row.description_font_weight,
          }))
          .slice(0, 3);
        setPrograms(mapped);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setPrograms([]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!active) return;
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [locale]);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6 rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-[#e6f3ec] px-6 py-8 md:px-10 md:py-10">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-semibold text-emerald-950">
            {t("home.programs.title")}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-emerald-700">
            {t("home.programs.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <LocalizedLink
          href="/programs"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-400/60 bg-white px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
        >
          {t("home.programs.view_all")}
          <span>â†’</span>
        </LocalizedLink>
      </div>
      {loading && (
        <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">{t("programs.loading")}</p>
      )}
      {!loading && programs.length === 0 && (
        <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
          {t("programs.empty")}
        </p>
      )}
      {!loading && programs.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3">
          {programs.map((program) => (
            <ProgramCardItem key={program.id} program={program} hidePrices={hidePrices} t={t} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function ProgramCardItem({ program, hidePrices, t }: { program: ProgramCard; hidePrices: boolean; t: (key: string) => string }) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);

  return (
    <LocalizedLink
      href={`/programs/${program.slug}`}
      className="group block overflow-hidden rounded-2xl shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-xl"
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full aspect-[3/4] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#f1f8f4]"
        onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)}
      >
        {/* Full-card image */}
        {program.imageUrl ? (
          <Image
            src={program.imageUrl}
            alt={program.title}
            fill
            className={`object-cover transition-transform duration-500 ease-out ${
              hovered ? "scale-110" : "scale-100"
            }`}
            sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 33vw"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-100 to-emerald-200">
            <ImageOff size={48} className="text-emerald-300" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Top badges */}
        {program.duration && (
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-20">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-white shadow-md">
              <Clock size={12} />
              {program.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {!hidePrices && (
          <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-20">
            {program.price === 0 ? (
              <span className="inline-flex rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-md">
                {t("common.free")}
              </span>
            ) : program.price > 0 ? (

FILE: src\components\home\WeightCalculatorSection.tsx
