"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { getSupabaseBrowserClient } from "@/lib/supabase-browser";

type SiteSettingsCtx = {
  hidePrices: boolean;
  hidePoints: boolean;
  isLoggedIn: boolean;
};

const SiteSettingsContext = createContext<SiteSettingsCtx>({
  hidePrices: false,
  hidePoints: false,
  isLoggedIn: false,
});

export function SiteSettingsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SiteSettingsCtx>({
    hidePrices: false,
    hidePoints: false,
    isLoggedIn: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = getSupabaseBrowserClient();

    const loadSettings = async (loggedIn: boolean) => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/admin/settings/visibility");
        const data = res.ok ? await res.json() : null;

        setSettings({
          // QeydiyyatlÄ± istifadÉ™Ã§ilÉ™r hÉ™miÅŸÉ™ qiymÉ™t vÉ™ xallarÄ± gÃ¶rÃ¼r
          hidePrices: loggedIn ? false : !!(data?.hide_prices),
          hidePoints: loggedIn ? false : !!(data?.hide_points),
          isLoggedIn: loggedIn,
        });
      } catch {
        setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, isLoggedIn: loggedIn }));
      }
    };

    // Ä°lkin yÃ¼klÉ™nmÉ™
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      loadSettings(!!data?.user);
    });

    // Auth dÉ™yiÅŸikliklÉ™rinÉ™ abunÉ™lik (giriÅŸ/Ã§Ä±xÄ±ÅŸ zamanÄ± dÉ™rhal reaksiya ver)
    const { data: listener } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      loadSettings(!!session?.user);
    });

    return () => {
      listener.subscription.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <SiteSettingsContext.Provider value={settings}>
      {children}
    </SiteSettingsContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useSiteSettings() {
  return useContext(SiteSettingsContext);

"use client";
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Product } from "@/types";

type WishlistContextValue = {
  items: Product[];
  add: (product: Product) => void;
  remove: (productId: string) => void;
  has: (productId: string) => boolean;
};

const WishlistContext = createContext<WishlistContextValue | undefined>(
  undefined
);

const STORAGE_KEY = "eshop_wishlist";

export function WishlistProvider({ 
  children,
  showToast 
}: { 
  children: React.ReactNode;
  showToast?: (message: string, type?: "success" | "error" | "info") => void;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Product[]>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
    } catch {}
  }, [items]);

  const add = (product: Product) => {
    setItems((prev) => {
      if (prev.find((p) => p.id === product.id)) return prev;
      return [...prev, product];
    });
    // Show toast notification
    if (showToast) {
      showToast("notification.added_to_wishlist", "success");
    }
  };

  const remove = (productId: string) => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== productId));
  };

  const has = (productId: string) => items.some((p) => p.id === productId);

  return (
    <WishlistContext.Provider value={{ items, add, remove, has }}>
      {children}
    </WishlistContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useWishlist() {
  const ctx = useContext(WishlistContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("WishlistContext not found");
  return ctx;
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT DEFAULT 'user', -- 'admin' vÉ™ ya 'user'
  full_name TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  city TEXT,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  cover_url TEXT,
  program_progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  default_currency currency_code DEFAULT 'AZN',

-- MÃ¶vcud cÉ™dvÉ™l Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n É™skik sÃ¼tunlarÄ± É™lavÉ™ et (mÃ¶vcud cÉ™dvÉ™llÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
-- QEYD: Bu sÃ¼tunlar CREATE TABLE-dan sonra iÅŸlÉ™yir vÉ™ mÃ¶vcud cÉ™dvÉ™llÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n lazÄ±mi sÃ¼tunlarÄ± É™lavÉ™ edir
DO $$ 
BEGIN
  -- Role sÃ¼tunu (É™n vacibdir, Ã§Ã¼nki policies-dÉ™ istifadÉ™ olunur)
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
    AND table_name = 'profiles' 
    AND column_name = 'role'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN role TEXT DEFAULT 'user';
  END IF;
  
  -- DigÉ™r sÃ¼tunlar
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS full_name TEXT;
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS phone TEXT;
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS city TEXT;
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar_url TEXT;
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cover_url TEXT;
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS program_progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
  
  -- default_currency Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n type yoxlamasÄ±
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'currency_code') THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_currency currency_code DEFAULT 'AZN';
  ELSE
    ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_currency TEXT DEFAULT 'AZN';
  END IF;
  
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW();
  ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW();
END $$;

-- Indexes (role sÃ¼tunu mÃ¶vcud olduqdan sonra)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS profiles_city_idx ON public.profiles(city);

-- Drop existing policies
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public profiles are viewable by everyone." ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can insert their own profile." ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can update own profile." ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can view own profile" ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can view all profiles" ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can update all profiles" ON public.profiles;

-- Policies
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK ( auth.uid() = id );

CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING ( auth.uid() = id );

CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE
  USING ( auth.uid() = id );

CREATE POLICY "Admins can view all profiles"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING ( 
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY "Admins can update all profiles"
  ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE
  USING ( 
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.categories (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,

BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'content_ads' AND column_name = 'link_url'
  ) THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'content_ads' AND column_name = 'link'
    ) THEN
      ALTER TABLE public.content_ads RENAME COLUMN link TO link_url;
    ELSE
      ALTER TABLE public.content_ads ADD COLUMN link_url TEXT DEFAULT '';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 25. TRÄ°GGER FUNKSÄ°YALARI (TRIGGER FUNCTIONS)

-- Updated_at trigger funksiyasÄ±
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = NOW();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Yeni istifadÉ™Ã§i Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n profil yaratma triggeri
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, role, full_name, phone, city, avatar_url, cover_url)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'user'),
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'city',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'cover_url'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- Marketing activity funksiyasÄ±
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_marketing_activity()
RETURNS JSON AS $$
DECLARE
  recent_profiles JSON;
  recent_orders JSON;
  orders_exist BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  -- Check if orders table exists
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM information_schema.tables 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders'
  ) INTO orders_exist;

  -- Get profiles (safe fields only)
  SELECT json_agg(t) INTO recent_profiles
  FROM (
    SELECT full_name, city, created_at
    FROM public.profiles
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) t;

  -- Get orders if table exists
  IF orders_exist THEN
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE '
        SELECT json_agg(t)
        FROM (
          SELECT 
            o.id, 
            o.created_at, 
            o.total, 
            json_build_object(''full_name'', p.full_name, ''city'', p.city) as profiles
          FROM public.orders o
          LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON o.user_id = p.id
          WHERE o.status = ''paid''
          ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
          LIMIT 5
        ) t'
      INTO recent_orders;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      recent_orders := '[]'::json;
    END;
  ELSE
    recent_orders := '[]'::json;
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'profiles', COALESCE(recent_profiles, '[]'::json),
    'orders', COALESCE(recent_orders, '[]'::json)
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

  USING ( bucket_id = 'profiles' );

  ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK ( bucket_id = 'profiles' AND auth.uid() = owner );

  ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE
  USING ( bucket_id = 'profiles' AND auth.uid() = owner );

  ON storage.objects FOR DELETE
  USING ( bucket_id = 'profiles' AND auth.uid() = owner );

VALUES ('content', 'content', true) 
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET public = true;

  FOR SELECT USING (bucket_id = 'content');

  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (
    bucket_id = 'content' AND
    auth.role() = 'authenticated'
  );

  FOR UPDATE USING (
    bucket_id = 'content' AND
    auth.role() = 'authenticated'
  );

  FOR DELETE USING (
    bucket_id = 'content' AND
    auth.role() = 'authenticated'
  );

-- Featured Products View
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.featured_products_view AS
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.slug,
  p.name,
  p.category_id,
  p.program_id,
  p.base_price,
  p.discount_percent,
  p.stock,
  p.points,
  p.is_active,
  p.is_featured,
  p.homepage_order,
  p.weight_goal_tag,
  p.image_url,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at,
  COALESCE(rev.rating_average, 0) as rating_average,
  COALESCE(rev.review_count, 0) as review_count
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    AVG(rating)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
    COUNT(*)::int as review_count
  FROM public.reviews
  GROUP BY product_id
) rev ON p.id = rev.product_id
WHERE p.is_featured = true 
  AND p.is_active = true
ORDER BY p.homepage_order ASC, p.created_at DESC;

ALTER VIEW public.featured_products_view SET (security_invoker = true);

-- Featured Categories View
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.featured_categories_view AS
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.slug,
  c.name,
  c.icon,
  c.description,
  c.image_url,
  c.parent_id,
  c.is_featured,
  c.homepage_order,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)::int as product_count
FROM public.categories c
LEFT JOIN public.products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.is_active = true
WHERE c.is_featured = true
GROUP BY c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.icon, c.description, c.image_url, 
         c.parent_id, c.is_featured, c.homepage_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at
ORDER BY c.homepage_order ASC, c.created_at DESC;

ALTER VIEW public.featured_categories_view SET (security_invoker = true);

-- Featured Products Function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_featured_products(limit_count INT DEFAULT 12)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id BIGINT,
  slug TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  category_id BIGINT,
  program_id BIGINT,
  base_price NUMERIC,
  discount_percent NUMERIC,
  stock INT,
  points NUMERIC,
  is_active BOOLEAN,
  is_featured BOOLEAN,
  homepage_order INT,
  weight_goal_tag TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  rating_average NUMERIC,
  review_count INT
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    p.slug,
    p.name,
    p.category_id,
    p.program_id,
    p.base_price,
    p.discount_percent,
    p.stock,
    p.points,
    p.is_active,
    p.is_featured,
    p.homepage_order,
    p.weight_goal_tag,
    p.image_url,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    COALESCE(rev.rating_average, 0)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
    COALESCE(rev.review_count, 0)::int as review_count
  FROM public.products p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      product_id,
      AVG(rating)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
      COUNT(*)::int as review_count
    FROM public.reviews
    GROUP BY product_id
  ) rev ON p.id = rev.product_id
  WHERE p.is_featured = true 
    AND p.is_active = true
  ORDER BY p.homepage_order ASC, p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT limit_count;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- Featured Categories Function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_featured_categories(limit_count INT DEFAULT 8)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id BIGINT,
  slug TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  icon TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  parent_id BIGINT,
  is_featured BOOLEAN,
  homepage_order INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  product_count INT
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.slug,
    c.name,
    c.icon,
    c.description,
    c.image_url,
    c.parent_id,
    c.is_featured,
    c.homepage_order,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)::int as product_count
  FROM public.categories c
  LEFT JOIN public.products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.is_active = true
  WHERE c.is_featured = true
  GROUP BY c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.icon, c.description, c.image_url, 
           c.parent_id, c.is_featured, c.homepage_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at
  ORDER BY c.homepage_order ASC, c.created_at DESC
  LIMIT limit_count;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

  target_email TEXT := 'herbaformadaqal2026@gmail.com'; -- BURANI DÆYÄ°ÅžÄ°N
  user_id UUID;

    RAISE NOTICE 'Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i tapÄ±lmadÄ±: %', target_email;

      user_id,

      'admin'

-- 1. Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§ini tapmaq
DO $$
DECLARE
  target_email TEXT := 'herbaformadaqal2026@gmail.com';
  user_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT id INTO user_id FROM auth.users WHERE email = target_email;

  IF user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i tapÄ±lmadÄ±: %', target_email;
  ELSE
    -- 2. Profili yenilÉ™mÉ™k (vÉ™ ya yaratmaq)
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role)
    VALUES (
      user_id, 
      COALESCE((SELECT raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name' FROM auth.users WHERE id = user_id), target_email),
      'admin'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
    SET role = 'admin';
    
    RAISE NOTICE 'Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i (% - %) profili ADMIN olaraq yenilÉ™ndi.', target_email, user_id;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 3. NÉ™ticÉ™ni yoxlamaq
SELECT u.email, p.role 
FROM auth.users u
LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON u.id = p.id
WHERE u.email = 'herbaformadaqal2026@gmail.com';

-- ==============================================================================
-- SUPABASE: HERO SLIDES (Æsas sÉ™hifÉ™ slaydlarÄ±)
-- Bu skripti Supabase Dashboard â†’ SQL Editor-dÉ™ iÅŸÉ™ salÄ±n.
-- Slayd mÉ™lumatlarÄ± DB-dÉ™ saxlanÄ±lÄ±r vÉ™ É™sas sÉ™hifÉ™dÉ™ dilÉ™ gÃ¶rÉ™ gÃ¶stÉ™rilir.
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1) updated_at avtomatik yenilÉ™nmÉ™si Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n funksiya (yoxdursa yaradÄ±lÄ±r)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = NOW();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- 2) Hero slides cÉ™dvÉ™li (yoxdursa yaradÄ±lÄ±r)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.hero_slides (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  subtitle TEXT DEFAULT '',
  button_text TEXT DEFAULT '',
  button_link TEXT DEFAULT '/products',
  image_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  image_position TEXT DEFAULT 'center center',
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  sort_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'az' CHECK (locale IN ('az', 'en', 'tr', 'ru')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3) ÆgÉ™r cÉ™dvÉ™l artÄ±q varsa, É™lavÉ™ sÃ¼tunlar (migration kimi)
ALTER TABLE public.hero_slides
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS image_position TEXT DEFAULT 'center center';
ALTER TABLE public.hero_slides
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'az';

UPDATE public.hero_slides SET image_position = 'center center' WHERE image_position IS NULL;
UPDATE public.hero_slides SET locale = 'az' WHERE locale IS NULL OR locale = '';

-- Locale constraint (kÃ¶hnÉ™ varsa silib yenidÉ™n É™lavÉ™ et)
ALTER TABLE public.hero_slides DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS hero_slides_locale_check;
ALTER TABLE public.hero_slides
  ADD CONSTRAINT hero_slides_locale_check CHECK (locale IN ('az', 'en', 'tr', 'ru'));

-- 4) RLS (Row Level Security)
ALTER TABLE public.hero_slides ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public read access" ON public.hero_slides;
CREATE POLICY "Public read access" ON public.hero_slides
  FOR SELECT USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can manage hero_slides" ON public.hero_slides;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage hero_slides" ON public.hero_slides
  FOR ALL
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

-- 5) Ä°ndekslÉ™r (sÉ™hifÉ™dÉ™ dilÉ™ gÃ¶rÉ™ sÄ±ralÄ± gÃ¶stÉ™rmÉ™k Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hero_slides_active_order_idx
  ON public.hero_slides(is_active, sort_order);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hero_slides_locale_active_order_idx
  ON public.hero_slides(locale, is_active, sort_order);

-- 6) updated_at trigger
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS hero_slides_updated_at ON public.hero_slides;
CREATE TRIGGER hero_slides_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.hero_slides
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();

-- 7) Ä°cazÉ™lÉ™r
GRANT SELECT ON public.hero_slides TO anon, authenticated;
GRANT ALL ON public.hero_slides TO authenticated;

-- 8) PostgREST schema cache (Supabase API yenilÉ™nmÉ™si Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n)
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

FILE: src\db\migrations\create_chat_messages_table.sql

-- Chat Messages table for customer support chat widget
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.chat_messages (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  sender_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sender_type IN ('user', 'admin')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Index for faster queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages_session_id_idx ON public.chat_messages(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages_created_at_idx ON public.chat_messages(created_at);

-- Enable RLS
ALTER TABLE public.chat_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Policies
-- Everyone can insert messages (for chat widget)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public insert access" ON public.chat_messages;
CREATE POLICY "Public insert access" ON public.chat_messages
  FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- Everyone can read messages from their session
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public read own session" ON public.chat_messages;
CREATE POLICY "Public read own session" ON public.chat_messages
  FOR SELECT
  USING (true); -- Allow reading all messages for now (session-based filtering is done in application code)

-- Admins can read all messages
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admin read all" ON public.chat_messages;
CREATE POLICY "Admin read all" ON public.chat_messages
  FOR SELECT
  USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

-- Trigger to create profile on user signup
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, role, full_name, phone, city, avatar_url, cover_url)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'user'),
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'city',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'cover_url'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- Trigger execution
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.handle_new_user();

-- 2. CONTENT_ADS - link_url, is_active sÃ¼tunlarÄ±nÄ± É™lavÉ™ et, link sÃ¼tununu link_url-É™ Ã§evir
-- ÆgÉ™r link sÃ¼tunu varsa, link_url yaradÄ±lÄ±b dÉ™yÉ™rlÉ™r kÃ¶Ã§Ã¼rÃ¼lÃ¼r

BEGIN
  -- link_url sÃ¼tunu yoxdursa É™lavÉ™ et
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'content_ads' AND column_name = 'link_url'
  ) THEN
    -- ÆgÉ™r link sÃ¼tunu varsa, onu link_url-É™ rename et
    IF EXISTS (

      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'content_ads' AND column_name = 'link'
    ) THEN
      ALTER TABLE public.content_ads RENAME COLUMN link TO link_url;
    ELSE
      ALTER TABLE public.content_ads ADD COLUMN link_url TEXT DEFAULT '';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ 
DECLARE 
  r RECORD;
BEGIN 
  FOR r IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public') LOOP 
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public read access" ON public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename); 
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admin full access" ON public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename); 
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "User own access" ON public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename); 
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public can view products" ON public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename);
    EXECUTE 'DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Authenticated can manage products" ON public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename);
  END LOOP; 
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name, role)
  VALUES (new.id, new.email, new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 'user');
  RETURN new;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.handle_new_user();

-- 0. Create profiles table if it doesn't exist (Fix for "relation does not exist" error)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT DEFAULT 'user',
  full_name TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  city TEXT,
  avatar_url TEXT,
  cover_url TEXT,
  program_progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 1. Ensure all columns exist (for existing tables)
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role TEXT DEFAULT 'user';
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS city TEXT;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS program_progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;

-- 2. Create function to get marketing activity (bypassing RLS)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_marketing_activity()
RETURNS JSON AS $$
DECLARE
  recent_profiles JSON;
  recent_orders JSON;
  orders_exist BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  -- Check if orders table exists
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT FROM information_schema.tables 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders'
  ) INTO orders_exist;

  -- Get profiles (safe fields only)
  SELECT json_agg(t) INTO recent_profiles
  FROM (
    SELECT full_name, city, created_at
    FROM public.profiles
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) t;

  -- Get orders if table exists
  IF orders_exist THEN
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE '
        SELECT json_agg(t)
        FROM (
          SELECT 
            o.id, 
            o.created_at, 
            o.total, 
            json_build_object(''full_name'', p.full_name, ''city'', p.city) as profiles
          FROM public.orders o
          LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON o.user_id = p.id
          WHERE o.status = ''paid''
          ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
          LIMIT 5
        ) t'
      INTO recent_orders;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      recent_orders := '[]'::json;
    END;
  ELSE
    recent_orders := '[]'::json;
  END IF;

  RETURN json_build_object(
    'profiles', COALESCE(recent_profiles, '[]'::json),
    'orders', COALESCE(recent_orders, '[]'::json)
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- 3. Update RLS Policies
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Drop existing public policy (if exists)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public profiles are viewable by everyone." ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can view own profile" ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can view all profiles" ON public.profiles;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can update all profiles" ON public.profiles;

-- Create new policies
-- Users can insert their own profile
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Users can view their own profile
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Users can update their own profile
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile"
  ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE
  USING ( auth.uid() = id );

-- Admins can view all profiles
CREATE POLICY "Admins can view all profiles"
  ON public.profiles FOR SELECT
  USING ( 
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

-- Admins can update all profiles
CREATE POLICY "Admins can update all profiles"
  ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE
  USING ( 
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
      WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    )
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.featured_products_view AS
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.slug,
  p.name,
  p.category_id,
  p.program_id,
  p.base_price,
  p.discount_percent,
  p.stock,
  p.points,
  p.is_active,
  p.is_featured,
  p.homepage_order,
  p.weight_goal_tag,
  p.image_url,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at,
  -- RÉ™y statistikalarÄ±
  COALESCE(rev.rating_average, 0) as rating_average,
  COALESCE(rev.review_count, 0) as review_count
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    AVG(rating)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
    COUNT(*)::int as review_count
  FROM public.reviews
  GROUP BY product_id
) rev ON p.id = rev.product_id
WHERE p.is_featured = true 
  AND p.is_active = true
ORDER BY p.homepage_order ASC, p.created_at DESC;

-- RLS aktivlÉ™ÅŸdirilmÉ™si
ALTER VIEW public.featured_products_view SET (security_invoker = true);

-- ==============================================================================
-- 2. FEATURED CATEGORIES VIEW
-- ==============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.featured_categories_view AS
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.slug,
  c.name,
  c.icon,
  c.description,
  c.image_url,
  c.parent_id,
  c.is_featured,
  c.homepage_order,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  -- MÉ™hsul sayÄ±
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)::int as product_count
FROM public.categories c
LEFT JOIN public.products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.is_active = true
WHERE c.is_featured = true
GROUP BY c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.icon, c.description, c.image_url, 
         c.parent_id, c.is_featured, c.homepage_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at
ORDER BY c.homepage_order ASC, c.created_at DESC;

-- RLS aktivlÉ™ÅŸdirilmÉ™si
ALTER VIEW public.featured_categories_view SET (security_invoker = true);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_featured_products(limit_count INT DEFAULT 12)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id BIGINT,
  slug TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  category_id BIGINT,
  program_id BIGINT,
  base_price NUMERIC,
  discount_percent NUMERIC,
  stock INT,
  points NUMERIC,
  is_active BOOLEAN,
  is_featured BOOLEAN,
  homepage_order INT,
  weight_goal_tag TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  rating_average NUMERIC,
  review_count INT
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    p.slug,
    p.name,
    p.category_id,
    p.program_id,
    p.base_price,
    p.discount_percent,
    p.stock,
    p.points,
    p.is_active,
    p.is_featured,
    p.homepage_order,
    p.weight_goal_tag,
    p.image_url,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    COALESCE(rev.rating_average, 0)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
    COALESCE(rev.review_count, 0)::int as review_count
  FROM public.products p
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      product_id,
      AVG(rating)::numeric(3,2) as rating_average,
      COUNT(*)::int as review_count
    FROM public.reviews
    GROUP BY product_id
  ) rev ON p.id = rev.product_id
  WHERE p.is_featured = true 
    AND p.is_active = true
  ORDER BY p.homepage_order ASC, p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT limit_count;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- ==============================================================================
-- 4. FEATURED CATEGORIES FUNKSÄ°YASI
-- ==============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_featured_categories(limit_count INT DEFAULT 8)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id BIGINT,
  slug TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  icon TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  parent_id BIGINT,
  is_featured BOOLEAN,
  homepage_order INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  product_count INT
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.slug,
    c.name,
    c.icon,
    c.description,
    c.image_url,
    c.parent_id,
    c.is_featured,
    c.homepage_order,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)::int as product_count
  FROM public.categories c
  LEFT JOIN public.products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.is_active = true
  WHERE c.is_featured = true
  GROUP BY c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.icon, c.description, c.image_url, 
           c.parent_id, c.is_featured, c.homepage_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at
  ORDER BY c.homepage_order ASC, c.created_at DESC
  LIMIT limit_count;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

import { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function verifyAdmin(supabase: SupabaseClient) {
  const {
    data: { user },
    error: authError,
  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  if (authError || !user) {
    return { error: "Unauthorized", status: 401 };
  }

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (profileError || !profile || profile.role !== "admin") {
    return { error: "Forbidden", status: 403 };
  }

  return { user };
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { getSiteSettings, getMetaTags } from "@/modules/settings/queries";
import { ensureAbsoluteImageUrl } from "@/lib/seo-utils";
import { parseKeywords } from "@/lib/keywords-utils";

const OG_LOCALE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  az: "az_AZ",
  en: "en_US",
  tr: "tr_TR",
  ru: "ru_RU",
};

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export type BuildPageMetadataArgs = {
  locale: string;
  /** meta_tags.page dÉ™yÉ™ri (admin panel) */
  pageKey: string;
  /**
   * Kanonik path: lokal sÉ™hifÉ™lÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n "/products"; auth Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n "/auth/login"
   */
  canonicalPath: string;
  fallbackTitle: string;
  fallbackDescription: string;
  fallbackKeywords?: string;
  /**
   * true: URL-dÉ™ dil prefiksi yoxdur (middleware /auth, /account)
   */
  omitLocaleInCanonical?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Admin meta_tags + site_settings É™sasÄ±nda Next Metadata (Open Graph, Twitter, canonical).
 */
export async function buildPageMetadata({
  locale,
  pageKey,
  canonicalPath,
  fallbackTitle,
  fallbackDescription,
  fallbackKeywords,
  omitLocaleInCanonical,
}: BuildPageMetadataArgs): Promise<Metadata> {
  const localePath = LOCALES.includes(locale as (typeof LOCALES)[number])
    ? locale
    : "az";

  const [settings, metaTags] = await Promise.all([
    getSiteSettings(),
    getMetaTags(pageKey),
  ]);

  const siteUrl =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || "https://www.herbaformadaqal.com";
  const brandName =
    settings?.public_site_name || settings?.site_name || "Herbalife";

  const title = (metaTags?.title?.trim() || fallbackTitle).trim();
  const description = (
    metaTags?.description?.trim() || fallbackDescription
  ).trim();
  const keywordsRaw =
    metaTags?.keywords?.trim() || fallbackKeywords || "";
  const keywords = keywordsRaw ? parseKeywords(keywordsRaw) : [];

  const rawOgImage =
    metaTags?.og_image ||
    metaTags?.image ||
    settings?.logo ||
    `${siteUrl}/og-image.jpg`;
  const ogImage =
    ensureAbsoluteImageUrl(rawOgImage, siteUrl) || `${siteUrl}/og-image.jpg`;

  const path =
    canonicalPath === "/" ? "" : canonicalPath.startsWith("/")
      ? canonicalPath
      : `/${canonicalPath}`;

  const canonical = omitLocaleInCanonical
    ? `${siteUrl}${path === "" ? "" : path}`
    : `${siteUrl}/${localePath}${path}`;

  const ogTitle = metaTags?.og_title?.trim() || title;
  const ogDescription =
    metaTags?.og_description?.trim() || description;

  const alternates: Metadata["alternates"] = omitLocaleInCanonical
    ? { canonical }
    : {
        canonical,
        languages: {
          "x-default": siteUrl,
          az: `${siteUrl}/az${path}`,
          en: `${siteUrl}/en${path}`,
          tr: `${siteUrl}/tr${path}`,
          ru: `${siteUrl}/ru${path}`,
        },
      };

  return {
    title,
    description,
    keywords: keywords.length > 0 ? keywords : undefined,
    openGraph: {
      title: ogTitle,
      description: ogDescription,
      url: canonical,
      siteName: brandName,
      images: [{ url: ogImage, width: 1200, height: 630, alt: ogTitle }],
      locale: OG_LOCALE_MAP[localePath] || "az_AZ",
      type: "website",
    },
    twitter: {
      card: "summary_large_image",
      title: ogTitle,
      description: ogDescription,
      images: [ogImage],
    },
    alternates,
  };
}

import { defaultLocale, locales, type Locale } from "@/modules/i18n/config";

async function loadMessages(locale: Locale) {
  switch (locale) {
    case "az":
      return (await import("@/modules/i18n/messages/az.json")).default;
    case "ru":
      return (await import("@/modules/i18n/messages/ru.json")).default;
    case "en":
      return (await import("@/modules/i18n/messages/en.json")).default;
    case "tr":
      return (await import("@/modules/i18n/messages/tr.json")).default;
    default:
      return (await import("@/modules/i18n/messages/az.json")).default;
  }
}

export type Messages = Record<string, string>;

export async function getMessages(locale?: string): Promise<Messages> {
  const value = locales.includes(locale as Locale)
    ? (locale as Locale)
    : defaultLocale;
  return loadMessages(value);
}

/**
 * AÃ§ar sÃ¶zlÉ™ri (keywords) vergÃ¼l, nÃ¶qtÉ™li vergÃ¼l vÉ™ ya yeni sÉ™tir ilÉ™ ayrÄ±lmÄ±ÅŸ
 * sÉ™tirdÉ™n massivÉ™ Ã§evirir. BoÅŸ vÉ™ artÄ±q boÅŸluqlar silinir.
 * Google vÉ™ digÉ™r axtarÄ±ÅŸ sistemlÉ™ri Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n hÉ™r aÃ§ar sÃ¶z ayrÄ±ca nÉ™zÉ™rÉ™ alÄ±nÄ±r.
 */
const KEYWORD_SEPARATORS = /[,;\n]+/;

export function parseKeywords(raw: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (raw == null || typeof raw !== "string") return [];
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return [];
  return trimmed
    .split(KEYWORD_SEPARATORS)
    .map((k) => k.trim())
    .filter((k) => k.length > 0);
}

/**
 * Saxlama Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n: istifadÉ™Ã§i mÉ™tni parse edib yenidÉ™n vergÃ¼llÉ™ birlÉ™ÅŸdirir.
 * DB-dÉ™ hÉ™miÅŸÉ™ "aÃ§ar sÃ¶z1, aÃ§ar sÃ¶z2" formatÄ± qalÄ±r.
 */
export function formatKeywordsForStorage(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const arr = parseKeywords(raw);
  if (arr.length === 0) return null;
  return arr.join(", ");
}

import { headers } from "next/headers";

const LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const FALLBACK = "en";

function getLocaleFromAcceptLanguage(acceptLanguage: string | null): string {
  if (!acceptLanguage?.trim()) return FALLBACK;
  const parts = acceptLanguage.split(",").map((p) => p.trim().split(";")[0]?.toLowerCase() || "");
  for (const part of parts) {
    const lang = (part.split("-")[0] || part).toLowerCase();
    if (LOCALES.includes(lang as (typeof LOCALES)[number])) return lang;
  }
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** Server component-dÉ™ Accept-Language-dan dil almaq Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n */
export async function getLocaleFromHeaders(): Promise<string> {
  const headersList = await headers();
  const acceptLanguage = headersList.get("accept-language");
  return getLocaleFromAcceptLanguage(acceptLanguage);
}

import { locales, type Locale } from "@/modules/i18n/config";

/**
 * Path artÄ±q dil prefiksi ilÉ™ baÅŸlayÄ±rsa (mÉ™s. /en/products) true
 */
export function pathHasLocalePrefix(path?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!path) return false;
  const segment = path.replace(/^\/+/, "").split("/")[0] || "";
  return locales.includes(segment as Locale);
}

/**
 * Path-dÉ™n dil prefiksini Ã§Ä±xarÄ±r: /en/products -> /products, /az -> /
 */
export function getPathWithoutLocale(path?: string | null): string {
  const normalized = path
    ? path.startsWith("/")
      ? path
      : `/${path}`
    : "/";
  if (!pathHasLocalePrefix(normalized)) return normalized;
  const rest = normalized.replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}/, "") || "/";
  return rest || "/";
}

/**
 * Daxili linklÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n cari dilÉ™ uyÄŸun path qaytarÄ±r.
 * /api vÉ™ /admin Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n prefiks É™lavÉ™ etmir.
 */
export function getLocalizedPath(path: string, locale: Locale): string {
  const normalized = path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`;
  if (
    normalized.startsWith("/api") ||
    normalized.startsWith("/admin") ||
    normalized.startsWith("/auth") ||
    normalized.startsWith("/account")
  ) {
    return normalized;
  }
  if (pathHasLocalePrefix(normalized)) {
    return normalized;
  }
  return `/${locale}${normalized}`;
}

/**
 * MÃ¼ÅŸtÉ™ri adÄ±nÄ± rÉ™ylÉ™rdÉ™ ÅŸifrÉ™lÉ™nmiÅŸ (maskalanmÄ±ÅŸ) formada gÃ¶stÉ™rmÉ™k Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n.
 * MÉ™s: "Ä°smayÄ±l" â†’ "Ä°***l", "Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i" â†’ "Ä°***i"
 */
export function maskUserName(name: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (name == null || typeof name !== "string") return "***";
  const s = name.trim();
  if (s.length === 0) return "***";
  if (s.length === 1) return s + "***";
  const first = s[0];
  const last = s[s.length - 1];
  if (s.length <= 4) return first + "***";
  return first + "***" + last;
}

import type { Product } from "@/modules/products/types";

/** TÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™ cÉ™dvÉ™lindÉ™ mÉ™tn axtarÄ±ÅŸÄ± Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n sahÉ™lÉ™r (bÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™r) */
const SEARCH_TRANSLATION_FIELDS = new Set(["title", "description", "name"]);

/**
 * MÉ™hsulun bÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™rdÉ™ki ad/tÉ™svir mÉ™tnlÉ™rini vÉ™ slug-u birlÉ™ÅŸdirir (É™sas sÉ™hifÉ™ kartlarÄ± Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n).
 */
export function productSearchHaystack(
  p: Pick<Product, "slug" | "translations"> & { name?: string | null }
): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (p.slug) parts.push(p.slug);
  if (p.name) parts.push(p.name);
  for (const tr of p.translations || []) {
    if (SEARCH_TRANSLATION_FIELDS.has(tr.field) && tr.value) parts.push(tr.value);
  }
  return parts.join(" \u0001 ").toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Client-side mÉ™hsul siyahÄ±sÄ±: sorÄŸu istÉ™nilÉ™n dildÉ™ olanda uyÄŸun gÉ™lir (bÃ¼tÃ¼n tÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™ dÉ™yÉ™rlÉ™ri + slug + name).
 */
export function productMatchesQuery(
  p: Product & { name?: string | null },
  q: string
): boolean {
  const qt = q.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!qt) return true;
  const qn = qt.replace(/-/g, " ");
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (p.slug) {
    parts.push(p.slug.toLowerCase());
    parts.push(p.slug.toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, " "));
  }
  if (p.name) parts.push(String(p.name).toLowerCase());
  for (const tr of p.translations || []) {
    if (SEARCH_TRANSLATION_FIELDS.has(tr.field) && tr.value) {
      parts.push(tr.value.toLowerCase());
    }
  }
  return parts.some((h) => h.includes(qt) || h.includes(qn));
}

export function normalizeRole(role: unknown): string {
  if (typeof role !== "string") return "user";
  return role.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_");
}

export function isAdminRole(role: unknown): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeRole(role);
  return normalized === "admin" || normalized === "super_admin";
}

/**
 * Meta/OG ÅŸÉ™kil URL-ini Google vÉ™ sosial ÅŸÉ™bÉ™kÉ™lÉ™r Ã¼Ã§Ã¼n hÉ™miÅŸÉ™ absolute URL et.
 * Nisbi path (/uploads/...) vÉ™ ya boÅŸ olarsa siteUrl É™sasÄ±nda dÃ¼zÉ™ldir.
 */
export function ensureAbsoluteImageUrl(
  imageUrl: string | null | undefined,
  siteUrl: string
): string {
  if (!imageUrl || !imageUrl.trim()) return "";
  const trimmed = imageUrl.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith("http://") || trimmed.startsWith("https://")) {
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (trimmed.startsWith("/")) {
    return `${siteUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}${trimmed}`;
  }
  return `${siteUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/${trimmed}`;
}

"use client";
import { createBrowserClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

let client: SupabaseClient | null = null;

const isInvalidRefreshTokenError = (err: { message?: string } | null) =>
  err?.message?.includes("Refresh Token") ||
  err?.message?.includes("refresh_token") ||
  err?.message?.includes("Invalid Refresh Token");

export function getSupabaseBrowserClient(): SupabaseClient {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return {
      auth: {
        signInWithPassword: async () => ({
          data: null,
          error: new Error("Auth not available in SSR"),
        }),
        signUp: async () => ({
          data: null,
          error: new Error("Auth not available in SSR"),
        }),
        getUser: async () => ({
          data: { user: null },
          error: new Error("Auth not available in SSR"),
        }),
      },
    } as unknown as SupabaseClient;
  }
  if (!client) {
    const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
    if (!url || !key) {
      return {
        auth: {
          signInWithPassword: async () => ({
            data: null,
            error: new Error("Supabase env not configured"),
          }),
          signUp: async () => ({
            data: null,
            error: new Error("Supabase env not configured"),
          }),
          getUser: async () => ({
            data: { user: null },
            error: new Error("Supabase env not configured"),
          }),
        },
      } as unknown as SupabaseClient;
    }
    const rawClient = createBrowserClient(url, key);
    const originalGetUser = rawClient.auth.getUser.bind(rawClient.auth);
    rawClient.auth.getUser = async () => {
      const result = await originalGetUser();
      if (result.error && isInvalidRefreshTokenError(result.error)) {
        await rawClient.auth.signOut();
        const next = typeof window !== "undefined" ? encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname) : "";
        window.location.href = `/auth/login${next ? `?next=${next}` : ""}`;
        return { data: { user: null }, error: result.error };
      }
      return result;
    };
    const originalGetSession = rawClient.auth.getSession?.bind(rawClient.auth);
    if (originalGetSession) {
      rawClient.auth.getSession = async () => {
        const result = await originalGetSession();
        if (result.error && isInvalidRefreshTokenError(result.error)) {
          await rawClient.auth.signOut();
          const next = typeof window !== "undefined" ? encodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname) : "";
          window.location.href = `/auth/login${next ? `?next=${next}` : ""}`;
          return { data: { session: null }, error: result.error };
        }
        return result;
      };
    }
    client = rawClient;
  }
  return client;
}

export async function getSupabaseServerClient(): Promise<SupabaseClient> {
  if (!url || !key) {
    const emptyListResult = { data: [], error: null };
    const singleNullResult = { data: null, error: null };

    const selectBuilder = {
      eq: () => selectBuilder,
      order: () => emptyListResult,
      limit: () => emptyListResult,
      in: () => emptyListResult,
      maybeSingle: () => singleNullResult,
      single: () => singleNullResult,
    };

    return Promise.resolve({
      auth: {
        getUser: async () => ({
          data: { user: null },
          error: new Error("Supabase env not configured"),
        }),
      },
      from: () => ({
        select: () => selectBuilder,
        insert: () => ({
          select: () => ({
            single: () => ({ data: null, error: new Error("Supabase env not configured") }),
          }),
        }),
      }),
    } as unknown as SupabaseClient);
  }

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const client = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return cookieStore.getAll();
      },
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        try {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
          );
        } catch {
          // ignore in server components where setAll may not be allowed
        }
      },
    },
  });
  return client as unknown as SupabaseClient;
}

import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";
import type { CartLineInput, PricingResult } from "./types";

export async function calculateTotals(input: {
  lines: CartLineInput[];
  couponCode?: string;
  shippingMethodId?: number;
  shippingAddress?: Record<string, unknown>;
  userId: string;
}): Promise<PricingResult> {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const productIds = input.lines.map((l) => l.productId);
  const { data: products } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .in("id", productIds);
  let subtotal = 0;
  for (const line of input.lines) {
    const product = products?.find((p) => p.id === line.productId);
    if (!product) continue;
    const base = Number(product.base_price) || 0;
    const discount = Number(product.discount_percent) || 0;
    const unit = base * (1 - discount / 100);
    subtotal += unit * line.quantity;
  }
  let discount = 0;
  let couponId: number | null = null;
  if (input.couponCode) {
    const { data: coupon } = await supabase
      .from("coupons")
      .select("*")
      .eq("code", input.couponCode)
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (coupon) {
      couponId = coupon.id;
      if (coupon.coupon_type === "percentage") {
        discount = (Number(coupon.value) / 100) * subtotal;
      } else if (coupon.coupon_type === "fixed") {
        discount = Number(coupon.value);
      }
      if (coupon.max_discount_amount) {
        const max = Number(coupon.max_discount_amount);
        if (discount > max) discount = max;
      }
    }
  }
  let shipping = 0;
  let shippingMethodId: number | null = null;
  if (input.shippingMethodId) {
    const { data: method } = await supabase
      .from("shipping_methods")
      .select("*")
      .eq("id", input.shippingMethodId)
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (method) {
      shippingMethodId = method.id;
      shipping = Number(method.base_price) || 0;
    }
  }
  const total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount + shipping);
  return {
    subtotal,
    discount,
    shipping,
    total,
    couponId,
    shippingMethodId,
    shippingAddress: input.shippingAddress || null,
  };
}

import type {
  PaymentGateway,
  PaymentIntentInput,
  PaymentIntentResult,
} from "./gateway";

const AZ_GATEWAY_BASE = process.env.PAYMENT_API_BASE_URL || "";

async function callGateway(input: PaymentIntentInput) {
  const res = await fetch(`${AZ_GATEWAY_BASE}/payments`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.PAYMENT_API_KEY || ""}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      amount: input.amount,
      currency: input.currency,
      order_id: input.orderId,
      return_url: process.env.PAYMENT_RETURN_URL,
      webhook_url: process.env.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_URL,
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error("Payment provider error");
  }
  return res.json();
}

export const azGateway: PaymentGateway = {
  async createPaymentIntent(
    input: PaymentIntentInput
  ): Promise<PaymentIntentResult> {
    const data = await callGateway(input);
    return {
      redirectUrl: data.redirect_url,
      providerReference: data.reference,
    };
  },
  verifySignature(payload: string, signature: string) {
    if (!process.env.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET) return false;
    const expected = process.env.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
    return signature === expected && payload.length > 0;
  },
};

export async function getProductBySlug(slug: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: product } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("slug", slug)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!product) return null;

  const [translationsResult, imagesResult, reviewsResult, campaignsResult] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("translations")
      .select("*")
      .eq("entity_table", "products")
      .eq("entity_id", product.id),
    supabase
      .from("product_images")
      .select("*")
      .eq("product_id", product.id)
      .order("position"),
    supabase
      .from("reviews")
      .select("*")
      .eq("product_id", product.id)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
    // Aktiv kampaniyalarÄ± gÉ™tir
    supabase
      .from("campaign_products")
      .select(`
        discount_percent,
        campaigns (
          id,
          slug,
          campaign_type,
          starts_at,
          ends_at,
          is_active
        )
      `)
      .eq("product_id", product.id),
  ]);

  const rawReviews = (reviewsResult.data || []) as { user_id?: string; [key: string]: unknown }[];
  const reviewCount = rawReviews.length;
  const ratingSum = rawReviews.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.rating as number), 0);
  const ratingAverage = reviewCount > 0 ? ratingSum / reviewCount : 0;

  // RÉ™y sahiblÉ™rinin profillÉ™rini gÃ¶tÃ¼rÃ¼b adlarÄ± ÅŸifrÉ™lÉ™nmiÅŸ formada É™lavÉ™ et
  const userIds = [...new Set(rawReviews.map((r) => r.user_id).filter(Boolean))] as string[];
  const profiles: Record<string, { full_name?: string | null }> = {};
  if (userIds.length > 0) {
    const { data: profilesData } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("id, full_name")
      .in("id", userIds);
    (profilesData || []).forEach((p: { id: string; full_name?: string | null }) => {
      profiles[p.id] = { full_name: p.full_name };
    });
  }
  const reviews = rawReviews.map((r) => ({
    ...r,
    user_display_name_masked: maskUserName(profiles[r.user_id!]?.full_name ?? "Ä°stifadÉ™Ã§i"),
  }));

  // Aktiv kampaniyalarÄ± filtrlÉ™
  const now = new Date();
  const activeCampaigns = (campaignsResult.data || [])
    .filter((cp: any) => {
      const campaign = cp.campaigns;
      if (!campaign || !campaign.is_active) return false;
      if (campaign.starts_at && new Date(campaign.starts_at) > now) return false;
      if (campaign.ends_at && new Date(campaign.ends_at) < now) return false;
      return true;
    })
    .map((cp: any) => ({
      id: cp.campaigns.id,
      slug: cp.campaigns.slug,
      campaign_type: cp.campaigns.campaign_type,
      discount_percent: Number(cp.discount_percent) || 0,
    }));

  // Æn yÃ¼ksÉ™k endirim faizini tap
  const maxCampaignDiscount = activeCampaigns.length > 0
    ? Math.max(...activeCampaigns.map((c: any) => c.discount_percent))
    : 0;

  // MÉ™hsulun Ã¶z endirimi ilÉ™ kampaniya endirmini birlÉ™ÅŸdir
  const productDiscount = Number(product.discount_percent) || 0;
  const totalDiscount = Math.max(productDiscount, maxCampaignDiscount);

  return {
    ...product,
    translations: translationsResult.data || [],
    product_images: imagesResult.data || [],
    reviews,
    rating_average: ratingAverage,
    review_count: reviewCount,
    campaigns: activeCampaigns,
    effective_discount_percent: totalDiscount > productDiscount ? totalDiscount : productDiscount,
  } as Product & { campaigns?: any[]; effective_discount_percent?: number };
}

const CATEGORY_LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export async function getCategories(locale?: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.from("categories").select("*").order("id");
  const rows = data || [];

  const safeLocale = locale && (CATEGORY_LOCALES as readonly string[]).includes(locale) ? locale : "az";

  let nameByCategoryId: Map<number, string> = new Map();
  if (rows.length > 0 && safeLocale !== "az") {
    const ids = rows.map((r: any) => r.id);
    const { data: translations } = await supabase
      .from("translations")
      .select("entity_id, value")
      .eq("entity_table", "categories")
      .eq("field", "name")
      .eq("language", safeLocale)
      .in("entity_id", ids);
    if (translations) {
      translations.forEach((t: any) => nameByCategoryId.set(Number(t.entity_id), t.value));
    }
  }

  return rows.map((cat: any) => {
    const slug = cat.slug || (cat.name ? cat.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') : `category-${cat.id}`);
    const baseName = cat.name || slug.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ");
    const name = (safeLocale !== "az" && nameByCategoryId.get(cat.id)) || baseName;
    return {
      ...cat,
      slug,
      name,
    };
  }) as Category[];
}

export async function getCategoryBySlug(slug: string, locale?: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const decodedSlug = decodeURIComponent(slug);

  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("categories")
    .select("*")
    .eq("slug", decodedSlug)
    .maybeSingle();

  let category = data;
  if (!category) {
    const { data: allCategories } = await supabase.from("categories").select("*");
    category = (allCategories || []).find((c: any) => {
      const dbSlug = c.slug || (c.name ? c.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') : '');
      return dbSlug === decodedSlug || dbSlug === slug || decodeURIComponent(dbSlug) === decodedSlug;
    }) || null;
  }
  if (!category) return null;

  const baseName = category.name || (category.slug || "").split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ");
  let name = baseName;
  const safeLocale = locale && (CATEGORY_LOCALES as readonly string[]).includes(locale) ? locale : "az";
  if (safeLocale !== "az") {
    const { data: tr } = await supabase
      .from("translations")
      .select("value")
      .eq("entity_table", "categories")
      .eq("entity_id", category.id)
      .eq("field", "name")
      .eq("language", safeLocale)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (tr?.value) name = tr.value;
  }

  return { ...category, name } as Category;
}

export async function getCategoryById(id: number) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  if (!id || isNaN(id)) {
    console.error("getCategoryById: Invalid id provided:", id);
    return null;
  }
  
  // Try direct lookup first
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("categories")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", id)
    .maybeSingle();
  
  if (error) {
    console.error("getCategoryById error:", error);
    return null;
  }
    
  if (data) {
    // Ensure name and slug exist
    const slug = data.slug || (data.name ? data.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') : `category-${data.id}`);
    const name = data.name || (data.slug ? data.slug.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ") : `Category ${data.id}`);
    
    return {
      ...data,
      slug,
      name,
    } as Category;
  }

  // Fallback: Fetch all and find match (handles cases where query fails)
  const { data: allCategories, error: allError } = await supabase.from("categories").select("*");
  
  if (allError) {
    console.error("getCategoryById - fetch all error:", allError);
    return null;
  }
  
  const match = (allCategories || []).find((c: any) => c.id === id);
  
  if (match) {
    // Ensure name and slug exist
    const slug = match.slug || (match.name ? match.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') : `category-${match.id}`);
    const name = match.name || (match.slug ? match.slug.split("-").map((s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)).join(" ") : `Category ${match.id}`);
    
    return {
      ...match,
      slug,
      name,
    } as Category;
  }
  
  console.warn("getCategoryById: Category not found with id:", id);
  return null;
}

export async function getProductsByCategory(categoryId: number) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  
  const allProductIds = new Set<number>();
  
  // 1. product_categories cÉ™dvÉ™lindÉ™n mÉ™hsul ID-lÉ™rini gÉ™tir (É™gÉ™r cÉ™dvÉ™l mÃ¶vcuddursa)
  try {
    const { data: productCategories, error: pcError } = await supabase
      .from("product_categories")
      .select("product_id")
      .eq("category_id", categoryId);
    
    // ÆgÉ™r error yoxdursa vÉ™ data varsa, istifadÉ™ et
    if (!pcError && productCategories) {
      productCategories.forEach((pc: any) => {
        if (pc.product_id) {
          allProductIds.add(pc.product_id);
        }
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // product_categories cÉ™dvÉ™li mÃ¶vcud deyilsÉ™, error ignore et
    console.log("product_categories table may not exist, using category_id only");
  }
  
  // 2. category_id ilÉ™ mÉ™hsullarÄ± gÉ™tir (fallback vÉ™ ya É™lavÉ™)
  const { data: productsByCategoryId, error: catError } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("id")
    .eq("category_id", categoryId)
    .eq("is_active", true);
  
  if (!catError && productsByCategoryId) {
    productsByCategoryId.forEach((p: any) => {
      if (p.id) {
        allProductIds.add(p.id);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // ÆgÉ™r heÃ§ bir mÉ™hsul tapÄ±lmadÄ±sa, boÅŸ array qaytar
  if (allProductIds.size === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  
  // 3. BÃ¼tÃ¼n mÉ™hsullarÄ± gÉ™tir (yalnÄ±z aktiv olanlar)
  const { data: products, error: productsError } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .in("id", Array.from(allProductIds))
    .eq("is_active", true);
  
  if (productsError) {
    console.error("Error fetching products by category:", productsError);
    return [];
  }
  
  return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings((products || []) as Product[]);
}

const PROGRAMS_LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;
const PROGRAMS_FIELDS = ["title", "description"] as const;

export async function getPrograms(locale?: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: rows } = await supabase
    .from("programs")
    .select("id, title, description, image_url, duration, price, slug, is_active, title_font_size, title_font_weight, description_font_size, description_font_weight")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  const list = rows ?? [];
  if (list.length === 0) return list;

  const useTranslations =
    locale &&
    PROGRAMS_LOCALES.includes(locale as (typeof PROGRAMS_LOCALES)[number]) &&
    locale !== "az";

  if (!useTranslations) return list;

  const ids = list.map((r: { id: number }) => r.id);
  const { data: trans } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id, field, value")
    .eq("entity_table", "programs")
    .eq("language", locale)
    .in("entity_id", ids)
    .in("field", PROGRAMS_FIELDS);

  const byId = new Map<number, Record<string, string>>();
  (trans || []).forEach((t: { entity_id: number; field: string; value: string }) => {
    if (!byId.has(t.entity_id)) byId.set(t.entity_id, {});
    byId.get(t.entity_id)![t.field] = t.value ?? "";
  });

  return list.map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const tr = byId.get(row.id as number) || {};
    return {
      ...row,
      title: tr.title ?? row.title,
      description: tr.description ?? row.description,
    };
  });
}

export async function searchProducts(query: string) {
  if (!query || !query.trim()) {
    return [];
  }

  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const trimmedQuery = query.trim();
  // PostgREST .or() vergÃ¼llÉ™ri ayÄ±rÄ±cÄ± kimi oxuyur â€” tÉ™mizlÉ™; %/_ ilike xÃ¼susi simvollarÄ± da aradan qaldÄ±r
  const safeForIlike = trimmedQuery.replace(/[,()%]/g, " ").replace(/[%_]/g, " ").trim();
  if (!safeForIlike) {
    return [];
  }
  const searchTerm = `%${safeForIlike}%`;

  // 1. Products: slug + name (description sÃ¼tunu sxemada olmaya bilÉ™r â€” tÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™lÉ™rdÉ™ axtarÄ±lÄ±r)
  const { data: productsByDirectMatch } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .or(`slug.ilike.${searchTerm},name.ilike.${searchTerm}`);

  // 2. BÃ¼tÃ¼n dillÉ™rdÉ™ title, description, name tÉ™rcÃ¼mÉ™lÉ™ri
  const { data: translations } = await supabase
    .from("translations")
    .select("entity_id")
    .eq("entity_table", "products")
    .in("field", ["title", "description", "name"])
    .ilike("value", searchTerm);

  // 3. Translations-dÉ™ tapÄ±lan mÉ™hsul ID-lÉ™rini gÃ¶tÃ¼r
  const productIdsFromTranslations = translations
    ? [...new Set(translations.map((t) => t.entity_id))]
    : [];

  // 4. Bu ID-lÉ™rÉ™ gÃ¶rÉ™ mÉ™hsullarÄ± gÉ™tir
  let productsByTranslation: Product[] = [];
  if (productIdsFromTranslations.length > 0) {
    const { data: productsFromTranslations } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("*")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .in("id", productIdsFromTranslations);
    
    productsByTranslation = (productsFromTranslations || []) as Product[];
  }

  // 5. HÉ™r iki nÉ™ticÉ™ni birlÉ™ÅŸdir vÉ™ unique mÉ™hsullarÄ± gÃ¶tÃ¼r
  const allProducts = [
    ...(productsByDirectMatch || []),
    ...productsByTranslation,
  ] as Product[];

  // 6. Duplicate mÉ™hsullarÄ± sil (id-yÉ™ gÃ¶rÉ™)
  const uniqueProducts = Array.from(
    new Map(allProducts.map((p) => [p.id, p])).values()
  );

  // 7. Limit tÉ™tbiq et
  const limitedProducts = uniqueProducts.slice(0, 50);

  return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings(limitedProducts);
}

export async function getRecommendedProducts(limit = 4) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  let recommendedProducts: Product[] = [];

  if (user) {
    // Get last viewed products by this user
    const { data: views } = await supabase
      .from("product_views")
      .select("product_id")
      .eq("user_id", user.id)
      .order("viewed_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(5);

    if (views && views.length > 0) {
      const viewedProductIds = views.map((v) => v.product_id);

      // Get categories of these viewed products
      // We need to fetch the products first to know their categories
      const { data: viewedProductsDetails } = await supabase
        .from("products")
        .select("category_id")
        .in("id", viewedProductIds);

      const categoryIds = viewedProductsDetails
        ?.map((p) => p.category_id)
        .filter((id): id is number => id !== null) || [];
      
      const uniqueCategoryIds = Array.from(new Set(categoryIds));

      if (uniqueCategoryIds.length > 0) {
        // Fetch products from these categories
        const { data: products } = await supabase
          .from("products")
          .select("*")
          .in("category_id", uniqueCategoryIds)
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .limit(limit);

        if (products) {
          recommendedProducts = products as Product[];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // If we don't have enough recommendations (or user not logged in), fetch popular/random products
  if (recommendedProducts.length < limit) {
    const needed = limit - recommendedProducts.length;
    // For now, just fetch latest active products as fallback
    const { data: fallbackProducts } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("*")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(needed + 5); // Fetch a bit more to avoid duplicates

    if (fallbackProducts) {
      const existingIds = new Set(recommendedProducts.map((p) => p.id));
      const newProducts = (fallbackProducts as Product[])
        .filter((p) => !existingIds.has(p.id))
        .slice(0, needed);
      
      recommendedProducts = [...recommendedProducts, ...newProducts];
    }
  }

  return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings(recommendedProducts);
}

export async function getMostViewedProducts(excludeProductId?: number, limit = 8) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Count views per product from the product_views table
  const { data: viewCounts } = await supabase
    .from("product_views")
    .select("product_id");

  if (!viewCounts || viewCounts.length === 0) {
    // Fallback: return popular products by created_at
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("*")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(limit + 1);
    const products = ((data || []) as Product[]).filter(p => p.id !== excludeProductId).slice(0, limit);
    return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings(products);
  }

  // Count views per product
  const countMap = new Map<number, number>();
  viewCounts.forEach((v: any) => {
    countMap.set(v.product_id, (countMap.get(v.product_id) || 0) + 1);
  });

  // Sort by view count descending
  const sortedIds = Array.from(countMap.entries())
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .filter(([pid]) => pid !== excludeProductId)
    .slice(0, limit)
    .map(([pid]) => pid);

  if (sortedIds.length === 0) {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from("products")
      .select("*")
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(limit);
    return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings((data || []) as Product[]);
  }

  const { data: products } = await supabase
    .from("products")
    .select("*")
    .in("id", sortedIds)
    .eq("is_active", true);

  // Preserve order from sortedIds
  const productMap = new Map((products || []).map((p: any) => [p.id, p]));
  const ordered = sortedIds
    .map(id => productMap.get(id))
    .filter(Boolean) as Product[];

  return await enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings(ordered);
}

async function enrichProductsWithTranslationsAndRatings(products: Product[]): Promise<Product[]> {
  if (!products.length) return [];
  const productIds = products.map((p) => p.id);
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();

  // Fetch translations and reviews in parallel
  const [{ data: translations }, { data: reviews }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("translations")
      .select("entity_id, language, field, value")
      .eq("entity_table", "products")
      .in("entity_id", productIds),
    supabase
      .from("reviews")
      .select("product_id, rating")
      .in("product_id", productIds),
  ]);

  // Build translations map
  const translationsMap = new Map<number, Array<{ language: string; field: string; value: string }>>();
  (translations || []).forEach((t: any) => {
    const list = translationsMap.get(t.entity_id) || [];
    list.push({ language: t.language, field: t.field, value: t.value });
    translationsMap.set(t.entity_id, list);
  });

  // Build reviews map
  const reviewsMap = new Map<number, number[]>();
  (reviews || []).forEach((r: any) => {
    const list = reviewsMap.get(r.product_id) || [];
    list.push(r.rating);
    reviewsMap.set(r.product_id, list);
  });

  return products.map((p) => {
    const ratings = reviewsMap.get(p.id) || [];
    const count = ratings.length;
    const sum = ratings.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const avg = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0;
    const productTranslations = translationsMap.get(p.id) || [];
    return {
      ...p,
      translations: productTranslations as any,
      rating_average: avg,
      review_count: count,
    };
  });
}

import { getSupabaseServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase-server";

export async function getSiteSettings() {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("site_settings")
    .select("public_site_name, site_name, logo, footer_phone, primary_color, hide_prices, hide_points")
    .eq("id", 1)
    .maybeSingle();
  return data;
}

const HERO_LOCALES = ["az", "en", "tr", "ru"] as const;

export async function getHeroSlides(locale?: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const safeLocale = locale && (HERO_LOCALES as readonly string[]).includes(locale) ? locale : "az";
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("hero_slides")
    .select("*")
    .eq("is_active", true)
    .order("sort_order", { ascending: true });

  if (error) return [];
  const rows = data || [];
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const hasLocale = rows[0] && "locale" in rows[0];
  if (hasLocale) {
    const byLocale = rows.filter((r: { locale?: string }) => r.locale === safeLocale);
    if (byLocale.length > 0) return byLocale;
    const azRows = rows.filter((r: { locale?: string }) => r.locale === "az");
    return azRows.length > 0 ? azRows : rows;
  }
  return rows;
}

export async function getPageSections(pageSlug: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("page_sections")
    .select("section_key, content")
    .eq("page_slug", pageSlug);
  
  const sections: Record<string, any> = {};
  if (data) {
    data.forEach((row) => {
      sections[row.section_key] = row.content;
    });
  }
  return sections;
}

export async function getMetaTags(page: string) {
  const supabase = await getSupabaseServerClient();
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("meta_tags")
    .select("*")
    .eq("page", page)
    .maybeSingle();
  return data;
}
